n-m-h3-prob-02.title: Iziganeko Ezimbini Ezingenakwenzeka Kunye: Ngaba Ziyazimela?
n-m-h3-prob-02.goal: Hlula "azinakwenzeka kunye" kwa "ukuzimela," uze uchaze ukuqiqa usebenzisa intsingiselo yokuzimela (ukwazi enye akutshintshi ithuba lenye).
n-m-h3-prob-02.material: Idayisi elungileyo iphoswa kanye. Isiganeko A "kukuphosa 1 okanye 2," kwaye B "kukuphosa 3 okanye 4." Ezi ziganeko zimbini azinakwenzeka ngexesha elinye. UJimin wajonga oku wenza ibango elingezantsi.
n-m-h3-prob-02.thinking.0: Nqumela ukuba ibango lichanekile na usebenzisa ubungqina
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.prompt: UJimin wathi, "Iziganeko A no-B azinakwenzeka ngexesha elinye, ngoko azichaphazelani. Ngoko ziyazimela." Luluphi uvavanyo olufanelekileyo kakhulu lwebango likaJimin?
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.hint.0: Cinga wena ngokwakho ukuba kwenzeka ntoni kwithuba le-B xa wazi ukuba i-A yenzekile.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.hint.1: Ukuba ziyazimela, ukwazi i-A kufuneka kushiye ithuba le-B lisafana naleyo yokuqala. Thelekisa ukuba kunjalo na kule meko.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.o.a: Kungachanekanga. Ukuba uyazi ukuba i-A yenzekile, i-B ayisakwazi ukwenzeka, ngoko ithuba le-B lihluke kwelo lokuqala.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.o.b: Kuchanekile. Kuba ezi ziganeko zimbini azenzeki kunye, esinye asitshintshi ithuba lesinye.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.r.b: Uyifundile "azinakwenzeka kunye" njenge "azichaphazelani." Ukuba isiganeko esinye siyenzeka kwenza esinye singenzeki yimpembelelo enkulu ngokwayo.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.o.c: Kuchanekile. Kuba i-A ne-B zinethuba elifanayo, esinye asichaphazeli esinye.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.r.c: Amathuba alinganayo ngobukhulu kunye nokuzimela zizinto ezahlukeneyo. Ukuzimela kumalunga nokuba ithuba lesinye liyatshintsha xa wazi esinye.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.o.d: Kungachanekanga. Kuba i-A ne-B zinamathuba ahlukeneyo, esinye sichaphazela esinye.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.r.d: Amathuba ahlukeneyo akuthethi ukuba iziganeko aziyazimela. Into ekufuneka uyithelekise kukuba ithuba lesinye liyatshintsha xa wazi esinye.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.explain: Ukuba i-A ne-B azinakwenzeka ngexesha elinye kwaye nganye inethuba elikhulu kune-0, ngoko ukwazi ukuba i-A yenzekile kutshintsha ithuba le-B libe ngu-0. Ukuba ziyazimela, P(B|A)=P(B) kufuneka ibe yinyani, ngoko aziyazimela. Kwidayisi, xa i-A yi-1 okanye 2 kwaye i-B yi-3 okanye 4, P(B)=1/3, kodwa ukuba i-A yenzeka, P(B|A)=0.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s2.prompt: Ngokuphosa idayisi enye ngokufanayo, cinga nesiganeko C (ukuphosa inani eliyipheyiri) kunye nesiganeko D (ukuphosa 3 okanye ngaphantsi). Khetha onke amabini eziganeko ayazimela.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s2.hint.0: Kwibini ngalinye, fumana i-P(zombini iziganeko ziyenzeka) kunye ne-P(yokuqala)×P(yesibini) uze uthelekise ukuba ayalingana na.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s2.hint.1: Qala ubhale iziphosa ezizezeziganeko ngasinye, uze ufumane iziphosa ezizezeziganeko zombini.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s2.r.a: Uthathe ibini elingenakwenzeka kunye njengelizimeleyo. Ukuba linye liyenzeka, ithuba lelinye liba ngu-0.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s2.r.d: Uthathe i-A equlethwe kwi-D njengengabandakanyekanga. Ukuba i-A yenzeka, i-D inyanisekile, ngoko ithuba le-D liyatshintsha.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s2.explain: P(A)=1/3, P(C)=1/2, kwaye P(A∩C)=P({2})=1/6=P(A)P(C), ngoko i-A ne-C ziyazimela. I-B ne-C ziyazimela nazo, kuba B∩C={4} kwaye 1/6=1/3×1/2. Kwi-A ne-D, P(A∩D)=1/3 kodwa P(A)P(D)=1/6, ngoko aziyazimela. Iziganeko zinokuzimela nokuba ziyadibana, kwaye iziganeko ezingadibaniyo (xa amathuba azo makhulu kune-0) azinakuzimela.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.prompt: Bhala inkcazo yokuthumela kuJimin. Ngokusekelwe kwiintsingiselo yokuba i-A ne-B ziyazimela, chaza isizathu sokuba i-A ne-B aziyazimela kulo mzekelo wedayisi, usebenzisa "ithuba le-B xa sazi ukuba i-A yenzekile."
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ubhale ukuba zeziphi iziphosa ezisalayo xa wazi ukuba i-A yenzekile, uze ubone ukuba ngaba ezinye zazo zikwi-B.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala ithuba lokuqala le-B kunye nethuba ngoko ecaleni komnye kwisivakalisi esinye uze uzithelekise.

n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ubhale intsingiselo yokuzimela njenge "ukwazi isiganeko esinye akutshintshi ithuba lesinye"?
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Kulo mzekelo, ingaba uthethe zombini ithuba lokuqala le-B kunye nethuba layo emva kokufunda ukuba i-A yenzekile?
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingaba uthe "azinakwenzeka ngexesha elinye" kunye "nokuzimela" zizinto ezahlukeneyo?
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.model.0: Ukuba iziganeko ziyazimela, ithuba le-B lalisoloko li-1/3 nasemva kokuba sazi ukuba i-A yenzekile. Kodwa ukuba i-A (1 okanye 2) yenzeka, i-B (3 okanye 4) ayinakwenzeka, ngoko ithuba layo liba ngu-0. Ithuba liyatshintsha, ngoko aziyazimela.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.model.1: Ekuqaleni, ithuba le-B yinxalenye yesithathu. Kodwa ukuba sifunda ukuba idayisi ibonisa 1 okanye 2, ngoko 3 okanye 4 ayinakwenzeka, ngoko ithuba le-B litshintsha liye ku-0. Ukuba ziyazimela akufanele ukuba litshintshe, kodwa litshintshile, ngoko aziyazimela.

n-m-h3-prob-08.title: Imali Yomvuzo Yomdlalo Owaphazamisekayo: Kufuneka Wahlulwe Njani?
n-m-h3-prob-08.goal: Hlela inkcazelo efunekayo ukufumana ithuba lokuphumelela, uze usete isithuba sesampulu esinamathuba alinganayo ngokucinga ukuba umdlalo owawuza kuphela kwangoko udlalwa ukuya ekupheleni.
n-m-h3-prob-08.material: Iqela A neqela B bebedlala umdlalo apho iqela lokuqala eliphumelela imidlalo emi-3 lithatha yonke imali yomvuzo ye-80,000 won, kodwa waphazamiseka ngenxa ethile. Kude kube ngoku iqela A linoloyiso olu-2 neqela B linoloyiso olu-1. Amaqela omabini avume ukwahlula imali yomvuzo ngokulingana "nethuba lokuba iqela ngalinye liphumelele kwimidlalo eseleyo."
n-m-h3-prob-08.thinking.2: Ukucacisa ukuba kutheni ukucinga kungatshintshi siphumo
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.prompt: Iqela A neqela B bebedlala umdlalo apho iqela lokuqala eliphumelela imidlalo emi-3 lithatha yonke imali yomvuzo ye-80,000 won, kodwa waphazamiseka. Kude kube ngoku iqela A linoloyiso olu-2 neqela B linoloyiso olu-1. Imali yomvuzo iza kwahlulwa ngokulingana nethuba leqela ngalinye lokuphumelela. Khetha yonke inkcazelo eyimfuneko ngokupheleleyo ukufumana la mathuba. (Akukho nto yaziwayo ngenqanaba lobugcisa lamaqela.)
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.hint.0: Susa icandelo ngalinye lenkcazelo ngexesha, uze ucinge ukuba ingaba ithuba lokuphumelela elizayo lalinokubalwa ngaphandle kwayo.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala into oyifunayo ukuze wazi ukuba mingaphi imidlalo eyongezelelweyo ekufuneka iqela ngalinye liyiphumelele ukuze libe yinkokeli.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.o.a: Ulandelelwano lwemidlalo ephumeleleyo kude kube ngoku (nokuba ibingu-A, B, A)
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.r.a: Ucinge ukuba ulandelelwano lubalulekile. Ithuba lokuphumelela elizayo lixhomekeke kwinani loloyiso elikhoyo nakwimidlalo eseleyo; ulandelelwano apho uloyiso lwaqokelelana alunampembelelo.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.o.b: Inani loloyiso lweqela ngalinye kude kube ngoku (uloyiso olu-2 noloyiso olu-1)
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.o.c: Inani loloyiso elifunekayo ukuba yinkokeli (eyokuqala ukuphumelela imidlalo emi-3)
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.r.d: Ixesha alinasiphumo kuphumelelo nakwiziphumo zexesha elizayo. Cinga ukuba ingaba yinkcazelo echaphazela ithuba lokuphumelela.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.o.e: Ithuba lokuba iqela ngalinye liphumelele umdlalo omnye
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.explain: Amanani oloyiso akhoyo kunye noloyiso olufunekayo ukuba yinkokeli kumisela ukuba mingaphi imidlalo eyongezelelweyo ekufuneka iqela ngalinye liyiphumelele (u-A ufuna umdlalo o-1, u-B ufuna imidlalo emi-2), yaye ithuba lokuphumelela umdlalo omnye limisela ithuba lokuba oko kwenzeke. Ulandelelwano loloyiso nexesha elithathiweyo azichaphazeli imidlalo eseleyo, ngoko azifuneki.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.prompt: Cinga ukuba amaqela omabini alinganayo ekuphumeleleni umdlalo omnye yaye imidlalo ayichaphazelani. Fumana ithuba lokuba iqela A liphumelele ubuntshatsheli, uze ubhale nemali yomvuzo ekufuneka iqela A iyifumane. Faka kwisisombululo sakho ukuba zeziphi iimeko obuzibalile.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala into ekufuneka yenzeke kwimidlalo eseleyo ukuze iqela A liphumelele nokuze iqela B liphumelele.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.hint.1: Nokuba umdlalo wawuza kuphela kwangoko, cinga ukuba ukucinga ukuba yonke imidlalo eseleyo idlalwa kukuvumela ukwenza iimeko zibe nethuba elilinganayo.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba uqwalasele iimeko apho iqela A liphumelela nezo apho iqela B liphumelela ngokwahlukeneyo?
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ukhethe iimeko ukuze yonke inamathuba alinganayo?
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ngaba uyihlule imali yomvuzo usebenzisa amathuba?
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.model.0: Ukuba sicinga ukudlala yomibini imidlalo eseleyo, iziphumo ezine (A,A),(A,B),(B,A),(B,B) zinamathuba alinganayo. Ukuze u-B aphumelele, u-B kufuneka aphumelele yomibini imidlalo, oko kukuphela kwe-(B,B), ngoko u-B unika-1/4 kwaye u-A unika-3/4. Ngoko u-A kufuneka afumane i-60,000 won no-B i-20,000 won.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.model.1: Ukuze u-B aphumelele, u-B kufuneka aphumelele imidlalo emibini eseleyo ilandelelana, kwaye elo thuba ngu-1/2×1/2=1/4. Ngoko ithuba lokuba u-A aphumelele ngu-3/4, kwaye u-A kufuneka afumane i-60,000 won kwimali yomvuzo ye-80,000 won.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.prompt: U-Minji wathi, "Ukuba u-A uphumelela umdlalo olandelayo umdlalo uyaphela, ngoko akulunganga ukucinga ukudlala yomibini imidlalo eseleyo, kuba oko kwahlukile kwinto eyayiza kwenzeka ngokwenene." Siyiphi impendulo efanelekileyo ngakumbi kwisithi sika-Minji?
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.hint.0: Fumana ithuba lenye nenye kwiindlela ezintathu umdlalo wokwenene onokuphela ngazo, uze ujonge ukuba zidibana zibe ngu-1.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.hint.1: Ukuba yomibini imidlalo eseleyo idlalwa, yenza itheyibhile ebonisa ukuba ngubani oba yinkokeli kwesinye nesinye seziphumo ezine.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.o.a: Imidlalo emibini eyongezelelweyo idlalwa ngokwenene, ngoko zonke ezine eziphumo zinokwenzeka.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.r.a: Eli cacisa liphikisana nenyaniso yokuba umdlalo uphela kwangoko. Abazidlali zonke ngokwenene.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.o.b: Inani lemidlalo kude kube sekupheleni kufuneka lifane ukuze imali yomvuzo yahlulwe ngokufanelekileyo.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.r.b: Ubeke ukufaneleka kwinani lemidlalo kude kube sekupheleni. Umgangatho lithuba lokuphumelela.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.o.c: Yeyokulula nje, ngoko akuhlobo ukuba ixabiso lichanekile.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.r.c: Awuchazanga ukuba kutheni ixabiso lichanekile. Kukho isizathu sokuba kulungile ukujonga ngale ndlela.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.o.d: Imidlalo emva kokuba umdlalo sele ugqityiwe ayitshintshi iqela eliphumeleleyo, ngoko isiphumo siyafana nokuba yonke idlalwa.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.explain: Ukuba u-A uphumelela umdlalo olandelayo, u-A uyinkokeli, yaye imidlalo elandelayo ayitshintshi ophumeleleyo. Ngoko nokuba sicinga ukuba yomibini imidlalo eseleyo idlalwa, "ngubani ophumelela ubuntshatsheli" akatshintshi, yaye iziphumo ezine zonke ziba nethuba elilinganayo le-1/4, nto leyo yenza ukubala kube lula. Ukuba sithatha iindlela ezintathu umdlalo wokwenene ophela ngazo ("u-A uphumelela" ngo-1/2, "u-B uphumelela emva koko u-A uphumelele" ngo-1/4, "u-B uphumelela kabini ilandelelana" ngo-1/4) njengezinamathuba alinganayo, oko akulunganga.

n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ngenene uwahloniphile amaxabiso ezixa ezinxalenye S_1, S_2, S_3, S_4?

Ukuba sitshintsha indlela yokudibanisa ngamaqela ibe 1+(−1+1)+(−1+1)+…, inika u-1, ngoko ixabiso lixhomekeke kwindlela yokudibanisa ngamaqela. Ukuba uthotho oludityanisiweyo ngu-0 akunasiphumo kwisixa sothotho lokuqala.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.model.2: USoyoung, i-S_n yothotho lokuqala ngu-1 xa n ingumangqabangqaba kwaye ngu-0 xa n iyipheyiri, ngoko aluna mda (luyahlukana). n-m-h3-serieslim-04.topic: Uthotho: izixa zamacandelo kunye nothotho lwejiyometri olungapheliyo
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.title: Ngaba u-0.999… Mncinci Kancinci Kunga-1?
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.goal: Cacisa, usebenzisa umda wokwahlukana, ukuba umda unokuba sisixa nokuba izixa ezinxalenye azilufikeleli, uze wakhe olunye uthotho olunalo mpawu mnye.

UYuna: "0.9, 0.99, 0.999, … zihlala zimncinci kuno-1 kungakhathaliseki ukuba uya kude kangakanani, ngoko u-0.999… mncinci kuno-1." UDohyun: "0.999…=9/10+9/100+9/1000+…, olo luthotho olungapheliyo lokuphindaphinda ngokulinganayo olunelungu lokuqala 9/10 nomlinganiselo oqhelekileyo 1/10, ngoko isixa salo ngu-1."
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.thinking.0: Ukucoca ukuba ubungqina bengxelo buyawuxhasa na umgaqo wayo
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.prompt: Hlola amazwi ababini abahlobo kunye nobungqina babo, uze ukhethe isigwebo esifaneleke kakhulu.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola ngokwahlukileyo ukuba ubungqina bukaYuna bunyanisile na, nokuba isigqibo sakhe silandela na kobo bungqina.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala ukuba isixa sothotho sichazwa njani, uze uthelekise ukuba ukubala kukaDohyun kuyahambelana na nale ngcaciso.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.o.a: UDohyun unyanisile: isixa sothotho ngumda wezixa zaso ezinxalenye, kwaye izixa ezinxalenye ziya zisondela ku-1 ngokungenasiphelo

n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.o.b: Isixa asinqumanga: kuba izixa ezinxalenye ziqhubeka zitshintsha ngonaphakade kwaye ziyakwazi ukuba nexabiso elinye
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.r.b: Ubuxubile ukuqhubeka kwezixa ezinxalenye zitshintsha nokungahlangani. Nokuba ziyatshintsha, uthotho luyahlangana ukuba ziyasondela kwixabiso elinye.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.o.c: UYuna unyanisile: akukho sixa esinxalenye silingana no-1, ngoko u-0.999… wahlukile ku-1
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.r.c: Uthabathe ipropati yesixa esinxalenye ngasinye wayiphathela ngqo kumda. Umda asingomnye wezixa ezinxalenye.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.o.d: Bobabini bayanyanisa: u-0.999… mncinci kuno-1 ngomahluko omncinci ngokungenasiphelo, kodwa kwiimbalo uthathwa njengo-1
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.r.d: Uthe kusalele umahluko opozitivu kwi-1, kwaye uthe nokulingana no-1. Phakathi kwamanani okwenyani, amanani amabini afana kuphela xa umahluko wawo ungu-0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.explain: Isixa sothotho ngumda wezixa ezinxalenye S_n. Apha S_n=1−(1/10)^n kwaye umda ngu-1, ngoko 0.999…=1. Ubungqina bukaYuna bunyanisile, kodwa kwi-"zonke ii-S_n zimncinci kuno-1" akulandeli ukuba "lim S_n mncinci kuno-1" (emdeni iba ≤).
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.prompt: Ingxelo kaYuna "kungakhathaliseki ukuba udibanisa kude kangakanani n, isixa esinxalenye simncinci kuno-1" inyanisile. Kodwa isigqibo sakhe asilunganga. Cacisa isizathu usebenzisa i-1−S_n, ixabiso le-1 elinciphisiwe ngesixa esinxalenye S_n.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala i-S_1, S_2, S_3 kwaye ubhale umahluko wazo ngalunye kwi-1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.hint.1: Dibanisa indlela lo mahluko oziphatha ngayo xa n ikhula nento umda ocacisa isixa sothotho ngayo.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba udibanise ukusondela kweli xabiso ku-0 nokuba isixa singu-1?
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ngaba uthethe ukuba umda unokuba ngu-1 nokuba izixa ezinxalenye azilufikeleli u-1?
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.model.0: 1−S_n=1/10^n ihlala inkulu kuno-0, ngoko inyani ukuba S_n imncinci kuno-1. Kodwa xa n ikhula, 1/10^n isondela ku-0 ngokungenasiphelo, ngoko umda we-S_n ngu-1, kwaye ekubeni isixa sothotho ngumda lowo, 0.999…=1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.model.1: Akukho sixa esinxalenye sifikelela ku-1, kodwa 1−S_n=(1/10)^n iyahlangana ku-0. Isixa sothotho ngumda wezixa zaso ezinxalenye, ngoko ngu-1. Nokuba zonke izixa ezinxalenye zimncinci kuno-1, umda unokuba ngu-1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.model.2: Zonke ii-S_n zimncinci kuno-1, kodwa umahluko 0.00…01 uba mncinci ngokungenasiphelo xa n ikhula, ngoko umda ngu-1, kwaye ngenxa yoko 0.999…=1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.prompt: Zenzele wena uthotho olunepropati efanayo. Faka uthotho olubini olungapheliyo lokuphindaphinda ngokulinganayo a + ar + ar² + … olunelungu lokuqala a nomlinganiselo oqhelekileyo r, isixa salo singu-1 kwaye zonke izixa zalo ezinxalenye zimncinci kuno-1, usebenzisa imilinganiselo eqhelekileyo eyahlukileyo. (Ungasebenzisa iidesimali.)
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ngokubhala ukuba yeyiphi i-equation ekufuneka ibambe phakathi kwe-a ne-r ukuze isixa sibe ngu-1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.hint.1: Bala i-S_1 ne-S_2 uhlole ukuba r kufuneka ibe nawuphi umqondiso ukuze zonke izixa ezinxalenye zibe ngaphantsi kwe-1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.ok.c1: Ixabiso elipheleleyo lomlinganiselo oqhelekileyo lincinci kuno-1, ngoko uyahlangana.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.fail.c1: |r|<1 ayibambi, ngoko olu ayisosithotho esihlangeneyo esinesixa 1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.ok.c3: Onke amalungu ayipozitivu, ngoko izixa ezinxalenye zimncinci kuno-1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.fail.c3: Umlinganiselo oqhelekileyo awuyipozitivu, ngoko isixa esinxalenye sinokugqitha u-1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.explain: Ukuba a=1−r kwaye 0<r<1, isixa esinxalenye S_n=1−r^n sihlala sincinci kuno-1 kodwa umda waso ngu-1. a=0.9, r=0.1 ngqo ngu-0.999…. Ukuba r inegatifu, a=1−r>1, ngoko isixa esinxalenye sokuqala sele sigqitha u-1.

n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca wokuqala ongachanekanga kwisisombululo sikaSeojin.
n-m-h3-integc-01.title: Ungawathemba Ngaba Amaxabiso Afunyenwe Ngokudibanisa Ngeenxalenye?
n-m-h3-integc-01.topic: Ukudibanisa: iimpazamo zokudibanisa ngeenxalenye nokuhlola ngophawu lwe-integrand
n-m-h3-integc-01.goal: Fumana uze ulungise umgca wokuqala ongalunganga kwisisombululo sokudibanisa ngeenxalenye, uze uchaze indlela yokuhlola uphawu lwe-integral echanekileyo usebenzisa uphawu lwe-integrand, nemida yoko kuhlolwa.
n-m-h3-integc-01.material: U-Seojin wasombulula i-∫_0^π x sin x dx esebenzisa ukudibanisa ngeenxalenye. (∫_0^π yi-integral echanekileyo ukusuka ku-0 ukuya ku-π. [F]_0^π = F(π) − F(0).)
n-m-h3-integc-01.thinking.1: Xela uphawu lwe-integral echanekileyo ngophawu lwe-integrand
n-m-h3-integc-01.thinking.2: Phonononga uluhlu apho indlela yokuhlola isebenza khona (izithuba apho uphawu lutshintsha khona)
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.hint.0: Kumgca ngamnye onika umsebenzi osandula ukufunyanwa (u', v), hlola loo msebenzi ngemeko yokuqala.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.hint.1: Kumgca apho v ifunyanwa, yahlula v ngokwakho uhlole ukuba ilingana no-v'.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.line.0: Kwi-∫_0^π x sin x dx, vumela u=x kwaye v'=sin x.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.line.1: Emva koko u'=1 kwaye v=cos x.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.line.2: Ngefomyula yokudibanisa ngeenxalenye, ∫_0^π x sin x dx = [x cos x]_0^π − ∫_0^π 1·cos x dx.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.line.3: [x cos x]_0^π = π·cos π − 0 = −π, kwaye ∫_0^π cos x dx = [sin x]_0^π = 0.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.explain: Umgca 2 ngowokuqala ophosisayo. I-derivative ye-cos x yi-−sin x, ngoko v ene-v'=sin x yi-−cos x, hayi cos x. Ukusuka kumgca 3, v engalunganga ifakwa nje kwifomyula, ngoko ifomyula nokubala kuchanekile kodwa isiphumo asichanekanga.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.prompt: Lungisa umgca ongachanekanga uze ufumane ixabiso le-∫_0^π x sin x dx. Emva koko, usebenzisa uphawu lwe-x sin x kwi-0≤x≤π, bhala ngezivakalisi ezinye okanye ezibini ukuba kutheni i-−π kaSeojin ingenakuba lixabiso.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.hint.0: Fumana kwakhona i-v ene-v'=sin x, uyifake kwifomula yomgca wesi-3, uze ubale kwimida.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.hint.1: Jonga kwitheyibhile ukuba i-x kunye ne-sin x ngamnye uyi-0 okanye ungaphezulu kwi-0≤x≤π, uze ucinge ukuba i-integral echanekileyo yomsebenzi oyi-0 okanye ongaphezulu kwe-0 inophawu luni.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.placeholder: Umzekelo: Ukuba silungisa i-v, ..., ixabiso li-.... Kodwa i-x sin x ...
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ulungise i-v yaba yi-−cos x wayibuyisela kwifomula?
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ucaphule ukuba i-sin x iyi-0 okanye ingaphezulu kwi-0≤x≤π njengesizathu sakho?
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ngaba uyidibanisile ipropathi yokuba ukuba into ebalwayo iyi-0 okanye ingaphezulu kwe-0, i-integral echanekileyo nayo iyi-0 okanye ingaphezulu kwe-0?
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.model.0: Ukuba i-v'=sin x, ngoko i-v=−cos x. [−x cos x]_0^π + ∫_0^π cos x dx = π + 0 = π. Kwi-0≤x≤π, i-x≥0 kwaye i-sin x≥0, ngoko i-x sin x≥0, nto leyo ithetha ukuba i-integral echanekileyo ayinakuba negative (−π).
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.model.1: Ukuba ulungisa i-v yaba yi-−cos x, ixabiso li-π. Kwixesha lokuba i-x sin x ihlala iyi-0 okanye ingaphezulu, ngoko njengendawo ayinakuphuma ingaphantsi kwe-0, kwaye i-−π inegative, nto leyo ichasene nenyaniso.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.prompt: Ngoku kusetyenziswa umsebenzi omnye, kodwa ixesha lishintshiwe laba yi-[0,2π]. Khetha ingxelo echanekileyo malunga nendlela yokukhangela uphawu lwe-integral echanekileyo usebenzisa uphawu lwento ebalwayo.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.hint.0: Jonga uphawu lwe-sin x kwi-[π,2π] uze ucinge ngokubonakala kwegrafu ye-x sin x.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.hint.1: Xa kukho amalungu apozithivu kunye nanegethivu, cinga ukuba uphawu lwesixa luxhomekeke kwintoni.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.o.a: I-x sin x iyi-0 okanye ingaphezulu kwi-[0,2π], ngoko ixabiso kufuneka libe pozithivu nalo.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.r.a: Jonga uphawu lwe-sin x kwi-[π,2π]. Awuzange ujonge ukuba ingaba uphawu luhlala lunjalo na xa ixesha lishintsha.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.o.b: Nokuba uphawu luyashintsha, inxalenye epozithivu iza kuqala, ngoko ixabiso lihlala lipozithivu.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.r.b: Ujonge ulandelelwano kuphela ungaqhathanisanga ubungakanani benxalenye epozithivu neyenegethivu. Inxalenye enegethivu inokuba nkulu ngakumbi.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.o.c: Uphawu lwe-x sin x luyashintsha ngaphakathi kwexesha, ngoko uphawu lodwa alunakumisela uphawu lwexabiso.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.r.c: Uqaphele ukuba ukukhangela uphawu sisixhobo esinokusetyenziswa kwixesha apho uphawu lunolunye uhlobo kuphela.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.o.d: Nokuba ixesha lingandiswa, inxalenye eyongeziweyo iyaphelisana, ngoko ixabiso li-π, ufana nakwi-[0,π].
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.r.d: Ucinge ukuba ixesha elongeziweyo [π,2π] liza kuphelisana ungayijongi i-integral yalo ngqo.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.explain: Kwi-[π,2π], i-sin x≤0, ngoko i-x sin x≤0. Ngoko uphawu aluhlobo lunye kuyo yonke into, kwaye inxalenye epozithivu neyenegethivu ziyadibana. Enyanisweni, [−x cos x + sin x]_0^{2π} = −2π, enegethivu. Ukukhangela uphawu kukuxelela uphawu lwexabiso kuphela xa uphawu lungashintshi ngaphakathi kwexesha.

n-m-h3-integc-08.title: Indawo Yommandla Ofanayo: Abantu Ababini, Izisombululo Ezimbini Ezahlukeneyo
n-m-h3-integc-08.topic: Ukudibanisa: indawo — ukudibanisa ngokwe-x nangokwe-y (ukutshintsha ukumelwa)
n-m-h3-integc-08.goal: Chaza, usebenzisa umlo wommandla, isizathu sokuba ukudibanisa ngokwe-x nokudibanisa ngokwe-y kunike indawo efanayo yommandla ofanayo, uze unqumele iimeko apho indlela yesibini inokusetyenziswa khona.
n-m-h3-integc-08.material: Abantu ababini bafumana indawo yommandla R ovalelwe lijika y=ln x, i-eksisi ye-x, nomgca x=e besebenzisa iindlela ezahlukeneyo. UJian wasombulula ∫_1^e ln x dx ngokudibanisa ngamacandelo wafumana [x ln x − x]_1^e = (e−e)−(0−1) = 1. USoyul wasusa ∫_0^1 eʸ dy = e−1 kwindawo e yestandi 0≤x≤e, 0≤y≤1, wafumana e−(e−1)=1. (∫_1^e yi-integral echanekileyo isuka ku-1 ukuya ku-e.)
n-m-h3-integc-08.thinking.1: Jonga ngomfanekiso ukuba ngummandla onjani osuswayo
n-m-h3-integc-08.thinking.2: Nqumela iimeko apho indlela isebenza khona (ukuhambelana kwenye ngenye)
n-m-h3-integc-08.prereq.1: Imisebenzi ephikisayo nee-integral ezichanekileyo zemisebenzi yelogarithim nesikhuphi
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.prompt: Kumfanekiso, yeyiphi inxalenye endawo yayo i-∫_0^1 eʸ dy ekhutshwa nguSoyul kwi-e?
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.hint.0: Thatha ubude y, zoba umgca omnye othe tye kuwo wonke inxande, uze ufumane ichaphaza apho ijika lisika loo mgca.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.hint.1: Kuloo mgca, yitsho ukuba ngasiphi isiphelo sejika, ekhohlo okanye ekunene, apho kukho R.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.o.a: Ummandla R ngokwawo, esifuna ukufumana indawo yawo
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.r.a: Indawo ye-R lixabiso elifunyanwa ngokususa le ntetho kwi-e. Ukuba i-R yayifana nommandla wale ntetho, kwakungayi kufuneka kususwe kwi-e.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.r.b: Ubonile ukuba yinxalenye ekhohlo yejika x=eʸ, oko kukuthi, inxalenye yenxande engeyiyo i-R.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.o.c: Inxalenye engaphantsi kwejika y=ln x ene-1≤x≤e
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.r.c: Loo nxalenye yiyo ngqo i-R. USoyul akasusi i-R kwi-e; ususa inxalenye esalayo.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.o.d: Inxalenye phakathi kwe-eksisi ye-x nejika ene-0<x<1
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.r.d: Kwi-0<x<1 ijika lingaphantsi kwe-eksisi ye-x, ngoko alikho kwi-R, kwaye alinanto yakwenza nale ntetho.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.explain: Indawo yenxande 0≤x≤e, 0≤y≤1 yi-e. Kubude ngabunye y, ichaphaza elikwijika yi-x=eʸ, ngoko ububanzi benxalenye ekhohlo yayo yi-eʸ, kwaye indawo yayo yi-∫_0^1 eʸ dy = e−1. I-R yinxalenye esekunene kwejika, ngoko indawo yayo yi-e−(e−1)=1.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.prompt: Ulandela indlela kaSoyul, fumana indawo yommandla ovalelwe yi-y=ln x, i-eksisi ye-x, nomgca x=e². Bonisa ububanzi nobude benxande kunye ne-integral echanekileyo oyisusayo, uze ubhale umphumo.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.hint.0: Fumana ubude bejika ku-x=e², y=ln e², ukumisela ubude benxande.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.hint.1: Kubude ngabunye y, bonisa u-x wejika ngokwe-y, uze udibanise loo ntetho ukusuka ku-0 ukuya kubude benxande.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.placeholder: umz. Inxande ibanzi ngo-..., ubude ..., kwaye ...
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingaba uqinisekise ukuba ubude benxande yi-ln e²=2?
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ufumene i-∫_0^2 eʸ dy = e²−1?
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingaba ujonge ukuba ihambelana nexabiso elifunyenwe ngokudibanisa ngamacandelo?
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.model.0: Inxande ibanzi nge-e² kwaye ubude yi-ln e²=2, ngoko indawo yayo yi-2e². Inxalenye ekhohlo yejika yi-∫_0^2 eʸ dy = e²−1. Ngoko indawo ye-R yi-2e² − (e²−1) = e²+1.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.model.1: Nge-x=e², i-y isuka ku-0 ukuya ku-2, ngoko indawo yenxande yi-2e² kwaye inxalenye ekhutshwayo yi-∫_0^2 e^y dy=e²−1. Indawo yi-2e²−e²+1=e²+1.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.prompt: Indlela kaSoyul inokusetyenziswa "xa ijika lingabhalwa njengentetho enye yohlobo x=h(y)." Khetha onke amajika angezantsi anokubhalwa ngaloo ndlela kwixesha elinikiweyo.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.hint.0: Kwijika ngalinye, thatha ixabiso elinye le-y uze ubale ukuba ngaphi u-x kwixesha onelo xabiso le-y.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.hint.1: Jonga ukuba igrafu ixhuma ngaphezulu naphantsi ngaphakathi kwexesha (okanye ikhula kuphela).
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.r.a: Ixabiso ngalinye le-y lihambelana namaxabiso amabini e-x (x no−x). Ayinakubhalwa njengentetho enye yohlobo x=h(y).
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.r.b: Ubonile ukuba i-y nganye ihambelana ne-x enye kuphela (x=ln y), ngoko inokubhalwa njengentetho enye yohlobo x=h(y).
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.r.c: Ixabiso ngalinye le-y lihambelana namaxabiso amabini e-x (x no-π−x). Ayinakubhalwa njengentetho enye yohlobo x=h(y).
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.r.d: Ubonile ukuba i-y nganye ihambelana ne-x enye kuphela (x= ingcambu yekhyubhu ye-y), ngoko inokubhalwa njengentetho enye yohlobo x=h(y).
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.explain: I-y=eˣ (0≤x≤1) kunye ne-y=x³ (−1≤x≤1) ziyanda kumaxesha azo, ngoko i-y nganye ihambelana ne-x enye (zinemisebenzi ephikisayo). Kwi-y=x² okanye i-y=sin x, kukho ii-x ezimbini kwi-y enye, ngoko njengoko zinjalo azinakuba yintetho enye x=h(y), kwaye ixesha kufuneka lahlulwe.

n-m-h3-vec-04.title: I-Engile Phakathi Kwemigca Emibini Ifana Ne-Engile Phakathi Kweevektha Zecala Zayo?
n-m-h3-vec-04.goal: Qonda umahluko phakathi kwe-engile phakathi kweevektha zecala ne-engile phakathi kwemigca ngokuhlaziya isigwebo sakho njengoko ulwazi longezwa, uze usebenzise ifomula elungileyo ye-engile phakathi kwemigca.
n-m-h3-vec-04.material: Ufuna ukufumana i-engile θ phakathi kwemigca emibini l no-m kwiplani yolungelelwaniso. Ulwazi luvezwa icandelo elinye ngexesha. (u·v ifundwa "u dot v," |u| bubukhulu be-u, kwaye √5 ifundwa "root 5.")
n-m-h3-vec-04.thinking.0: Ukuhlaziya isigwebo xa kuvela ulwazi olutsha
n-m-h3-vec-04.thinking.1: Ukukhangela ukuba ixabiso lifanayo na nokuba ivektha yecala ikhethwe ngendlela eyahlukileyo
n-m-h3-vec-04.thinking.2: Ukucacisa isizathu sokuba ixabiso elipheleleyo lifuneka
n-m-h3-vec-04.prereq.0: Imveliso ye-dot yeevektha zeplani kunye ne-engile phakathi kwazo
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.prompt: Ulwazi luvezwa icandelo elinye ngexesha. Kwinyathelo ngalinye, khetha isigwebo usebenzisa kuphela oko ukwaziyo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.hint.0: Ngalo lonke ixesha kuvela ulwazi olutsha, khangela ukuba isigwebo sangaphambili sisasebenza na.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.hint.1: Kumgca ofanayo, khetha ivektha yecala eliphikisana, wenze ikhompyutha efanayo, uze uthelekise iziphumo.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Ukhethe u=(1, 2) njengevektha yecala lomgca l kunye no-v=(1, −3) njengevektha yecala lomgca m. Ukubala kunika u·v=−5, |u|=√5, |v|=√10.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Uyigweba njani i-engile θ phakathi kwemigca emibini?
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.after: I-engile phakathi ko-u no-v ine-cos = −1/√2, oko kukuthi 135°. Kodwa akukaqinisekiswa ukuba eli xabiso lingathathwa njenge-engile phakathi kwemigca emibini.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Uyiguqulele ngqo i-engile phakathi kweevektha ezimbini kwi-engile phakathi kwemigca. Esi sesona sigwebo siqala ukuza engqondweni.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Kufuneka sikhangele ngakumbi ukuba eli xabiso liyichaza ngokwenene i-engile phakathi kwemigca na, nokuba lifanayo na ukuba iivektha zecala zikhethwe ngendlela eyahlukileyo
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ukhumbule ukuba ivektha yecala ayiyonto ilinganayo emiselweyo kumgca ngamnye.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ekubeni imveliso yamachaphaza inegathivu, singathi kuphela imigca emibini ayime nkqo
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Uthe kuphela ayime nkqo. Awuyimisanga ubungakanani be-engile.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Nokuba uthatha −v=(−1, 3) njengevektha yecala lomgca m endaweni ye-v, usamgca m ofanayo.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Yiyiphi i-engile phakathi kwe-u kunye ne-−v, kwaye oku sixelela ntoni ngee-engile θ phakathi kwemigca?
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.after: I-engile phakathi kwe-u kunye ne-v yi-135°, kwaye i-engile phakathi kwe-u kunye ne-−v yi-45°. Nakwimigca emibini efanayo, ixabiso litshintsha ngokuxhomekeke kwindlela ivektha yecala ekhethwa ngayo. Xa imigca emibini idibana, kwenziwa ii-engile ze-45° kunye ne-135°, ngoko sifuna isivumelwano sokuba yeyiphi ekufuneka ibizwe ngokuba yi-engile phakathi kwemigca.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: u·(−v)=5 kwaye cos=1/√2, ngoko yi-45°. Kwimigca efanayo, kuphuma ii-engile ezimbini, i-135° kunye ne-45°, ngoko imveliso yamachaphaza enophawu yodwa ayimiseli i-engile phakathi kwemigca
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Uyijongile ngqo into yokuba ixabiso litshintsha ngokuxhomekeke kwindlela ivektha yecala ekhethwa ngayo
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Ukufumana i-45° yimpazamo yokubala, kwaye i-135° ichanekile
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ukutshintshela ku-−v kujika uphawu lwemveliso yamachaphaza, ngoko cos iba +1/√2; le asiyompazamo.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: u·(−v)=5 kwaye i-engile yi-45°, ngoko i-135° yangaphambili yayiphosakele kwaye i-engile phakathi kwemigca yi-45°
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ubunyanisile ukuba i-45° iyaphuma, kodwa uphoswe kukuba zombini i-135° kunye ne-45° zivela kwimigca emibini efanayo. Sifuna isivumelwano sokuba yeyiphi ekufuneka ithathwe njengo-engile phakathi kwemigca.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Siyavumelana ukuba i-engile θ phakathi kwemigca emibini yileyo ingeyiyo enkulu phakathi kweentlobo ezimbini zee-engile ezenziwa apho idibana khona (i-45° kunye ne-135°), oko kukuthi, leyo ene-0°<θ≤90°.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Yeyiphi ifomula esoloko inika θ nokuba iivektha zecala zikhethwa njani?
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.2.after: |u·v|=5, ngoko cosθ=5/(√5·√10)=1/√2 kwaye θ=45°. I-engile phakathi kwemigca kufuneka ifunyanwe ngefomula ethatha ixabiso eliphelele lemveliso yamachaphaza, ukuze ixabiso elifanayo liphume nokuba iivektha zecala zikhethwa njani.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Uphawu lutshintsha ngokuxhomekeke kukhetho lwevektha yecala, ngoko lunokungahambelani nesivumelwano sokuba θ iphakathi kwe-0° kunye ne-90°.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ukusebenzisa ixabiso eliphelele lemveliso yamachaphaza kunika ixabiso elifanayo nokuba ivektha yecala iguqulwa, kwaye cosθ≥0, ngoko θ ibuncinane ngu-90°.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Oku kuchanekile kuphela xa kusetyenziswa i-−v; ukuba ikhethwe ngenye indlela uphawu luyahluka, ngoko asiyifomula esoloko ichanekile.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni udlulisele ngqo i-engile phakathi kweevektha zecala kwi-engile phakathi kwemigca, kodwa isigqibo sakho satshintsha xa kongezwa ulwazi lokuba nomgca ofanayo unamavektha ecala amabini aphikisanayo. I-engile phakathi kwemigca kufuneka ibe linani elingatshintshi ngophawu lwevektha yecala, ngoko siyifumana ngokuthatha ixabiso eliphelele lemveliso yamachaphaza.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.prompt: Ivektha yecala lomgca p yi-(2, 1) kwaye ivektha yecala lomgca q yi-(1, −3). Fumana ixabiso le-cosθ yee-engile θ phakathi kwemigca emibini, uze ubhale ngesivakalisi esinye isizathu sokuba ifomula ifuna ixabiso eliphelele.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.hint.0: Fumana ixabiso lemveliso yamachaphaza kunye nobungakanani bevektha ezimbini, uze uzifake kwifomula.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.hint.1: Yenza ukubala okufanayo nge-(−1, 3), ukuphambana kwevektha yecala (1, −3), uze uthelekise iziphumo.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.placeholder: umz., cosθ = ... Ixabiso eliphelele lifuneka kuba ...
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ubale ixabiso le-u·v kunye nobungakanani bevektha ezimbini?
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingaba uthelekise ukuba yiyiphi i-engile ephumayo ukuba usebenzisa imveliso yamachaphaza njengoko injalo xa inegathivu?
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingaba udibanise isizathu sexabiso eliphelele ne-"ndlela ivektha yecala ekhethwa ngayo"?
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.model.0: (2, 1)·(1, −3) = −1 kwaye ubungakanani busi-√5 kunye ne-√10, ngoko cosθ = |−1|/(√5·√10) = 1/(5√2) ≈ 0.14. Ukuba siguqula ivektha yecala, uphawu lwemveliso yamachaphaza luyatshintsha, ngoko sifuna ixabiso eliphelele ukuze i-engile phakathi kwemigca imiselwe ngokuthe gabalala.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.model.1: Imveliso yamachaphaza yi-−1 kwaye |p|=√5, |q|=√10, ngoko cosθ=1/√50=√2/10. Sisebenzisa ixabiso eliphelele kuba savumelana ukuba i-engile phakathi kwemigca emibini ibuncinane ngu-90°, kwaye sifuna ixabiso elifanayo nokuba iivektha zecala zikhethwa njani.

n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.line.0: Isixa sothotho ngu-lim S_n, kwaye xa n ≥ 2, a_n = S_n − S_(n−1).
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.line.2: Ngokucinga ukuba le fomula inokusetyenziswa nakwi-n=1, misela a_n = 3·(1/2)^(n−1) kuzo zonke ii-n.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.line.3: Olu luthotho olungapheliyo lokuphindaphinda ngokulinganayo olunelungu lokuqala u-3 nomlinganiselo oqhelekileyo 1/2, ngoko isixa ngu-3/(1−1/2) = 6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.explain: Ngumgca 3. I-S_n−S_(n−1) inokusetyenziswa kuphela xa n≥2, ngoko ukuba ifomula efunyenweyo isebenza nakwi-n=1 kufuneka kuhlolwe ngokwahlukileyo. n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.hint.0: Fumana umda we-S_n ngokuthe ngqo kwaye uwuthelekise nexabiso elifunyenwe nguMinjae.

n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.prompt: Kwiyo nganye ye-S_n engezantsi, khetha leyo ifomula yelungu elilinganayo efunyenwe xa n≥2 isebenza ngendlela enjalo nakwi-n=1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.hint.0: Kwifomula nganye, fumana i-S_1 uyithelekise nexabiso olifumanayo ngokufaka n=1 kwifomula efunyenwe kwi-S_n−S_(n−1).
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.hint.1: Kwifomula nganye, faka amaxabiso ahlukeneyo e-n kwi-S_n uthelekise, uze ujonge into eqhelekileyo phakathi kweefomula apho i-S_1 ebaliweyo ilingana nexabiso lefomula ye-a_1.

n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.r.c: a_1=S_1=3, kwaye ukufaka n=1 kwifomula 3·(1/2)^(n−1) yakwi-n≥2 kunika nako u-3, ngoko iyahambelana.

n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.explain: Ukuba ukufaka n=0 kwifomula ye-S_n kunika S_0=0 (c: 6−6=0), ifomula isebenza nakwi-n=1. Kwezinye, i-S_0 ngu-−2, −1, 2 ngokulandelelana, ngoko a_1 kufuneka ifunyanwe ngokwahlukileyo.

n-m-h3-serieslim-05.topic: Uthotho: izixa zamacandelo kunye nothotho lwejiyometri olungapheliyo
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.prompt: Kwinqanaba ngalinye, khetha uvavanyo usebenzisa kuphela oko usele ukwazi.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.title: Xa x Ingu-0, Ingaba Isixa Sothotho Sinikwa Yifomula Efanayo?
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.goal: Kuthotho lokuphindaphinda ngokulinganayo umlinganiselo waso oqhelekileyo otshintsha ngo-x, hlola uluhlu apho ifomula yesixa isebenza khona, uze ucacise ukuba ukubala ngokwahlukileyo xa x=0 kubonisa ukuba isixa siyahluka kweso sithuba.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.material: Kwinani lokwenyani x, vumela f(x)=x²+x²/(1+x²)+x²/(1+x²)²+x²/(1+x²)³+…. (Luthotho olunelungu lokuqala x² apho ilungu ngalinye elilandelayo liphindaphindwa ngo-1/(1+x²).) Ulwazi lutyhilwa ngecandelo elinye ngexesha.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.thinking.0: Ukuhlaziya isigwebo sakho njengoko ulwazi lwanda
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.hint.0: Ngalo lonke ixesha kuvela ulwazi olutsha, hlola kwakhona ukuba ifomula oyisebenzise ngaphambili isasebenza injalo na.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.hint.1: Faka x=0 ngokuthe ngqo uze ubhale ukuba ngawaphi amalungu ambalwa okuqala.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ucinga ukuba f(x) yifomula enjani kuwo onke amanani okwenyani x?
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.after: x²/(1−1/(1+x²))=1+x² yifomula efunyenwe emva kokucima. Khumbula ukuba kukho x apho x² ecinyiweyo ingu-0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.o.a: f(x)=1+x²: kuba onke amaxabiso amabini ahambelana ne-1+x²
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wolule ifomula ehambelana namachaphaza amabini kuwo onke ama-x. Esi sisigwebo sokuqala esiza engqondweni.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: f(x)=1+x², kodwa x apho umlinganiselo oqhelekileyo ungaqhelekanga kufuneka uhlolwe ngokwahlukileyo
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uyathandabuza ukuba iziphumo zamachaphaza amabini ziyasebenza na kuwo onke ama-x.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.o.c: f(x)=x²+1/x²: kuba enye ifomula inokuhambelana namaxabiso amabini
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Xa x=1 inika u-2 kwaye xa x=2 inika u-4.25, ngoko ayihambelani nelinye lamaxabiso amabini. Awuyifakanga ifomula ukuze uyihlole.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.info: Ngoku cinga ngemeko ka-x=0. Faka x=0 ngokuthe ngqo kwifomula echazayo ye-f.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.after: f(0)=0. Nokuba umlinganiselo oqhelekileyo ngu-1, ukuba ilungu lokuqala ngu-0 ngoko zonke izixa ezinxalenye zingu-0, ngoko luyahlangana ku-0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Usebenzise ifomyula efunyenwe kwa-x≠0 kwa-x=0 njengoko injalo.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.o.b: 0: kuba onke amalungu angu-0, ngoko zonke izixa ezithile zingu-0
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Uqale kwinkcazo wabala izixa ezithile ngqo.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ayimiselwanga: kuba umlinganiselo oqhelekileyo ngu-1, ngoko iyahlukana
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ucinge ukuba umlinganiselo oqhelekileyo ongu-1 uhlala uhlukana. Uphosise imeko apho ilungu lokuqala li-0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.info: Ukushwankathela, f(x)=1+x² ukuba x≠0, kwaye f(0)=0 ukuba x=0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Sesiphi isibakala esichanekileyo malunga nomda we-f(x) njengoko x→0 nokuqhubeka kwa-x=0?
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Ilungu ngalinye liqhubekile, kodwa isixa f siyaphuka kwa-x=0. Kwisixa esingenasiphelo, "ukuba ilungu ngalinye liqhubekile, isixa siqhubekile" akuhlali kusebenza.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Umda yi-1 kwaye f(0)=0, ngoko f ayiqhubekanga kwa-x=0
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ugwebe ukuqhubeka ngokuthelekisa ixabiso lomda nexabiso lomsebenzi.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ilungu ngalinye ngumsebenzi oqhubekayo, ngoko isixa f siqhubekile kuzo zonke x
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Usebenzise ipropati esebenza kwizixa eziphelele kwisixa esingenasiphelo njengoko injalo.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Umda no-f(0) zombini zingu-0, ngoko f iqhubekile kwa-x=0
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Awuhlolanga ukuba ifomyula 1+x² yokungu-x≠0 iya phi njengoko x→0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni ufuna ukusebenzisa ifomyula elingana namachaphaza amabini kuzo zonke x, kodwa isigwebo sakho satshintsha xa uhlola imeko x²≠0 esetyenziswe ekucinyweni. Xa usebenzisa ifomyula, kufuneka uvavanye ngqo kwixabiso lomda ukuba iimeko apho ifomyula isebenza khona ziyasebenza kule meko.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.prompt: Ilungu ngalinye x²/(1+x²)^n ngumsebenzi oqhubekayo ka-x. Bhala ukuba f(0) yintoni kwa-x=0, nokuba ihluke njani kwifomyula 1+x² yokungu-x≠0, unika isizathu.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.hint.0: Faka x=0 ngqo kwifomyula echaza f ubhale amalungu ambalwa okuqala.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.hint.1: Xa usebenzisa ifomyula yesixa yothotho lokuphindaphinda ngokulinganayo, hlola ukuba likho na ixesha apho umahluli uba ngu-0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ufake ngokwenene x=0 wabhala amalungu ambalwa okuqala?
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ucinge ukuba ifomyula efunyenwe kwa-x≠0 inokusetyenziswa kwa-x=0?
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ngaba uthe nokuba ilungu ngalinye liqhubekile, isixa sisenokungaqhubeki?
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.model.0: Ukuba x=0, ilungu ngalinye li-0²/1^n=0, ngoko f(0)=0. Kodwa ukuba x≠0, f(x)=1+x², ngoko kufuphi no-x=0 amaxabiso ayo asondele kwi-1. Ngoko umda we-1 wahlukile kwi-f(0)=0, kwaye f ayiqhubekanga kwa-x=0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.model.1: Ukufaka x=0 kunika umlinganiselo oqhelekileyo we-1, kodwa onke amalungu ukusuka kwelokuqala angu-0, ngoko isixa singu-0. Oku kwahlukile kwi-1, ofumana xa ufaka u-0 kwi-1+x², kwaye f iyaphuka kwa-x=0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.model.2: Ifomyula 1+x² isetyenziswa kuphela kwa-x≠0. Ukuba x=0, onke amalungu angu-0 ngoko isixa singu-0, kwaye oko kwahlukile kwi-1+0²=1, ngoko umsebenzi awuxhunyiwe kuloo ndawo.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.model.3: Ukuba x=0, umlinganiselo oqhelekileyo uba yi-1 ngoko ifomyula ayinakusetyenziswa, kwaye onke amalungu angu-0, ngoko f(0)=0. Oko kwahlukile kwi-1, ofumana xa ufaka u-0 kwi-1+x².

n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.ok.c1: Ixabiso elipheleleyo lomlinganiselo oqhelekileyo lincinci kuno-1, ngoko uyahlangana.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.title: Uthotho Lokuphindaphinda Ngokulinganayo Olungenasiphelo Ilungu Layo Lokuqala Likhulu Kunesixa Sayo

n-m-h3-serieslim-06.material: Masithi uthotho lokuphindaphinda ngokulinganayo olungenasiphelo a + ar + ar² + … olunelungu lokuqala a nomlinganiselo oqhelekileyo r lunesixa 6. Kulula ukucinga, "Isixa si-6, ngoko ilungu lokuqala kufuneka libe lincinci kune-6."

n-m-h3-serieslim-06.prereq.0: Isixa sothotho lokuphindaphinda ngokulinganayo olungenasiphelo a/(1−r)
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.prompt: Yenza uthotho lokuphindaphinda ngokulinganayo olungenasiphelo olunesixa 6 nelungu lokuqala a elikhulu kune-6, uze ukhethe n (inani lemvelo elisuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-9) apho isixa esithile S_n sothotho olo sikhulu kune-6. Ngenisa a, r, n. Yenza ezintathu ezinee-(r, n) ezahlukeneyo. (S_n sisixa ukusuka kwilungu lokuqala ukuya kwilungu lesi-n.)
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.hint.0: Kuqala bhala ukuba yeyiphi ikhweshini esebenza phakathi kuka-a no-r ukuze isixa sibe ngu-6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.hint.1: Emva kokukhetha r kuloo khweshini, hlola ukuba a likhulu kune-6 na, kwaye ukuba akunjalo, tshintsha uphawu okanye ubungakanani be-r.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.hint.2: Nge-r oyikhethileyo, bala S_1, S_2, S_3 ngqo uze ukhethe n apho likhulu kune-6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.fail.c1: |r|<1 ayisebenzi, ngoko olu thotho aluneso sixa.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.fail.c4: Kule n, S_n alikhulu kune-6. Bala S_1, S_2, S_3 ngqo uzithelekise ne-6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.explain: Kuba a=6(1−r), a>6 ifuna r<0. Emva koko S_n=6(1−r^n), ngoko ukuze S_n libe likhulu kune-6 sidinga r^n<0, oko kukuthi, n kufuneka ibe yingumangqabangqaba. Umzekelo, ukuba a=9 kunye ne-r=−1/2, ngoko S_1=9 kunye ne-S_3=6(1+1/8)=6.75 zikhulu kune-6, kwaye S_2=4.5 incinci. r=−1 ayivumelekanga kuba |r|<1 iyasilela, kwaye a=8, r=−1/2 inesixa 8/1.5≈5.33.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.prompt: Khetha yonke into ekufuneka ibe nyaniso kuthotho lokuphindaphinda ngokulinganayo olungenasiphelo olunesixa 6 nelungu lokuqala elikhulu kune-6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.hint.0: Cwangcisa kwitheyibhile oko imizekelo oyenze kwinyathelo elidlulileyo ifana ngako.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.hint.1: Bala S_1, S_2, S_3 kwimizekelo yakho uthelekise ukuba nganye inkulu okanye incinci kune-6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.r.a: S_1 inkulu kune-6, kodwa ilungu lesibini lithabatha, ngoko S_2 iba ncinci kune-S_1. Kumzekelo a=9, r=−1/2, S_2=4.5.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.o.b: Onke amalungu abonakalisa ngokongeza kwaye aqhubeka encipha

n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.r.c: Umlinganiselo oqhelekileyo uthabatha kwaye ilungu lokuqala libonakalisa ngokongeza, ngoko ilungu lesibini ar lithabatha.

n-m-h3-serieslim-07.goal: Hlela indibaniselwano apho ukuhlangana kwe-Σ(a_n+b_n) kumiselwa kukuba i-Σa_n ne-Σb_n ziyahlangana na nezo ungamiselwanga kuzo, uze wakhe umzekelo ochasayo.

n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.r.b: Ukuba a_n=b_n=1 iyahlukana, kodwa ukuba a_n=1, b_n=−1 uthotho lwesixa luyahlangana, ngoko akumiselwanga.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.r.c: Ukuthabatha i-Σa_n ehlangeneyo kushiya i-Σb_n, ngoko ukuba uthotho lwesixa lwaluhlangene, i-Σb_n ibiya kufuneka ihlangane nayo; ngoko uthotho lwesixa luyahlukana.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.o.d: a_n no-b_n zombini ziyahlangana ukuya ku-0
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.r.d: Ukuba a_n=b_n=1/n uthotho lwesixa luyahlukana, kwaye ukuba a_n=1/n², b_n=1/n² luyahlangana. Akumiselwanga.

n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.prompt: Bonisa imeko apho ulwazi lungonelanga. Vumela a_n=p·r^n, b_n=q·r^n (p≠0, q≠0, |r|≥1); emva koko Σa_n kunye ne-Σb_n zombini ziyahlukana. Ngenisa p, q, r kabini, ngee-r ezahlukeneyo, ukuze Σ(a_n+b_n) ihlangane.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala a_n+b_n edityaniswe ngokwe-r^n, uze ucinge ukuba ikoyifishenti kufuneka ibe yintoni ukuze olo thotho luhlangane.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.hint.1: Fumana indlela yokwenza ikoyifishenti ibe ngu-0 ngelixa ugcina imeko yokuba nanye ka-p okanye ka-q ayingo-0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.ok.c1: Amalungu aqhelekileyo e-Σa_n kunye ne-Σb_n angengo-0, ngoko nganye iyahlukana.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.fail.c1: p okanye q ingu-0, ngoko olo thotho aluhlukani.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.ok.c2: |r|≥1, ngoko ilungu eliqhelekileyo alisondeli kwi-0, kwaye nganye iyahlukana.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.fail.c3: (p+q)r^n ayingo-0, ngoko uthotho lwesixa luyahlukana nalo.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.explain: Kuba a_n+b_n=(p+q)r^n, ukuba p+q=0 onke amalungu angu-0, ngoko uthotho lwesixa luyahlangana ukuya ku-0. n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s3.prompt: Chaza ukuba kutheni ingxelo "ukuba Σa_n kunye ne-Σb_n zombini ziyahlukana, ngoko Σ(a_n+b_n) iyahlukana nayo" ingalunganga. Sebenzisa umzekelo wenyathelo elidlulileyo, uze ubhale nemeko efunekayo xa kwahlulwa uthotho lwezixa lube sisixa sothotho olubini.

n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ngaba uthe kunokwenzeka ntoni xa uthotho olubini oluhlukeneyo ludityaniswa?
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s3.model.0: Nokuba zombini ziyahlukana, njenge-Σa_n ene-p·r^n kunye ne-Σb_n ene-−p·r^n, ukuzidibanisa kwenza ilungu ngalinye libe ngu-0, ngoko luyahlangana.
