n-m-h3-est-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingaba ukudibanisile nesizathu sokuba i-B ithenjwa (ithuba elifanayo)?
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s2.model.0: Uvavanyo lwewebhusayithi lubandakanya kuphela abafundi abaphendula ngokwabo, ngoko abafundi abathile, abafana nabo banomdla kakhulu ekufundeni, banokuba baninzi kakhulu. Oku kuthambekela kuhlala kunjalo nokuba baphendula abangama-900 okanye abangama-9000, ngoko kunzima ukukuthemba nangona isampulu inkulu.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s2.model.1: A yisampulu eyenziwe kuphela ngabantu abaphendule ngokuzithandela, ngoko ayimeli bonke abafundi. Nokuba bangaphi kwisampulu, ukuba indlela yokukhetha ithambekele kwicala elinye, umndilili uhlala ungekho kumndilili wenani labemi.

n-m-h3-conic-01.title: Ukuhlola isisombululo malunga nendawo kanxantathu PF₁F₂
n-m-h3-conic-01.topic: Izahlulo zekhonikhi: iinkcazo nemigca ethintelayo yeparabola, ye-ellipse, neye-hyperbola; ukuhambelana phakathi kweemo neekhweshini
n-m-h3-conic-01.goal: Qonda ukuba nokuba isisombululo esinokubala konke kuchanekile sinokwenza isigqibo singabi nantsingiselo ukuba awuhloli ukuba imeko yengxaki inokusebenza ngokwenene, uze ufumane uluhlu apho imeko isebenza khona.
n-m-h3-conic-01.material: Incwadi yemisebenzi inale ngxaki nempendulo: "Vumela i-F₁ kunye ne-F₂ ibe ziifokasi ezimbini ze-ellipse x²/25 + y²/16 = 1. Kwichaphaza P kwi-ellipse ene-∠F₁PF₂ = 90°, fumana indawo kanxantathu PF₁F₂. (Impendulo: 16)" Ngezantsi sisisombululo esifumana le mpendulo.
n-m-h3-conic-01.thinking.0: Wahlula ukuba umgca ngamnye wesisombululo kukubala okanye kukwamkela imeko
n-m-h3-conic-01.thinking.1: Vavanya ukuba imeko enikiweyo inokusebenza ngokwenene ngokuzama indawo egqithisileyo
n-m-h3-conic-01.thinking.2: Fumana uluhlu lweparameter apho imeko isebenza khona
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.prompt: Umgca ngamnye wesisombululo esingezantsi uchanekile njengokubala. Kodwa impendulo 16 yale ngxaki inzima ukuyikholelwa. Khetha umgca wokuqala owenza impendulo ibe nzima ukuyikholelwa.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.hint.0: Wahlula ukuba umgca ngamnye uvela kumgca ongaphambili ngokubala okanye wamkela nje imeko ethathwe engxakini.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.hint.1: Dibanisa isiphumo somgca owamkela imeko nesinye isiphumo somgca esele sifunyenwe ngaphambili, uze ufake amanani ukubona ukuba zombini zinokusebenza ngaxeshanye.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.line.0: Kwi-ellipse x²/25 + y²/16 = 1, a=5 kwaye b=4, ngoko c²=a²−b²=9, c=3, kwaye F₁(−3, 0), F₂(3, 0).
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.line.1: Ngenkcazo ye-ellipse, PF₁ + PF₂ = 2a = 10, kwaye F₁F₂ = 6.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.line.2: Kuba ∠F₁PF₂ = 90°, ngetheorem kaPythagoras PF₁² + PF₂² = F₁F₂² = 36.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.line.3: Kuba (PF₁ + PF₂)² = PF₁² + PF₂² + 2·PF₁·PF₂, sifumana 100 = 36 + 2·PF₁·PF₂, ngoko PF₁·PF₂ = 32.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.explain: Ngumgca 3. Lo mgca uthathe i-"∠F₁PF₂=90°" ebhalwe engxakini njengoko inikiwe waseta ikhweshini. Kodwa kuba PF₁+PF₂=10 ukusuka kumgca 2, PF₁²+PF₂² incinci xa ubude obubini bulingana, ngoko kufuneka ibe yi-5²+5²=50 okanye ngaphezulu. Ayinakuba ngu-36, ngoko akukho chaphaza P elinjalo kwi-ellipse. Imigca 4 no-5 kukubala okulandela isiphumo somgca 3, ngoko nangona ukubala kuchanekile, akunantsingiselo.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.prompt: Chaza, usebenzisa amanani avela kwisisombululo, ukuba kutheni ungayikholelwa impendulo 16. Bhala nokuba yintoni into echanekileyo ekufuneka uyithi ngale ngxaki.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.hint.0: Cinga ngexabiso elincinci elinokuthathwa yi-PF₁²+PF₂² xa PF₁+PF₂ imiselwe kwi-10.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.hint.1: Zoba umfanekiso ukuxela ukuba ∠F₁PF₂ inkulu kakhulu phi njengoko P ihamba kwi-ellipse, uze uqikelele iingile apho.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba usebenzise amanani asesisombululweni (36, 10, 50, njalonjalo) ngqo kwinkcazelo yakho?
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uthe isigqibo sakho ngefom "imeko ayinakusebenza" kunokuba "ukubala kuphosisile"?
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ngaba waqonda ukuba oku kunokuhlolwa nangomfanekiso okanye indawo egqithisileyo (isiphelo se-minor axis)?
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.model.0: Ukuba PF₁+PF₂=10, isixa seesikwere sincinci xa ubude obubini bulingana, ngoko siyi-5²+5²=50 okanye ngaphezulu. Kodwa umgca 3 uthe 36, ngoko kukuphikisana. Ichaphaza P elinjalo alikho, kwaye 16 lixabiso elingenantsingiselo.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.model.1: Kwisiphelo se-minor axis (0, 4), PF₁=PF₂=5 kwaye F₁F₂=6, ngoko 25+25>36, nto leyo ethetha ukuba ∠F₁PF₂ incinci kune-90° kule ndawo. Le ngile inkulu kakhulu apho kwi-ellipse, ngoko akukho chaphaza apho ingu-90° khona. Ngoko indawo ayinakufunyanwa.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.model.2: Impendulo 16 ayichanekanga. Ukuba isixa si-10, isixa seesikwere singu-50 ubuncinane, kodwa singu-36, ngoko ayihambelani. Akukho chaphaza elinjalo.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.model.3: 16 ayilunganga. Ukuba isixa sobude obubini si-10, isixa seesikwere asinakuba ngu-36, ngoko P enjalo ayikho.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.prompt: Ngoku tshintsha i-ellipse ibe yi-x²/25 + y²/b² = 1 (0 < b < 5). Fumana uze ungenise amaxabiso amathathu ahlukeneyo ka-b apho ichaphaza P elinee-∠F₁PF₂ = 90° likho ngokwenene kwi-ellipse.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.hint.0: Kuqala jonga indlela umgama phakathi kweefokasi ezimbini otshintsha ngayo njengoko b ikhula.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.hint.1: Kwixabiso ngalinye lika-b, qikelela ukuba iingile kwichaphaza kwi-ellipse apho ∠F₁PF₂ inkulu kakhulu ifikelela kwi-90° na.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.ok.c2: Kule b, ichaphaza elinee-∠F₁PF₂=90° likhona kwi-ellipse.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.fail.c2: Kule b, ∠F₁PF₂ ayifikeleli kwi-90° naphina kwi-ellipse.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.explain: Ukuze iifokasi zibone ichaphaza P kwi-ellipse nge-90°, ∠F₁PF₂ kufuneka ibe yi-90° okanye ngaphezulu kwisiphelo se-minor axis, apho iingile inkulu kakhulu. Oku kwenzeka xa c ≥ b, oko kukuthi, xa 25−b² ≥ b². Ngoko b² ≤ 12.5, kwaye kwa-0<b<5, ichaphaza P likhona xa b imalunga ne-3.54 ubuninzi. b=3.5 iyasebenza, kodwa 3.6 ayisebenzi.

n-m-h3-conic-02.topic: Izahlulo zekhonikhi: iinkcazo nemigca ethintelayo yeparabola, ye-ellipse, neye-hyperbola; ukuhambelana phakathi kweemo neekhweshini
n-m-h3-conic-02.title: Sidinga ntoni enye ukumisela ikhweshini ye-hyperbola?
n-m-h3-conic-02.goal: Gweba ukuba ulwazi lwanele ukumisela ikhweshini yegophe ngokuthelekisa inani lezingaziwayo nenani leekhweshini ezizimeleyo.
n-m-h3-conic-02.material: Incwadi yemisebenzi iqulathe ingxaki "Fumana ikhweshini ye-hyperbola x²/a² − y²/b² = 1 (a>0, b>0) enee-fokasi (5, 0) no-(−5, 0)." Utitshala uthe, "Le ngxaki ilahlekelwe yimeko enye." Ufuna ukugqibezela ingxaki ngokongeza imeko elahlekileyo.
n-m-h3-conic-02.thinking.1: Wahlula oko sele ukwaziyo kulwazi olutsha
n-m-h3-conic-02.thinking.2: Bonisa ukuba ulwazi alwanelanga ngomzekelo ochasayo (igophe elahlukileyo elineefokasi ezifanayo)
n-m-h3-conic-02.prereq.0: Ifom esemgangathweni x²/a²−y²/b²=1 ye-hyperbola, nentsingiselo yeefokasi, iincopho, kunye ne-asimptote
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.prompt: Khetha onke amaqhekeza olwazi, ongezwe njengongezelelo kuphela kulwazi lokuba iifokasi zi-(5, 0) no-(−5, 0), amisela u-a no-b ngokungafaniyo. (a>0, b>0)
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala enye enye ukuba ulwazi ngalunye lunika ikhweshini entsha enxulumanisa u-a no-b.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.hint.1: Kuqala sebenza ukuba yeyiphi ikhweshini enxulumanisa u-a no-b esele isebenza xa kwaziwa iifokasi kuphela.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.r.b: Oku sele kwaziwa kumakhowudinethi eefokasi (±5, 0), ngoko asilulwazi olutsha. Kusekho enye kuphela kwiikhweshini ezifunekayo ezinxulumanisa u-a no-b.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.r.d: Oku kuhlala kusebenza kuwo nawuphi na igophe lefom x²/a²−y²/b²=1. Asilulwazi olutsha malunga no-a no-b.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.r.e: Ukufaka x=0 kunika −y²/b²=1, ngoko i-hyperbola yale fom ayidibani ne-eksisi ye-y. Asilulwazi olutsha malunga no-a no-b.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.explain: Ulwazi lweefokasi lunika ikhweshini enye kuphela, a²+b²=25. Incopho (3, 0) inika a=3, ngoko b=4 imiselwe, kwaye ithambeka le-asimptote 4/3 linika b/a=4/3, ngoko a=3 no-b=4 bamiselwe. Umgama phakathi kweefokasi ongu-10, ukulingana malunga nemvelaphi, nokungadibani ne-eksisi ye-y sele kwaziwa okanye kuhlala kunyaniso, ngoko akongezi khweshini.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.prompt: Yenza ii-hyperbola ezimbini zeemo ezahlukeneyo ezineefokasi (5, 0) no-(−5, 0) kwaye zefom x²/a² − y²/b² = 1, uze ungenise (a, b). (Ukuba ubhala amadesimali, sebenzisa iindawo ezimbini zedesimali.)
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.hint.0: Faka ixabiso lika-c kwikhweshini ephakathi kuka-a, b, no-c kwi-hyperbola.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha ixabiso elinye lika-a elanelisa loo khweshini uhlole ukuba b iba yintoni.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.explain: Ukuba iifokasi ziyafana, c=5, ngoko a²+b²=25. Ayinguye kuphela (3, 4) no-(4, 3) kodwa neebini ezinje nge-(2, malunga ne-4.58) zonke ziyenzeka, ngoko zikho ii-hyperbola ezingenasiphelo zeemo ezahlukeneyo.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Chaza ukuba kutheni ii-hyperbola ezahlukeneyo ziphuma nangona iifokasi ziyafana.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Bala ukuba zingaphi iikhweshini ezinxulumanisa u-a no-b nokuba zingaphi izingaziwayo.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Bala a²+b² kwibini ngalinye kwabini owenzileyo uze uthelekise.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ngaba uthe kukho ikhweshini enye kuphela esebenza phakathi kuka-a no-b?
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ngaba unike imizekelo emibini okanye ngaphezulu ye-(a, b) enelisa loo khweshini?
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Ukuba iifokasi zi-(±5, 0), ngoko c=5, kwaye kwi-hyperbola kuvela ikhweshini enye kuphela: a²+b²=c²=25. Zikho izingaziwayo ezimbini, a no-b, ngoko b itshintsha ngokuxhomekeke kwindlela a ekhethwa ngayo, kwaye kukho amagophe angenasiphelo.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Sinikwa kuphela a²+b²=25, ngoko (3, 4) iyasebenza, (4, 3) iyasebenza, kwaye nezinye ezininzi. Ngoko iifokasi zodwa azimiseli ngokungafaniyo.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.prompt: Ngeli xesha, khetha indlela enokusetyenziswa nakumagophe angeyo-hyperbola. Xa ufumana ulwazi olutsha, yeyiphi eyona ndlela ithembekileyo yokugqiba ukuba olo lwazi lodwa lumisela igophe ngokungafaniyo?
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.hint.0: Beka macala ngamacala inani leekhweshini ezifunyenwe kumaqhekeza amabini olwazi asetyenzisiweyo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku nenani lezingaziwayo.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.hint.1: Cinga ngendlela iqhekeza elinye lolwazi olutsha elitshintsha ngayo ezo nani.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.o.a: Gqiba ngokujonga ukuba ulwazi olutsha luqulathe amanani athile na.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.r.a: Nokuba kukho amanani, anokuphinda nje into esele yaziwa (umzekelo, umgama phakathi kweefokasi). Ubukho bamanani abunakuba ngumgangatho.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.o.b: Hlola ukuba linika enye ikhweshini enxulumanisa u-a no-b eyahlukileyo kwimeko yeefokasi.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.o.c: Hlola ukuba igophe linokuzotywa usebenzisa ulwazi olutsha.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.r.c: Ukukwazi ukuzoba umfanekiso akuthethi ukuba amanani amisiwe. Kufuneka ugqibe ukuba amisiwe usebenzisa iikhweshini.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.o.d: Gqiba ngokujonga ukuba ulwazi olutsha luvezwa ngendlela efanayo neefokasi na.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.r.d: Indlela into evezwa ngayo ayinanto yakwenza nesixa solwazi. Okubalulekileyo kukuba yeyiphi ikhweshini eyongezayo.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.explain: Ukuze imiselwe ngokungafaniyo, udinga iikhweshini ezizimeleyo ezininzi njengezingaziwayo. Iifokasi zinike ikhweshini enye kwaye a no-b zizingaziwayo ezimbini, ngoko kufuneka uhlole ukuba ulwazi olutsha lunika enye ikhweshini eyahlukileyo koko sele kwaziwa. Nangona kunjalo, nokuba kukho iikhweshini ezimbini isisombululo sisenokungafani, ngoko ekugqibeleni sombulula ukuqinisekisa.

n-m-h3-conic-04.topic: Izahlulo zekhonikhi: iinkcazo nemigca ethintelayo yeparabola, ye-ellipse, neye-hyperbola; ukuhambelana phakathi kweemo neekhweshini
n-m-h3-conic-04.title: Ukuzakhela imigca ethinta i-hyperbola
n-m-h3-conic-04.goal: Zakhele imigca emininzi ethintelayo, ufumanise ukuba kukho umgama wamathambeka apho kukho umgca othintelayo, uze uchaze oku usebenzisa i-discriminant.
n-m-h3-conic-04.material: Kukho i-hyperbola x²/4 − y²/9 = 1. Uza kufumanisa ngemigca y = mx + k ethinta lo mgca ngokuzakhela yona.
n-m-h3-conic-04.thinking.1: Zakhele imigca ethintelayo kwaye ufumane ipatheni
n-m-h3-conic-04.prereq.1: Ubudlelwane bokuma phakathi komgca ne-conic (ukulingana okwenziwa kunye)
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.prompt: Zakhele imigca emithathu eyahlukeneyo y = mx + k ethinta i-hyperbola x²/4 − y²/9 = 1 uze ufake (m, k). (Sebenzisa iidesimali ukuya kwindawo yesithathu yedesimali.)
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.hint.0: Faka ukulingana komgca kuqingatho lwe-hyperbola ukwenza ukulingana ku-x.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga ukuba loo mgca kufuneka ube kweyiphi imeko ukuze umgca uchukumise ijika kwichaphaza elinye kuphela.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.ok.c1: Ukufaka umgca kunika ukulingana kwekhwadratikhi ku-x.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.fail.c1: Ngale thambeka, ukufaka umgca akunikeli ukulingana kwekhwadratikhi.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.fail.c2: Lo mgca awuthinti i-hyperbola (i-discriminant ayilingani no-0).
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.explain: Ukufaka y=mx+k kwi-9x²−4y²=36 kunika (9−4m²)x²−8mkx−4k²−36=0. I-discriminant yi-144(k²+9−4m²), ngoko ukuze kuthintane, k²=4m²−9. Umzekelo, ukuba m=2.5, ngoko k²=16, ngoko k=±4.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s2.prompt: Khumbula imigca oyakhe ngaphambili. Khetha onke amathambeka apho umgca y = mx + k othinta le hyperbola ukhoyo.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala imeko yokuba i-discriminant yokulingana osete ngaphambili ibe ngu-0 njengokulingana ku-k².
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s2.hint.1: Kwithambeka ngalinye m, nqumela ukuba k² ingaba iya kuba negathivu na.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s2.r.a: Umgca othe tye y=k unqumla igatya ngalinye lamabini e-hyperbola kanye okanye awudibani nalo naliphi. Awunakuze uthinte.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s2.r.d: Kubonakala ngathi ucinge ukuba ithambeka elincinci linomgca othintelayo. Ukuba udlulisela ngaphandle kotshintsho ifomula yokuthinta i-ellipse k²=a²m²+b², ufumana k=±√13, kodwa lo mgca udibana ne-hyperbola kumachaphaza amabini.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s2.explain: Ukuze kuthintane, kufuneka k²=4m²−9≥0, kwaye ukhupha imeko ehambelana nee-asymptote (ithambeka ±3/2), 4m²>9, oko kukuthi, |m|>3/2. Amathambeka 2 no−3 ayasebenza; kwi-0 nakwi-1, k² inegathivu, ngoko ayisebenzi.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.prompt: Umgca onethambeka 1 awunakuthinta le hyperbola. Chaza isizathu, uze uchaze umgama wamathambeka m apho umgca othintelayo ukhoyo.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.hint.0: Faka m=1 uze ufumane k eyenza i-discriminant ibe ngu-0.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.hint.1: Sebenza ukuba m kufuneka ibe kumgama onjani ukuze k² ingabi negathivu.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba uchaze isizathu usebenzisa i-discriminant (okanye uphawu lwe-k²)?
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba uthe umda womgama unxulumene nethambeka lee-asymptote?
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.model.0: Ukufaka y=x+k kwenza i-discriminant ibe yi-144(k²+5), engenakuze ibe ngu-0. Ukuze ibe ngumgca othintelayo, kufuneka k²=4m²−9≥0, ngoko ixabiso elipheleleyo le-m kufuneka libe likhulu kune-3/2.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.model.1: Kwithambeka 1, k²=−5, ngoko akukho k yokwenyani kwaye ngoko akukho mgca othintelayo. Amathambeka emigca ethintelayo afuna 4m²−9 ibe ubuncinane ngu-0, kodwa ±1.5, ahambelana nee-asymptote, kufuneka akhutshwe, ngoko |m|>1.5.

n-m-h3-conic-05.topic: Izahlulo zekhonikhi: iinkcazo nemigca ethintelayo yeparabola, ye-ellipse, neye-hyperbola; ukuhambelana phakathi kweemo neekhweshini
n-m-h3-conic-05.title: Ukuba k iyatshintsha, ingaba uhlobo lwejika luyatshintsha nalo?
n-m-h3-conic-05.goal: Kukulingana kwe-conic equkuva unobumba, fumana kwaye uqinisekise ngokuthe ngqo amaxesha apho uhlobo lwesimo lutshintsha ngokuxhomekeke kuphawu lwabahlulayo.
n-m-h3-conic-05.material: Kwi-k yokwenyani, phanda ukuba isimo esimelwe kukulingana x²/(9−k) + y²/(4−k) = 1 sitshintsha njani nge-k. Ukuba ufaka k=2, iba x²/7 + y²/2 = 1, eyi-ellipse.
n-m-h3-conic-05.thinking.2: Khangela ukuba ukulingana kunokungameli simo kwaphela
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.prompt: Ukuba ufaka k=6, ufumana x²/3 + y²/(−2) = 1. Esi silinganiso simela siphi isimo?
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.hint.0: Phinda ubhale ilungu elinomhlukanisi onegathivu ngohlobo lokuthabatha.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.hint.1: Thelekisa ukulingana okuphinde kwabhalwa nohlobo oluqhelekileyo uze ujonge ukuba ngowuphi umhlathi oyipozithivu.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.o.a: Yi-ellipse, kuba ukulingana kubhaliwe njengesixa samalungu amabini.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.r.a: Uphoswe kukuba uphawu lomhlukanisi lunokutshintsha xa ufaka k. Ujonge kuphela inkangeleko yangaphandle yokulingana.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.o.b: Yi-hyperbola enee-eksisi ephambukayo kwicala le-eksisi ye-y, kuba inegathivu kwicala le-y².
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.r.b: Ukuba umhlukanisi onegathivu ukwicala le-y², ilungu le-x² liyipozithivu, ngoko livuleka kwicala le-eksisi ye-x. Khangela ukuba ngowuphi umhlathi oyipozithivu.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.o.c: Asiso naluphi na isimo, kuba omnye umhlukanisi unegathivu.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.r.c: Ukuba omnye umhlukanisi unegathivu, ukulingana kuphenduka ukuthabatha. Akunjalo ukuba akukho machaphaza; uhlobo lwejika luyatshintsha.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.o.d: Yi-hyperbola, kuba omnye umhlukanisi uba negathivu kwaye ukulingana kuthatha uhlobo lokuthabatha.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.explain: I-y²/(−2) yi-−y²/2, ngoko ukulingana yi-x²/3 − y²/2 = 1. Ilungu le-x² liyipozithivu, ngoko yi-hyperbola evuleka kwicala le-eksisi ye-x.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.prompt: Fumana kwaye ufake amaxabiso amathathu eyahlukeneyo e-k apho ukulingana x²/(9−k) + y²/(4−k) = 1 kuba yi-hyperbola yohlobo x²/A − y²/B = 1 (A>0, B>0).
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala ukuba iimpawu zabahlulayo ababini kufuneka zibe yintoni ukuze ukulingana kuthathe uhlobo lokuthabatha.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.hint.1: Phendula loo meko yophawu ibe ngukungalingani ku-k uze ufumane umgama.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Ilungu le-y² alitshintshi libe luhlobo lokuthabatha.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.explain: Ukuba umhlukanisi 9−k welungu le-x² uyipozithivu kwaye umhlukanisi 4−k welungu le-y² unegathivu, ukulingana kuthatha uhlobo x²/(9−k) − y²/(k−4) = 1. Oko kukuthi, yonke k ene-4<k<9 iyasebenza (k=4 no-9 azisebenzi kuba umhlukanisi ngu-0).
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.prompt: Xa k=2 yayiyi-ellipse, kodwa xa k=6 yaba yi-hyperbola. Chaza ukuba yeyiphi inxalenye yokulingana eyatshintsha nokuba yatshintsha njani.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.hint.0: Bhala iimpawu zabahlulayo ababini xa k=2 nasenxa k=6 uze uzithelekise.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.hint.1: Fumana ukuba ngowuphi umhlukanisi otshintshe uphawu.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingaba uthelekise utshintsho lweempawu zabahlulayo ababini xa k=2 nasenxa k=6?
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ukhomba ngqo ukuba ngowuphi umhlukanisi otshintshe uphawu?
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.model.0: Xa k=2, abahlulayo ababini ngu-7 no-2, bobabini bayipozithivu, ngoko unohlobo lwesixa (i-ellipse). Xa k=6, umhlukanisi 4−k kwicala le-y² uba −2, enegathivu, ngoko ukulingana kutshintshela kuhlobo lokuthabatha (i-hyperbola).
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.model.1: Xa k idlula u-4, i-4−k iba negathivu. Emva koko uphawu olungaphambi kwelungu le-y² luyatshintsha, ngoko i-ellipse iba yi-hyperbola. I-9−k ihlala iyipozithivu.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.prompt: Ukuba ufaka k=10, ukulingana kuba x²/(−1) + y²/(−6) = 1. Yeyiphi kwezi ngxelo malunga nesimo esimelwe sesi silinganiso echanekileyo?
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.hint.0: Phinda ubhale icala langasekhohlo ngokususa abahlulayo.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.hint.1: Thelekisa umgama wamaxabiso anokuthathwa licala langasekhohlo nelona lisekunene, 1.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.o.a: Akukho chaphaza (x, y) lanelisa olu lingano.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.o.b: Yi-ellipse, kuba nangona bobabini abahlulayo batshintshile, isekwisimo sesixa.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.r.b: Nakuba bobabini abahlulayo benegathivu, isekwisimo sesixa, kodwa awukhangelanga ukuba icala langasekhohlo alinakuba likhulu kuno-0, ngoko alinakulingana no-1 osekunene.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.o.c: Yi-hyperbola evuleka kwicala le-eksisi ye-x, kuba i-9−k inegathivu.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.r.c: Bobabini abahlulayo banegathivu, ngoko akukho kwisimo sokuthabatha. Jonga iimpawu kwakhona.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.o.d: Sisangqa, kuba la malungu mabini abonakala efana.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.r.d: Abahlulayo banamaxabiso ahlukeneyo, ngoko akunakuba sisangqa, kwaye awuzikhangelanga neempawu.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.explain: Icala langasekhohlo yi-−x²−y²/6, ephezulu ngu-0. Ayinakulingana no-1 osekunene, ngoko akukho (x, y) yokwenyani enelisa olu lingano. Kuxhomekeke ekubeni abahlulayo bayipozithivu okanye banegathivu, luhlulwa lube yi-ellipse, i-hyperbola, okanye akukho nto kwaphela.

n-m-h3-conic-07.topic: Izahlulo zekhonikhi: iinkcazo nemigca ethintelayo yeparabola, ye-ellipse, neye-hyperbola; ukuhambelana phakathi kweemo neekhweshini
n-m-h3-conic-07.title: Isixa seendlela ezimbini ezidlula kwichaphaza leparabola
n-m-h3-conic-07.goal: Usebenzisa indawo yamachaphaza, bona ukuba umda ophantsi osuka kukungalingani kwonxantathu awusoloko uyixabiso elifikelelwayo, uze ufumane ubuncinane kwakhona usebenzisa inkcazo yeparabola (umgama oya engxoweni = umgama oya kwi-directrix).
n-m-h3-conic-07.material: Iparabola y² = 8x inengxowa F(2, 0) kunye ne-directrix x = −2. USeoyun uthi, "Kwichaphaza P elikwijika nakwichaphaza A elithile, ubuncinane be-PA + PF buhlala bungu-AF ngokungalingani konxantathu."
n-m-h3-conic-07.thinking.1: Phinda ubhale ngohlobo olwahlukileyo usebenzisa inkcazo
n-m-h3-conic-07.thinking.2: Hlula ube ngamatyala ngokuxhomekeke kwindawo yechaphaza
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.prompt: Kwipharabola y² = 8x enesiko F(2, 0) nechaphaza A(4, 2), uhambise ichaphaza P kujika ukufumana ubuncinane be-PA+PF. Liliphi ixabiso nesizathu esihambelana kakhulu?
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.hint.0: Khetha amachaphaza amaninzi P kujika, bala i-PA+PF ngqo, wenze itheyibhile.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.hint.1: Khumbula inkcazo ukhangele ukuba ungayibhala kwakhona i-PF njengobunye ubude kwichaphaza elikwipharabola.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.o.a: 6, kuba ilingana nomgama ukusuka ku-A ukuya kumgca olawulayo.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.o.b: 2√2, kuba PA+PF ≥ AF kwaye likho P apho ukulingana kubamba khona.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.r.b: Ukulingana kukungalingani konxantathu kubamba kuphela xa P ikwicandelo lomgca AF. Awukhange ukhangele ukuba P enjalo ikujika.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.r.c: Ujonge kuphela iikhowudinethi zechaphaza A. Akukho nkcazelo yokuba eli xabiso lisisixa semigama enjani.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.r.d: Ufumene kuphela ixabiso kwichaphaza elinye akhange ukhangele ukuba lelona lincinane.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.explain: Kwichaphaza elikwipharabola, i-PF ilingana nomgama ukusuka ku-P ukuya kumgca olawulayo x=−2. Ngoko PA+PF sisixa sika-PA "nomgama ukusuka ku-P ukuya kumgca olawulayo," okuyi-6 ubuncinane, umgama ukusuka ku-A ukuya kumgca olawulayo. Ilingana ne-6 kwichaphaza elikujika ekuphakameni okufanayo no-A, njenge-P=(0.5, 2). 2√2 yi-AF, kodwa u-A no-F bobabini bangaphakathi kwejika, ngoko icandelo lomgca AF alinqumli ijika kwaye alinakufikelelwa.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.prompt: Ngeli xesha khetha ichaphaza A(x, y) elineekhowudinethi ezingamanani aphelele (ukusuka kwi-−10 ukuya kwi-10), uze ufumane ufake amachaphaza amathathu ahlukeneyo A apho ubuncinane be-PA+PF bulingana ne-AF njengoko P ihamba kujika.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.hint.0: Qala uthi ikuphi P ekufuneka ibe kuyo ukuze ukulingana kokungalingani konxantathu kubambe.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.hint.1: Yahlula kwiimeko apho u-A engaphakathi nangaphandle kwejika, uze uzobe ukuba icandelo lomgca AF liyadibana nejika na.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.ok.c1: Ezi ziikhowudinethi ezingamanani aphelele aphakathi koluhlu.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Iikhowudinethi kufuneka zibe ngamanani aphelele ukusuka kwi-−10 ukuya kwi-10 ngokubandakanya.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Icandelo lomgca AF lidibana nejika, ngoko likho P ene-PA+PF=AF.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Kweli chaphaza, akukho P kujika apho ilingana ne-AF.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.explain: PA+PF ≥ AF, kwaye ukulingana kubamba kuphela xa P ikwicandelo lomgca AF. F ingaphakathi kwejika, ngoko ukuba u-A ukujika okanye ungaphandle kwalo (y² ≥ 8x), icandelo lomgca AF lidibana nejika. Ukuba u-A ungaphakathi (y² < 8x), icandelo alidibani nejika, ngoko ubuncinane bukhulu kuno-AF.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.prompt: Kwi-A(4, 2), ubuncinane buphume bukhulu kuno-AF. Chaza ukuba kutheni ibango likaSeoyun elithi "ubuncinane be-PA+PF bulihlala bulu-AF" liphosakele.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.hint.0: Thi ikuphi P ekufuneka ibe kuyo ukuze ukulingana kubambe kukungalingani okusetyenziswe nguSeoyun.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.hint.1: Khangela ukuba loo meko iyanelisa kwi-A(4, 2) usebenzisa iindawo zecandelo lomgca AF nejika.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba uchaze imeko yokulingana kokungalingani konxantathu?
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uthe isiphumo siyahluka ngokwendawo yechaphaza A (ngaphakathi/ngaphandle kwejika)?
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.model.0: I-PF ilingana nomgama ukusuka ku-P ukuya kumgca olawulayo, ngoko PA+PF ubuncinane yi-6, umgama ukusuka ku-A ukuya kumgca olawulayo. Le 6 inkulu kakhulu kune-AF=2√2. Ibango likaSeoyun alihlali liyinyaniso, kuba kukho iimeko apho i-AF iyona incinane.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.model.1: Ukulingana kokungalingani konxantathu PA+PF≥AF kubamba kuphela xa P ikwicandelo lomgca AF. Ukuba u-A no-F bobabini bangaphakathi kwejika, icandelo lomgca AF alidibani nejika, ngoko akukho P enjalo. Ngoko ubuncinane bukhulu kuno-AF.

n-m-h3-diffc-05.title: Ukuba umsebenzi ongaphakathi unekona, ingaba umsebenzi odityanisiweyo nawo unayo?
n-m-h3-diffc-05.topic: Ukwenza i-derivative: ukwenzeka kwe-derivative yemisebenzi edityanisiweyo
n-m-h3-diffc-05.goal: Linga ibango elithi "ukuba umsebenzi ongaphakathi awenzeki ukwenziwa i-derivative, umsebenzi odityanisiweyo nawo awenzeki ukwenziwa i-derivative" ngemizekelo, uze uqinisekise imiqathango apho umsebenzi odityanisiweyo uba nokwenziwa i-derivative ngemizekelo oyakhileyo ngokwakho.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.material: g(x)=|x| ayinakwenziwa i-derivative xa x=0. (Ithambeka ekhohlo kwe-x=0 li-−1, kwaye ithambeka ekunene li-1.) UMinseo uyabanga, "Ukuba umsebenzi ongaphakathi g awunakwenziwa i-derivative xa x=0, ngoko nawuphi na umsebenzi onokwenziwa i-derivative f, umsebenzi odityanisiweyo h(x)=f(g(x))=f(|x|) awunakwenziwa i-derivative xa x=0."
n-m-h3-diffc-05.thinking.2: Chaza isiphumo kwimeko apho umthetho wekhonkco ungenakusetyenziswa
n-m-h3-diffc-05.prereq.0: Umsebenzi wexabiso elipheleleyo |x| awunakwenziwa i-derivative xa x=0
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke ii-f apho h(x)=f(|x|) iba nokwenziwa i-derivative xa x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.hint.0: Kwi-f nganye, bhala h(x)=f(|x|) ngokuthe ngqo ngokwe-|x|.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.hint.1: Kufutshane ne-x=0, sebenzisa |x|=x xa x>0 kunye ne-|x|=−x xa x<0 ukuthelekisa imo ye-h ekhohlo nasekunene.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.r.a: h(x)=x²+|x|, kwaye i-x² ayinakufihla ikona ye-|x|. Kule f, ithambeka xa x=0 asiyi-0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.r.b: h(x)=|x|³, ngoko amathambeka omabini amacala e-x=0 asondela kwi-0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.r.e: h(x)=(|x|−1)²=x²−2|x|+1, kwaye ngenxa ye-−2|x| inekona xa x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.explain: I-derivative yasekunene ye-h xa x=0 yi-f′(0) kwaye eyasekhohlo yi-−f′(0). Ukuze zilingane, f′(0)=0 iyafuneka. I-x³ kunye ne-x²+3 zine-f′(0)=0, ngoko ziyakwazi ukwenziwa i-derivative, kwaye ezinye zine-f′(0) elingana no-1, 3, kunye no-−2 ngokulandelelana, ngoko zinamakona.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.prompt: Vumela f(x)=ax³+bx²+cx. Faka ii-triples ezimbini okanye ngaphezulu ezahlukeneyo (a, b, c) ezenza h(x)=f(|x|) ibe nokwenziwa i-derivative xa x=0. Apha a kunye no-b abayi-0, kwaye zonke ngamanani aphelele ukusuka kwi-−9 ukuya kwi-9 kubandakanywa.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala f(|x|) njengentetho uhlule amalungu apho |x| ihleli njengesikhuphi esingumangqabangqaba kumalungu anezikhuphi eziyipheyiri, apho |x| ithi nyaku.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.hint.1: Fumana ilungu elishiya i-|x| injalo lize linike ikona xa x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.ok.c1: Zonke ii-koyifishenti ezintathu ngamanani aphelele ngaphakathi koluhlu.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.fail.c1: a, b, kunye no-c kufuneka zibe ngamanani aphelele ukusuka kwi-−9 ukuya kwi-9 kubandakanywa.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.fail.c2: a kunye no-b akufuneki babe yi-0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.ok.c3: Amathambeka asekhohlo nasekunene xa x=0 ayalingana.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Ukuba ikoyifishenti ye-x ayiyi-0, i-h inekona xa x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.explain: Kwi-h(x)=a|x|³+bx²+c|x|, a|x|³ kunye ne-bx² ziyakwazi ukwenziwa i-derivative xa x=0, kwaye i-c|x| inekona ukuba c≠0. Ngoko c kufuneka ibe yi-0. Oko kukuthi, f′(0)=c=0. (1, 2, 1) ine-c≠0, ngoko inekona; (0, 2, 0) kunye ne-(1, 0, −2) zine-a=0 no-b=0 ngokulandelelana, ngoko zophula umqathango c2, kwaye eyokugqibela iphula nomqathango c3.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.prompt: Chaza ukuba ibango likaMinseo alichanekanga usebenzisa imizekelo engentla, ubhale ukuba yimiphi imiqathango f efanele ayanelise ukuze f(|x|) ibe nokwenziwa i-derivative xa x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.hint.0: Beka ecaleni ii-f ezibe nokwenziwa i-derivative kwinyathelo elidlulileyo kunye nezo zingazange, uthelekise ithambeka le-f xa x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.hint.1: Chaza ithambeka lasekunene nelasekhohlo le-h xa x=0 ngokwethambeka le-f.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba unike i-f enye ethile wabonisa ukuba h(x) inokwenziwa i-derivative xa x=0?
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba uthe amathambeka asekhohlo nasekunene alingana njani?
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.model.0: Ukuba f(x)=x²+3, ngoko h(x)=x²+3, enokwenziwa i-derivative xa x=0. Nangona i-|x| inekona, umsebenzi odityanisiweyo awunayo. Ithambeka lasekunene le-h yi-f′(0) kwaye elasekhohlo yi-−f′(0), ngoko ukuba f′(0)=0 amathambeka omabini ayalingana kwaye inokwenziwa i-derivative. Ngoko ibango likaMinseo alichanekanga.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.model.1: Umzekelo ochasayo yi-f(x)=x³. I-h(x)=|x|³ inethambeka elingu-0 xa x=0. Ngokubanzi, ukuba f′(0)=0, ii-derivative zasekhohlo nasekunene zi-0 kunye ne-0, ngoko inokwenziwa i-derivative, kwaye ukuba f′(0) ayiyi-0, inekona.

n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.prompt: Ulwazi luvezwa isiqwenga esinye ngexesha. Kwinyathelo ngalinye, khetha isigwebo ngokusekelwe kuphela koko uyaziyo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.title: Kwenzeka ntoni ukuba ithambeka li-0 kwaye ubungakanani bokugoba bu-0 nabo?
n-m-h3-diffc-04.topic: Ukwenza i-derivative: ukutolika iigrafu, amaxabiso aphezulu okanye aphantsi, kunye ne-derivative yesibini
n-m-h3-diffc-04.goal: Njengoko ulwazi lwongezwa ngokunye ngexesha, hlaziya ugwebo lwamaxabiso aphezulu okanye aphantsi, uze uqonde ukuba xa ixabiso le-derivative yesibini li-0, kufuneka ujonge ngokuthe ngqo utshintsho lophawu lwe-derivative.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.material: Umsebenzi we-polynomial f uyanelisa f′(0)=0 xa x=0. Ngalo lonke ixesha kuvezwa inxalenye yolwazi, hlola ugwebo lwakho malunga nemo egrafu inayo xa x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.thinking.2: Hlola amaxabiso aphezulu okanye aphantsi ngotshintsho lophawu lwe-derivative
n-m-h3-diffc-04.prereq.0: Ubudlelwane phakathi kwamaxabiso aphezulu okanye aphantsi notshintsho lophawu lwe-derivative
n-m-h3-diffc-04.prereq.2: Intsingiselo yechaphaza lokugoba (ichaphaza apho ukugoba kutshintsha khona)
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.hint.0: Ngalo lonke ixesha kuvela ulwazi olutsha, gqiba ukuba lisetyenziselwa muphi uvavanyo nokuba imiqathango ilungile na ukuze luphumeze isigqibo.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.hint.1: Thelekisa ukuba izibakala zokuba f′ kunye ne-f″ ngamnye li-0 zithetha into efanayo nezimpawu ezisekhohlo nasekunene kweso sithuba.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.info: f′(0)=0. (Xa x=0, umgca othinteleyo ufana ne-eksisi ye-x.)
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Singathi i-f inexabiso eliphezulu okanye eliphantsi xa x=0?
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.after: I-f′(x)=0 ikuxelela kuphela umgqatswa wexabiso eliphezulu okanye eliphantsi. Kufuneka wazi ngakumbi ngophawu lwe-f′ ngaphambi nasemva kwe-x=0, okanye uphawu lwe-f″.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Lisezantsi lelokishi: ukuba umgca othinteleyo uthe tyaba, igrafu iwudibanisa ngaphantsi
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Uthathe onke amachaphaza anomgca othinteleyo othe tyaba njengamabini asezantsi elokishi. Umgca othinteleyo othe tyaba unokwenzeka kwelokishi eliphezulu, elokishi eliphantsi, okanye kwichaphaza lokugoba.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Liphezulu lelokishi: ukuba umgca othinteleyo uthe tyaba, ngumphezulu wegrafu
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uthathe onke amachaphaza anomgca othinteleyo othe tyaba njengamaphezulu elokishi.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Asikazi: kunokuba okanye kungabi lixabiso eliphezulu okanye eliphantsi, ngoko kufuneka sazi ngakumbi
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ucinge ukuba umgca othinteleyo othe tyaba kuphela awunakugqiba ukuba lixabiso eliphezulu okanye eliphantsi.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ukubona olu lwazi, ugwebo lwakho lunjani ngoku?
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Uvavanyo lokuba f″(0)>0 linika ubuncinane belokishi kwaye f″(0)<0 linika ubuninzi belokishi alikuxeleli nto xa f″(0)=0. f(x)=x⁴, −x⁴, kunye ne-x³ zonke zine-f′(0)=f″(0)=0, kodwa iimo zazo ziyahluka.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Alilixabiso eliphezulu okanye eliphantsi: ukuba f″(0) li-0, alilixabiso eliphezulu okanye eliphantsi
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ufunde f″(0)=0 njengobungqina bokuba alilixabiso eliphezulu okanye eliphantsi. Oko kuthetha kuphela ukuba uvavanyo lokuthi "i-derivative yesibini epositivu ithetha ubuncinane belokishi, enegethivu ithetha ubuninzi belokishi" alinakusetyenziswa.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Ayinakugqitywa ngolu lwazi: uvavanyo olusebenzisa i-derivative yesibini luyayeka ukusebenza
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Uqaphele ukuba ukuba f″(0)=0, i-f″ ayinakusetyenziswa ukugqiba ukuba lubuninzi okanye ubuncinane belokishi.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Lisezantsi lelokishi: ithambeka li-0 kwaye ukugoba ku-0, ngoko lilona lithe tyaba kakhulu
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Uqinisekise ubuncinane belokishi ngokweemvakalelo zokuthi "thyaba." Ichaphaza elithe tyaba alizozonke lichaphaza eliphantsi.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ekugqibeleni, imo ye-f xa x=0 injani?
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.after: I-f′(x)=4x³ inegethivu xa x<0 kwaye ipositivu xa x>0, ngoko i-f inobuncinane belokishi xa x=0. Kwakhona f″(x)=12x²≥0, ngoko ukuqubuda akutshintshi, kwaye alilo ichaphaza lokugoba.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Inobuncinane belokishi, kwaye eli chaphaza alilo ichaphaza lokugoba
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ufunde kunye ukuba uphawu lwe-f′ lutshintsha lusuka kwenegethivu lukhatshwa kwipositivu kwaye i-f″ ayingaphantsi kwe-0 kwaye ayitshintshi uphawu.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ayinalo ixabiso eliphezulu okanye eliphantsi, kwaye eli chaphaza lichaphaza lokugoba
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ugqibe ukuba lichaphaza lokugoba kuba nje f″(0)=0. Ukuze libe lichaphaza lokugoba, uphawu lwe-f″ kufuneka lutshintshe.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Inobuncinane belokishi, kwaye eli chaphaza lichaphaza lokugoba nalo
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ucinge ukuba f″(0)=0 ithetha ichaphaza lokugoba. I-f″(x)=12x² ayingaphantsi kwe-0, ngoko uphawu lwayo alutshintshi.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni, i-f′(0)=0 yodwa yenze kwabonakala ngathi lixabiso eliphezulu okanye eliphantsi, kwaye xa f″(0)=0 yavela, uvavanyo lwayeka ukusebenza. Nanjengoko kunjalo, ungafikelela kwisigqibo ngokuhlola ngokuthe ngqo ukuba uphawu lwe-f′ luyatshintsha na. Ixabiso elingu-0 lahlukile kutshintsho lophawu.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.prompt: Khetha umsebenzi one-f′(0)=0 kunye ne-f″(0)=0 ongenalo ixabiso eliphezulu okanye eliphantsi xa x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.hint.0: Fumana i-derivative yomsebenzi ngamnye uthelekise uphawu lwayo ekhohlo nasekunene kwe-x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.hint.1: Wahlule abe ngumisebenzi apho uphawu lwe-f′ lutshintsha nalapho lungatshintshi.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.r.a: I-x⁴ ine-f′(0)=f″(0)=0 kodwa inobuncinane belokishi xa x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.r.b: I-−x⁶ ine-f′(0)=f″(0)=0 kodwa inobuninzi belokishi xa x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.r.c: I-x⁶ nayo inobuncinane belokishi xa x=0. Jonga ukuba isikhuphi siyipheyiri na.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.r.d: Kwi-x³, i-f′(x)=3x² ayitshintshi uphawu, ngoko akukho xabiso liphezulu okanye eliphantsi.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.explain: Kwi-x³, i-f′(x)=3x²≥0, ngoko i-f′ inophawu olufanayo ngaphambi nasemva kwe-x=0, kwaye akukho xabiso liphezulu okanye eliphantsi. Kwimisebenzi emithathu eseleyo, uphawu lwe-f′ luyatshintsha, ngoko inamaxabiso aphezulu okanye aphantsi. Oku kuthetha ukuba i-f′(0)=f″(0)=0 yodwa ayinakuxela ukuba yeyiphi imeko.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.prompt: Xa f′(0)=0 kwaye f″(0)=0, bhala into ekufuneka uyihlole, nendlela, ukugqiba ukuba likho ixabiso eliphezulu okanye eliphantsi xa x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala ukuba ukuthi likho ixabiso eliphezulu okanye eliphantsi kubonakala njani ngokwephawu le-f′.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala ngokwahlukeneyo indlela engasayi kusetyenziswa xa f″(0)=0 kunye nendlela esenokusetyenziswa.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.placeholder: umzekelo: Ukuba f″(0)=0, ngoko ... endaweni yoko ...
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ubhale ukuba uthelekisa uphawu lwe-f′ ekhohlo nasekunene kwe-x=0?
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba uthe f″(0)=0 ayithethi ukuba akukho xabiso liphezulu okanye eliphantsi?
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.model.0: Ukuba f″(0)=0, i-derivative yesibini ayinakukuxelela ukuba lubuninzi okanye ubuncinane belokishi. Ngoko kufuneka ujonge ngokuthe ngqo ukuba uphawu lwe-f′ lutshintsha na ekhohlo nasekunene kwe-x=0. Ukuba luyatshintsha, likho ixabiso eliphezulu okanye eliphantsi, kwaye ukuba aluthintshi, alikho.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.model.1: Ukuba ixabiso le-derivative yesibini li-0, uvavanyo luyayeka ukusebenza, ngoko dweba itshathi yophawu lwe-f′(x). Ukuba i-f′ itshintsha isuka kwenegethivu iye kwipositivu (ubuncinane) okanye isuka kwipositivu iye kwenegethivu (ubuninzi) malunga ne-0, lixabiso eliphezulu okanye eliphantsi, kwaye ukuba uphawu luhleli lufana, alilo.

n-m-h3-diffc-08.title: Ngaba umgca othinteleyo udibana nejika kuphela kwichaphaza lokuthinteleka?
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.ok.c1: a no-b ngamanani aphelele aphakathi koluhlu.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.topic: Ukwahlula: iikhweshini zemigca ethintelayo, imigca ethintelayo yamagophe e-cubic
n-m-h3-diffc-08.goal: Yakha umzekelo wakho womgca othintelayo kwigophe le-cubic odibana negophe kwakhona kwichaphaza elingelilo elokuthintela, uze wahlule amachaphaza okuthintela apho oku kungenzeki khona.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.material: Umgca othintelayo kwigophe y=x³−3x kwichaphaza A(1, −2) yi-y=−2. Kwigrafu yomsebenzi wequadratic, wabona ukuba umgca othintelayo udibana negophe kuphela kwichaphaza elinye lokuthintela. Ingaba kunjalo nakweli gophe?
n-m-h3-diffc-08.prereq.1: Ukwahlula iikhweshini ze-cubic zibe zizinto (ingcambu ephindiweyo)
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.prompt: Ukuba ufumana onke amakhowudinethi e-x amachaphaza apho umgca othintelayo y=−2 udibana negophe y=x³−3x, ufumana ntoni?
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.hint.0: Amachaphaza apho umgca othintelayo negophe zidibana khona zizisombululo zekhweshini ebeka iikhweshini ezimbini zilingana. Seta ikhweshini.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.hint.1: Sebenzisa into yokuba x=1 sisisombululo ukwahlula icala lasekhohlo libe zizinto.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.r.a: Ucinge ukuba kuba ngumgca othintelayo, udibana negophe kuphela kwichaphaza lokuthintela. Sombulula ikhweshini x³−3x=−2 ngqo.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.r.b: Uphathe u-x=1 kunye no-−1 njengebini. Faka x=−1 kwikhweshini ukuhlola.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.r.d: Uphosise ingcambu ephindiweyo x=1. x=1 yichaphaza lokuthintela, ngoko lilele kumgca othintelayo.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.explain: x³−3x+2=(x−1)²(x+2), ngoko izisombululo zi-x=1 (ingcambu ephindiweyo, ichaphaza lokuthintela) kunye ne-x=−2. Kwichaphaza (−2, −2), umgca othintelayo udibana negophe kwakhona.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.prompt: Ngenisa iibini ezimbini okanye ngaphezulu ezahlukeneyo (a, b) ukuze umgca othintelayo kwigophe y=x³−3x kwichaphaza (a, a³−3a) udibane negophe nakwichaphaza (b, b³−3b) elingelilo elokuthintela. (a no-b ngamanani aphelele asuka kwi-−6 ukuya kwi-6 kuquka, kwaye b≠a)
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.hint.0: Khetha ixabiso lekhowudinethi ye-x a yechaphaza lokuthintela, ufumane ikhweshini yomgca othintelayo, uze ubhale ikhweshini efunyenwe ngokuyilinganisa negophe.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.hint.1: Sebenzisa isisombululo osele usaziyo kuloo khweshini (ichaphaza lokuthintela) ukufumana izisombululo eziseleyo.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.var.b: Ikhowudinethi ye-x b yechaphaza apho kudibana khona kwakhona
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.fail.c1: a no-b kufuneka babe ngamanani aphelele asuka kwi-−6 ukuya kwi-6 kuquka.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.explain: Ukulinganisa ikhweshini yomgca othintelayo kwichaphaza (a, a³−3a) negophe kunika (x−a)²(x+2a)=0, ngoko ikhowudinethi ye-x yechaphaza apho kudibana khona kwakhona yi-b=−2a. (1, −2), (2, −4), kunye ne-(−3, 6) yimizekelo; (1, 1) lichaphaza lokuthintela ngokwalo, kwaye (1, −1) alilo chaphaza kumgca othintelayo.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.prompt: Ujonge iibini (a, b) ozifumeneyo, bhala ubudlelwane obuvezwa b ngo-a, uze uchaze ukuba kutheni obo budlelwane busebenza.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.hint.0: Beka amaxabiso ka-a no-b kwimizekelo yakho macala ngamacala kwitheyibhile uthelekise ukuba b yimaxesha amangaphi ka-a.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.hint.1: Cinga ukuba ikhweshini edityanisiweyo yi-cubic nokuba x=a yingcambu injani (ingcambu enye okanye ephindiweyo), uze ubhale iingcambu ezintathu.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.placeholder: umz. Ukulinganisa umgca othintelayo negophe kunika ...
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ngaba usebenzise into yokuba ikhweshini ye-cubic eyenziwe ngumgca othintelayo negophe inengcambu ephindiweyo kwichaphaza lokuthintela?
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ufumene b usebenzisa into yokuba isixa seengcambu ezintathu singu-0, okanye usebenzisa ukwahlula ibe zizinto?
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.model.0: b=−2a. Ukulinganisa umgca othintelayo negophe kunika ikhweshini ye-cubic yefom x³−3x=m(x−a)+a³−3a, kwaye ichaphaza lokuthintela x=a yingcambu ephindiweyo, ngoko inokubhalwa njenge-(x−a)²(x−b). Ikoyifishenti ye-x² yi-0, ngoko isixa seengcambu ezintathu yi-a+a+b=0, nto leyo enika b=−2a.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.model.1: Ndihlolile ukuba iba yi-(x−a)²(x+2a)=0. Ichaphaza lokuthintela yingcambu ephindiweyo, ngoko kukho into (x−a)², kwaye akukho lungu le-x², ngoko ingcambu eseleyo yi-−2a, oko kukuthi, b=−2a.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.prompt: Phakathi kwamachaphaza kwigophe y=x³−3x, kwikhowudinethi ye-x ethini umgca othintelayo kuloo chaphaza ungadibani negophe naphina ngaphandle kwechaphaza lokuthintela?
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.hint.0: Usebenzisa ubudlelwane obufumene kwinyathelo elidlulileyo, fumana ikhowudinethi ye-x yechaphaza apho kudibana khona kwakhona kwichaphaza lokuthintela kwinketho nganye.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.hint.1: Cinga okwenzeka xa ichaphaza apho kudibana khona kwakhona liba lifanayo nechaphaza lokuthintela.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.r.a: Ukuba a=−1, umgca othintelayo udibana negophe kwakhona kwa-x=2.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.r.b: Ucinge ngemeko apho ikhowudinethi ye-x yechaphaza apho kudibana khona kwakhona iba yinto efanayo nechaphaza lokuthintela.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.r.c: Ukuba a=1, umgca othintelayo udibana negophe kwakhona kwa-x=−2.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.r.d: Ukuba a=2, umgca othintelayo udibana negophe kwakhona kwa-x=−4.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.explain: Ikhowudinethi ye-x yechaphaza apho kudibana khona kwakhona yi-−2a, ngoko oku kulingana nechaphaza lokuthintela kuphela xa −2a=a, oko kukuthi, a=0. Umgca othintelayo y=−3x udibana negophe kwichaphaza elinye x=0, ukusuka kwi-x³=0. Eli chaphaza lichaphaza lokugoba legophe nalo.

n-m-h3-diffc-06.title: Ungamchazela njani umfundi osemncinci intsingiselo yokuba i-derivative yesibini ipositivu?
n-m-h3-diffc-06.topic: Ukwenza i-derivative: ukutolika iigrafu, i-derivative yesibini nokuqubuda
n-m-h3-diffc-06.goal: Fumana isivakalisi esingalunganga kwinkcazelo yomfundi ophezulu, siqinisekise ngomzekelo ochasayo, uze usibhale kwakhona njengesivakalisi esichanekileyo esinokuqondwa ngumfundi osemncinci.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.material: Umncinci wakho uHaeun ubuze, "Ukuba f″(x)>0, ingaba igrafu inyuka njengoko iya ngasekunene?" Umfundi ophezulu uJihu wasabela ngokungezantsi. Hlola olu bhalo uze ulubhale kwakhona ukuze uHaeun aluqonde. (f″ yi-derivative ye-derivative ye-f.)
n-m-h3-diffc-06.prereq.2: Intsingiselo yokuqubuda ezantsi (ukuqubuda phezulu) nokuqubuda phezulu (ukuqubuda ezantsi)
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s1.prompt: Khetha isivakalisi esinye esingalunganga kwimpendulo kaJihu.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s1.hint.0: Landela indlela isivakalisi ngasinye esiqhubeka ngayo kwesandulele, esinye ngexesha.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga ukuba uphawu lomsebenzi onokufuneka uwazi ukuze uthi "ixabiso liyanda."
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s1.line.1: I-f′(x) ukwanda kuthetha ukuba ithambeka lomgca othinteleyo liqhubeka likhula.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s1.line.2: Ngoko kwisithuba apho f″(x)>0, ixabiso le-f(x) liyakhula njengoko uya ngasekunene.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s1.explain: Isivakalisi sesi-3 asichanekanga. Ukuba ixabiso le-f(x) liyanda okanye liyancipha kugqitywa luphawu lwe-f′(x). I-f″>0 ikuxelela kuphela ukuba i-f′ iyanda, ngoko kwisithuba apho i-f′ inegethivu, i-f(x) inokuncipha kwaye ihlale ine-f″>0.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s2.prompt: Ngumsebenzi nesithuba esiluphi esibonisa ngokucacileyo ukuba isivakalisi sesi-3 asichanekanga?
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s2.hint.0: Umzekelo ochasayo yimeko apho "umqathango wokuqala uyinyani kodwa isiphelo siyaxoka." Kumsebenzi ngamnye, hlola ngokwahlukeneyo uphawu lwe-f″ nokuba i-f iyanda na.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s2.r.a: Kolu hlu f″=2>0 kwaye f iyanda, ngoko ayiphikisani nesivakalisi 3.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s2.r.b: f″=2>0 kodwa f′=2x<0, ngoko f iyehla. Ngumzekelo ophikisana nesivakalisi 3.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s2.r.d: f″=6x>0 kwaye f iyanda, ngoko ayiphikisani nesivakalisi 3.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s2.explain: Kwa-f(x)=x² ene-x<0, f″(x)=2>0 kodwa f′(x)=2x<0, ngoko f(x) iyehla. Igrafu i-convex ezantsi kodwa iyehla ngethambeka.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.prompt: Phinda ubhale isivakalisi 3 ukuze uHaeun asiqonde. Kufuneka siquke oko f″(x)>0 ikuxelela kona, nokuba yintoni emisela ukuba f(x) iyanda okanye iyehla.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala kwiikholam ezimbini oko f″>0 ikuxelela kona nokungakuxeleli.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.hint.1: Jonga umzekelo ochasayo wenyathelo elidlulileyo uhlole ukuba ixabiso elimisela "ukuhla okanye ukunyuka" luphawu lwe-f, f′, okanye f″.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.placeholder: umz. Ukuba f″(x)>0, ngoko ... kodwa ukuba f iyanda ...
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba uchaze oko f″>0 ikuxelela kona ngokwethambeka okanye ngokwe-convexity?
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ubhale ukuba uphawu lwe-f′ lumisela ukunyuka nokuhla?
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ngaba unike umzekelo ukuze uHaeun alandele ngokujonga iisimboli kuphela?
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.model.0: Ukuba f″(x)>0, ithambeka lomgca othintelayo liqhubeka likhula kwaye igrafu i-convex ezantsi. Kodwa ukuba f(x) iyanda okanye iyehla kumiselwa luphawu lwe-f′(x). Umzekelo, f(x)=x² ine-f″=2>0 kwa-x<0, kodwa f′=2x<0, ngoko iyehla.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.model.1: f″>0 ithetha ukuba f′ iyanda, oko kukuthi, ithambeka liyakhula. Ukuba iya phezulu ekunene kumiselwa kukuba ithambeka libonakalisa ngokongeza, oko kukuthi, f′>0. Ukuba ithambeka lithabatha kwaye liyakhula, liyehla kwaye lisene-f″>0.

n-m-h3-prob-04.topic: Ithuba: ithuba elinemeko, ukuzimela nokuxhomekeka, ukuqiqa kwindlela kaBayes, ukumisela isithuba semizekelo
n-m-h3-prob-04.title: Ukunxiba Iiglasi Nokujoyina Iklabhu: Ukwenza Itheyibhile Yeempawu Ezingahlobananga
n-m-h3-prob-04.goal: Yenza iitheyibhile ezininzi ze-2×2 apho izehlo ezimbini zizimeleyo, uze uhlole indlela yokufunda ukuzimela njengokuthi "amazinga angaphakathi kwamaqela ayalingana."
n-m-h3-prob-04.material: Uza kwenza itheyibhile ebala abafundi abangama-60 kwiklasi ngo-"ukuba banxiba iiglasi" no-"ukuba bajoyine iklabhu."
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.prompt: Abafundi abangama-60 kwiklasi bahlelwe ngo-"ukuba banxiba iiglasi" no-"ukuba bajoyine iklabhu." Sesiphi isibakala esichaza kakuhle oko kuthetha ukuba ezi zimbini zizimele?
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.hint.0: Cinga ukuba, phakathi kwabafundi abanxiba iiglasi kuphela, isabelo esijoyinileyo sifana nesabelo esijoyinileyo lilonke.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.hint.1: Ukuba zizimele, "ukwazi ukuba umfundi unxiba iiglasi akutshintshi ithuba lokujoyina" kufuneka kusebenze. Thelekisa ukuba inketho nganye ithi oku.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.o.a: Inani labafundi abanxiba iiglasi lilingana nenani lalabo bangazinxibi.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.r.a: Ufunde ngokungathi ubungakanani beqela buyalingana. Ukuzimela kumalunga namazinga angaphakathi kwamaqela, hayi ubungakanani bamaqela.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.o.b: Inani lamalungu phakathi kwabafundi abanxiba iiglasi lilingana nenani lamalungu phakathi kwabo bangazinxibi.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.r.b: Uthelekise amanani abantu. Ukuba amaqela amabini anobungakanani obahlukileyo, amazinga ayahluka nokuba amanani abantu alingana.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.o.c: Isabelo samalungu phakathi kwabafundi abanxiba iiglasi silingana nesabelo samalungu phakathi kwabo bangazinxibi.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.o.d: Wonke umfundi onxiba iiglasi ujoyine, kwaye wonke umfundi ongaziniba iiglasi akazange ajoyine.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.r.d: Uphathe iimpawu ezimbini ezihlala zivela kunye njengezizimeleyo. Oko kuyeyona ntlobo iqinileyo yokuxhomekeka, apho ukwazi enye kumisela enye.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.explain: Ukuba isabelo esijoyinileyo phakathi kwabafundi abanxiba iiglasi silingana nesabelo esijoyinileyo phakathi kwabo bangazinxibi, ngoko ukwazi ukuba umfundi unxiba iiglasi akutshintshi ithuba lokujoyina. Oko kukuthi, P(ujoyina|iiglasi)=P(ujoyina), nto leyo ethetha okufanayo ne-P(iiglasi∩ujoyina)=P(iiglasi)P(ujoyina).
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.prompt: Yenza iitheyibhile zabafundi abangama-60. Vumela a = inani lalabo banxiba iiglasi abajoyinileyo, b = abanxiba iiglasi abangazange bajoyine, c = abangazinxibi iiglasi abajoyinileyo, d = abangazinxibi iiglasi abangazange bajoyine. Onke amanani amane kufuneka abe ngamanani emvelo angu-1 ubuncinane ane-sum 60, iiglasi nokujoyina kufuneka kuzimele, kwaye inani labafundi abanxiba iiglasi kufuneka lihluke kunani lamalungu. Ngenisa iitheyibhile ezi-3 ezahlukeneyo.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.hint.0: Kuqala gqiba ngenani labafundi abanxiba iiglasi, x, nenani lamalungu, y. Ukuba bazimele, inani a labafundi abanxiba iiglasi abajoyinileyo kufuneka libe yi-x×y÷60.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha x no-y ukuze a ibe linani eliphelele, emva koko ugcwalise b, c, d eziseleyo ukuze isixa sibe ngama-60, uze uhlole ukuba amazinga amalungu amaqela omabini ayalingana.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.ok.c1: Onke amanani amane ngamanani emvelo angu-1 ubuncinane.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.fail.c1: a, b, c, d kufuneka zonke zibe ngamanani emvelo angu-1 ubuncinane.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.fail.c3: Azizimelanga. Thelekisa izinga lamalungu labafundi abanxiba iiglasi nelo labo bangazinxibi.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.ok.c4: Inani labafundi abanxiba iiglasi lahlukile kunani lamalungu.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.fail.c4: Inani labafundi abanxiba iiglasi lilingana nenani lamalungu.

n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.because.hint.0: Kwitheyibhile oyikhethileyo, kuqala bhala inani labafundi abanee-glasi nabangenazo, emva koko wahlule inani lamalungu eqela ngalinye ngalo.

n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ngaba udibanise amazinga alinganayo kwingcamango yokuba ukunxiba iiglasi akutshintshi ithuba lokujoyina?

Kuba amazinga amabini ayalingana, ukwazi ukuba umfundi unxiba iiglasi akutshintshi ithuba lokujoyina, ngoko bazimele.

n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca wokuqala ongalunganga kwisisombululo sika-Seoyeon.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.title: Ukwahlula okwesibini kwegophe elinikwe yiparameter
n-m-h3-diffc-07.topic: Ukwahlula: ukwahlula okwesibini komsebenzi onikwe ngeparameter
n-m-h3-diffc-07.goal: Kwigophe elinikwe yiparameter, fumana uze ulungise impazamo kwisisombululo esiphinda sahlule u-dy/dx, uze ukhethe ifomyula echanekileyo.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.material: Esi sisisombululo sika-Seoyeon sokufumana ukwahlula okwesibini d²y/dx² kwa-t=2 kwigophe x=t², y=t³−3t (t>0). (t² yi-t isikwere kwaye t³ yi-t i-cube.)
n-m-h3-diffc-07.thinking.2: Thelekisa ulwakhiwo lweekhweshini ukukhetha ifomyula echanekileyo
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s1.hint.0: Qinisekisa ukuba dy/dx kumgca 2 yikhweshini ka-t, uze ucinge ngendlela yokubhala inkqubo yokuyahlula ngokumalunga no-x usebenzisa umthetho weekhonkco.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s1.hint.1: Chaza ngamagama ukuba umgca ngamnye ufumana yiphi i-derivative, uze uvavanye ukuba ulandela ngokusemthethweni emgceni ongaphambili ngomzekelo olula onje nge-x=t², y=t³.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s1.explain: Umgca 3 ngumgca wokuqala ongalunganga. dy/dx yikhweshini ka-t, ngoko ukuyahlula ngokumalunga no-x, kufuneka uyahlule ngokumalunga no-t kuqala emva koko wahlule ngo-dx/dt. Ukwahlula u-y no-x kabini nganye uze wahlule akukho kubala oko. Umgca 4 usebenzisa nje isiphumo somgca 3.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.prompt: Fumana ixabiso le-d²y/dx² kwa-t=2 usebenzisa indlela echanekileyo, uze ubhale indlela oyifumene ngayo.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.hint.0: Yenza lula dy/dx njengekhweshini ka-t, emva koko uyahlule loo khweshini ngokumalunga no-t.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.hint.1: Ukwahlula ngokumalunga no-x, sebenzisa dx/dt ukucinga ukuba yintoni ekufuneka uyahlule ngayo i-derivative ngokumalunga no-t.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba wenze lula dy/dx kuqala njengekhweshini ka-t?
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba wahlule loo khweshini ngokumalunga no-t emva koko wahlula ngo-dx/dt?
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.model.0: dy/dx=(3t²−3)/(2t)=(3/2)(t−1/t), kwaye ukuyahlula ngokumalunga no-t kunika (3/2)(1+1/t²). Ukwahlula oku ngo-dx/dt=2t kunika d²y/dx². Kwa-t=2, (3/2)(5/4)=15/8, ehlulwe ngo-4, inika 15/32.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.model.1: d²y/dx²=(d/dt(dy/dx))÷(dx/dt). Ukufaka t=2 kwi-d/dt{(3/2)(t−1/t)}=(3/2)(1+1/t²) kunika 15/8, kwaye ukwahlula ngo-dx/dt=4 kunika 15/32.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.prompt: Khetha ifomyula echanekileyo yokufumana d²y/dx² kwigophe elinikwe yiparameter.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.hint.0: Kuqala bhala ukuba d²y/dx² inokufundwa njenge-"ukwahlula ntoni ngokumalunga nantoni."
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.hint.1: Sebenzisa umthetho weekhonkco ukucinga ukuba yintoni ekufuneka uyiphindaphinde okanye uyahlule ngayo ukuguqula ukwahlula ngokumalunga no-t kube kukwahlula ngokumalunga no-x.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.o.a: Yahlula u-y owahlulwe kabini ngokumalunga no-t ngo-x owahlulwe kabini ngokumalunga no-t
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.r.a: Le yindlela eyasetyenziswa ngu-Seoyeon. Umlinganiselo wamaxabiso ahlulwe kabini ngokumalunga no-t wahlukile kwi-dy/dx ehlulwe ngokumalunga no-x.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.o.b: Yahlula u-dy/dx owahlulwe kanye ngokumalunga no-t ngo-x owahlulwe kanye ngokumalunga no-t
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.r.b: Oku kuvakalisa inkqubo yokwahlula u-dy/dx ngokumalunga no-x usebenzisa umthetho weekhonkco.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.o.c: Yahlula u-dy/dx owahlulwe kanye ngokumalunga no-t ngo-x owahlulwe kabini ngokumalunga no-t
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.r.c: Ubeke ukwahlula okwesibini kuka-x kwinani elingaphantsi. Ukuguqulela ekwahluleni ngokumalunga no-x, wahlula ngo-dx/dt kanye.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.o.d: Yahlula u-dy/dx owahlulwe kanye ngokumalunga no-t ngesikwere sika-x owahlulwe kanye ngokumalunga no-t
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.r.d: Wenze isikwere inani elingaphantsi. Kumthetho weekhonkco, into kuphela oyahlula ngayo ukuguqula ukwahlula ngokumalunga no-t kube kukwahlula ngokumalunga no-x yi-dx/dt, kanye.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.explain: d²y/dx²=d/dx(dy/dx)=[d/dt(dy/dx)]·(dt/dx)=[d/dt(dy/dx)]÷(dx/dt). Kwa-t=2, iifomyula ezingentla zinika 6, 15/16, kunye ne-15/128 ngokulandelelana, ezahlukileyo kwixabiso elichanekileyo 15/32.

n-m-h3-conic-03.topic: Izahlulo zekhonikhi: iinkcazo nemigca ethintelayo yeparabola, ye-ellipse, neye-hyperbola; ukuhambelana phakathi kweemo neekhweshini
n-m-h3-conic-03.title: Indawo yechaphaza P itshintsha njani xa ichaphaza F lihamba?
n-m-h3-conic-03.goal: Qinisekisa ngeenkcazo ukuba kolwakhiwo olufanayo, ukutshintsha indawo yechaphaza F kutshintsha indawo ibe sisangqa, i-ellipse, okanye i-hyperbola, uze wakhe isiqhelo sokungathwali isigqibo kwimeko enye usise kwenye ngaphandle kotshintsho.
n-m-h3-conic-03.material: Kwiplani kukho isangqa esinesazulu O nerediyasi 6, nechaphaza F. Kwichaphaza Q elihamba kwisangqa, vumela P ibe lichaphaza apho umgca othe nkqo wokwahlula ngeqingatha isahlulo somgca FQ udibana khona nomgca OQ. Siza kuphanda imo ezotywa ngu-P njengoko Q ihamba kwisangqa, sitshintsha indawo ka-F.
n-m-h3-conic-03.thinking.0: Hlaziya isigwebo sakho ixesha ngalinye xa imeko itshintsha
n-m-h3-conic-03.thinking.1: Fumana indawo usebenzisa isixa nomahluko wemigama
n-m-h3-conic-03.prereq.0: Iinkcazo ze-ellipse nee-hyperbola (isixa semigama, umahluko wemigama)
n-m-h3-conic-03.prereq.1: Ipropati yokuba ichaphaza elisemgceni othe nkqo wokwahlula isahlulo somgca ngeqingatha likumgama ofanayo neziphelo ezimbini
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.prompt: Ulwazi luvezwa isiqwenga esinye ngexesha njengoko indawo yechaphaza F itshintsha. Kwinyathelo ngalinye, khetha isigwebo ngokusekelwe kuphela koko uyaziyo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.hint.0: Ixesha ngalinye xa kuvela ulwazi olutsha, zoba umfanekiso obonisa apho ichaphaza P lilele khona kwisahlulo somgca OQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.hint.1: Sebenzisa PF=PQ ukuhlola ukuba isixa okanye umahluko we-PO ne-PF wenziwa lula ube lixabiso elingatshintshiyo.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Kuqala cinga ngemeko apho F lichaphaza elifanayo nesazulu O. Ichaphaza elisemgceni othe nkqo wokwahlula isahlulo somgca FQ likumgama ofanayo no-F no-Q, ngoko PF=PQ. Ichaphaza P lilele kumgca OQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Njengoko Q ijikeleza isangqa kanye, P izoba mo ni?
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Ukuba F=O, ngoko PO=PQ kwaye PO+PQ=OQ=6, ngoko PO=3. P lichaphaza elikumgama ongu-3 ukusuka ku-O, ngoko izoba isangqa esinerediyasi 3.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Uphinde wachaza nje isangqa esizotywa ngu-Q. P ayingu-Q; lichaphaza elisemgceni othe nkqo wokwahlula u-FQ ngeqingatha.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ubone ukuba P ikumgama ongatshintshiyo ukusuka ku-O.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: I-ellipse enee-fokasi O kunye nechaphaza elithile
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Asikaphumi kwimeko enee-fokasi ezimbini. F no-O lichaphaza elifanayo.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Xa Q ihamba, P ihamba nayo.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.info: F ihanjiswe yaya kwichaphaza elingaphakathi kwesangqa, elikumgama ongu-4 ukusuka ku-O. Kusengunyaniso ukuba PF=PQ. Ukuba uzoba umfanekiso, P ilele kwisahlulo somgca OQ (phakathi kuka-O no-Q).
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Kuba P ikwisahlulo somgca OQ, PO+PF=PO+PQ=OQ=6. Isixa semigama ukusuka kumachaphaza amabini O no-F sisigxina i-6, ngoko yi-ellipse enee-fokasi O no-F kunye ne-major axis yobude be-6.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Isengesangqa esinesazulu O: kuba Q ikwisangqa
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Xa F ishiya u-O, PO ayisasisigxina. Uthwale isigqibo senyathelo langaphambili njengoko sinjalo.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: I-hyperbola enomahluko osisigxina wemigama ukusuka ku-O no-F
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: I-hyperbola enomahluko osisigxina wemigama ukusuka ku-O no-F
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Awuhlolanga ukuba PO no-PF zidityanisiwe okanye zithabathiwe. Sebenzisa into yokuba P ikwisahlulo somgca OQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: I-ellipse enesixa sobude esisisigxina ukusuka ku-O no-F
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ubone ukuba isixa sisisigxina, kuba PO+PF=PO+PQ=OQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Iparabola enamachaphaza alinganayo ukusuka ku-F nomgca
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Imigama elinganayo bubudlelwane phakathi kuka-F no-Q (PF=PQ), kwaye ngumgama oya kwichaphaza Q, hayi emgceni.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Ngeli xesha F ihanjiswe yaya kwichaphaza elingaphandle kwesangqa, elikumgama ongu-9 ukusuka ku-O. Ukuba uzoba umfanekiso, P ayikho kwisahlulo somgca OQ kodwa ikwiyelelo lomgca OQ (ecaleni lika-Q okanye ecaleni luka-O). Kusengunyaniso ukuba PF=PQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Kwolwandiso kwicala le-Q, PO=OQ+PQ, ngoko PO−PF=6, kwaye kwolwandiso kwicala le-O, PF−PO=6. Nakweyiphi na imeko, |PO−PF|=6 iyinto engatshintshiyo, ngoko yi-hyperbola enezixhobo O no-F kunye ne-eksisi ephambukayo yobude be-6 (OF=9>6).
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Uyidlulisele ngaphandle kotshintsho into eyafunyanwa kwimeko yangaphakathi. Ukuba i-P ayikho kwisahlulo se-OQ, i-PO+PQ ayilingani ne-OQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Khangela ukuba i-PO ayitshintshi na. Ukuba i-F ikude ne-O, iyatshintsha.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Umgca ohlula ucezu phakathi ime nkqo kunye nomgca we-OQ badibana kuphantse yonke i-Q.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.reflect: Njengoko indawo ye-F yatshintsha, oluakhiwo lufanayo lwanika isangqa, i-ellipse kunye ne-hyperbola ngokulandelelana. Ukuyidlulisela ngaphandle kotshintsho into yangaphakathi ekwimeko yangaphandle akuchanekanga. Kuxhomekeke ekubeni ichaphaza le-P likwisahlulo se-OQ okanye kolwandiso lwaso, kwatshintsha ukuba sisixa okanye umahluko we-PO kunye ne-PF ongatshintshiyo.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.prompt: Chaza isizathu sokuba indawo yokuhamba ye-P ahluke xa i-F ingaphakathi kwesangqa nxa i-F ingaphandle kwesangqa, usebenzisa i-PO, i-PF kunye nerediyasi i-6 yesangqa.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.hint.0: Yitsho ukuba i-P ikuphi kumgca we-OQ kwimeko yangaphakathi nakwimeko yangaphandle.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.hint.1: Kwimeko nganye, dibanisa ubudlelwane phakathi kwe-PO kunye ne-PQ nobude obungu-6.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ubhale ukuba i-PO+PF=6 ngaphakathi kwaye |PO−PF|=6 ngaphandle?
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingaba uchazile ukuba isixa nomahluko ziyahlukana ngenxa yokuba indawo ye-P (kwisahlulo okanye kolwandiso) iyahluka?
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.model.0: Ukuba i-F ingaphakathi, i-P ikwisahlulo se-OQ, ngoko PO+PF=PO+PQ=6, isixa asitshintshi, kwaye yi-ellipse. Ukuba i-F ingaphandle, i-P ikolwandiso, ngoko umahluko we-PO kunye ne-PQ ngu-6, umahluko we-PO kunye ne-PF yi-6 engatshintshiyo, kwaye yi-hyperbola.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.model.1: Ukuba i-F ingaphakathi kwesangqa, isixa semigama esuka ku-O nakwi-F si-6, ngoko yi-ellipse, kwaye ukuba i-F ingaphandle kwesangqa, ixabiso elipheleleyo lomahluko wemigama yi-6 engatshintshiyo, ngoko yi-hyperbola. Oku kungenxa yokuba i-P ikwisahlulo okanye kolwandiso iyatshintsha.

n-m-h3-conic-06.topic: Izahlulo zekhonikhi: iinkcazo nemigca ethintelayo yeparabola, ye-ellipse, neye-hyperbola; ukuhambelana phakathi kweemo neekhweshini
n-m-h3-conic-06.title: Ziya phi ifokhasi kunye ne-directrix xa iparabola ihanjiswa?
n-m-h3-conic-06.goal: Funda ngokuchanekileyo icala lokuhambisa kulingano, hambisa ifokhasi kunye ne-directrix ngokuhambisa okufanayo, uze ubhale inkcazo yomfundi omncinci.
n-m-h3-conic-06.material: Umncinci wakho uHaeun ukuthumelele inqaku ngelixa efuna ifokhasi kunye ne-directrix yeparabola (y−1)² = −8(x+2).
n-m-h3-conic-06.thinking.0: Ukufunda ukuba iimpawu zikulingano zihambelana njani nicala lokuhamba
n-m-h3-conic-06.thinking.2: Ukuphinda ubhale inkcazo ukuze ihambelane nomntu omchazela
n-m-h3-conic-06.prereq.1: Ukuhambisa kunye nendlela ukulingana okutshintsha ngayo
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.prompt: Eli yinqaku elithunyelwe ngumncinci wakho uHaeun. Khetha umgca wokuqala olahlekileyo.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.hint.0: Okokuqala fumana ichaphaza kulingano olutsha apho macala omabini ngu-0. Ulithelekise nalapho eso sikhundla besidlalwa kulingano lwakudala.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.hint.1: Hlula ukuba ukubalwa komgca ngamnye kulandela kumgca wangaphambili okanye kukumiselwa okutsha.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.line.0: Kwi-y² = −8x, 4p = −8, ngoko p = −2, ifokhasi yi-(−2, 0), kwaye i-directrix yi-x = 2.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.line.1: I-(y−1)² = −8(x+2) ine-x+2 ne-y−1, ngoko yi-y² = −8x ehanjiswe nge-+2 kwicala le-x kunye ne-−1 kwicala le-y.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.line.3: Ukuhambisa i-directrix ngendlela efanayo kunika x = 2+2 = 4.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.line.4: Ngoko ifokhasi yi-(0, −1) kwaye i-directrix yi-x = 4.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.explain: Ngumgca 2. Ukufaka i-x+2 endaweni ye-x kuhambisa nge-−2 kwicala le-x, kwaye ukufaka i-y−1 endaweni ye-y kuhambisa nge-+1 kwicala le-y. Iimpawu ziphikisana. Yonke into ukususela kumgca 3 ukuya phambili kukubalwa okulandela icala lomgca 2, ngoko ukuba icala alichanekanga, yonke ayichanekanga. Umgca 1 uchanekile.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.prompt: Khetha indlela enokuthenjwa kakhulu yokujonga ukuba icala likaHaeun lokuhambisa lichanekile na.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.hint.0: Cinga ngokuba ichaphaza elihambelana nencopho endala linaluphi uphawu kulingano olutsha lwesimo esihanjisiweyo.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.hint.1: Okokuqala khumbula ukuba ifokhasi kunye ne-directrix zikwijika na.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.o.a: Faka ifokhasi efunyenweyo, (0, −1), ukubona ukuba iyanelisa na ukulingana okutsha (y−1)² = −8(x+2).
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.r.a: Ifokhasi asiyichaphaza elikwijika, ngoko akufuneki inelise ukulingana xa ifakwa. Ngoko oku kujonga akunakuxela icala lokuhambisa.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.o.b: Thelekisa ukuba ikoyifishenti −8 kulingano olutsha ifana na nekoyifishenti kulingano lokuqala.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.r.b: Ikoyifishenti ixela kuphela ubume (icala elivulekayo nobubanzi baso). Ayixeli ukuba indawo yahanjiswa kweliphi icala.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.o.c: Fumana ichaphaza apho macala omabini kulingano olutsha ngu-0 uze ubone ukuba lilapho incopho endala (0, 0) yahambela khona.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.o.d: Zoba igrafu ngokubanzi uze ubone ukuba icala elivulekayo lifana nangaphambili.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.r.d: Ukuhambisa akutshintshi icala elivulekayo, ngoko lijongeka linjalo nokuba icala lokuhambisa alichanekanga.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.explain: Incopho yayiyichaphaza (0, 0) apho macala omabini kulingano lwakudala ngu-0, ngoko ichaphaza (−2, 1) apho macala omabini kulingano olutsha ngu-0 yindawo eyahambela kuyo incopho. Ngoko ukuhambisa kuyi-−2 ecaleni le-eksisi ye-x kunye ne-+1 ecaleni le-eksisi ye-y. Ifokhasi kunye ne-directrix ayizichaphaza ezikwijika, ngoko awukwazi ukuzijonga ngokuzifaka kulingano.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.prompt: UHaeun ungumfundi wonyaka wokuqala wesekondari ophumelele ukufunda ukuhambisa. Bhala impendulo yokuthumela kuHaeun. Kufuneka ibandakanye apho kwahamba khona kakubi, icala elichanekileyo lokuhambisa, ifokhasi kunye ne-directrix echanekileyo, nendlela yokujonga.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.hint.0: Nqumela ukulandelelana kwempendulo: apho kwahamba khona kakubi, ukuhambisa okulungisiweyo, ifokhasi kunye ne-directrix, indlela yokujonga.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.hint.1: Usebenzisa ukuhambisa okulungisiweyo, hambisa incopho, ifokhasi kunye ne-directrix yokulingana kwangaphambili.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ukhombe apho kwahamba khona kakubi ngamagama anokuqondwa nguHaeun?
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ubonise ukuba ifokhasi kunye ne-directrix zahamba njani ukusuka kwiindawo zazo zakudala?
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.model.0: Haeun, icala liphambene kumgca 2. Ukuba i-x+2 ifakwa endaweni ye-x, igrafu ihanjiswa nge-−2 kwicala le-x, kwaye nge-y−1 ihanjiswa nge-+1 kwicala le-y. Ichaphaza kulingano olutsha apho macala omabini ngu-0 yi-(−2, 1), ngoko ungabona ukuba incopho yahamba isuka kwi-(0, 0) iya apho. Ngoko ifokhasi (−2, 0) ihamba iye kwi-(−4, 1), kwaye i-directrix x=2 ihamba iye kwi-x=0.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.model.1: Haeun, icala lokuhambisa kumgca 2 alichanekanga. I-(x+2) ihambisa i-2 ekhohlo, kwaye i-(y−1) ihambisa i-1 phezulu. Ungajonga ngokufaka ukuba incopho yi-(−2, 1). Ngoko ifokhasi yi-(−4, 1) kwaye i-directrix yi-x = 0.

n-m-h3-diffc-01.title: Sifanele sifunde njani ithambeka elinenani elingaphantsi elingu-0?
n-m-h3-diffc-01.topic: Ukwahlula: ukwahlula okungathe ngqo namagama athinteleyo kumachaphaza apho ithambeka lingachazwanga
n-m-h3-diffc-01.goal: Phanda ukuba umgca othinteleyo ukho na kwichaphaza apho inani elingaphantsi lethambeka elifunyenwe ngokwahlula okungathe ngqo lingu-0, uze ufumane ulungise isigqibo esiphosakeleyo kwisisombululo.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.material: Esi sisisombululo sikaHayoon sokufumana umgca othinteleyo kwichaphaza P(2, −1) kujika C: x²+xy+y²=3. (x² no-y² zithetha u-x isikwere no-y isikwere. Ukuba ichaphaza P likwi-C kukhangelwe nge-4−2+1=3.)
n-m-h3-diffc-01.thinking.1: Tolika umgca othinteleyo apho ithambeka lingachazwanga njengemilo yegrafu
n-m-h3-diffc-01.prereq.0: Ukwahlula okungathe ngqo (phatha u-y njengomsebenzi we-x uwahlule macala omabini ngokwe-x)
n-m-h3-diffc-01.prereq.1: Ukufumana ulingano lomgca othinteleyo kwichaphaza elikwijika
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca wokuqala ophosakeleyo kwisisombululo sikaHayoon.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.hint.0: Funda umgca ngamnye ukususela phezulu ukhangele ngokubala ngqo ukuba ulandela kumgca ongaphambi kwawo na.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.hint.1: Thelekisa ukuba isigqibo somgca wokugqibela sithi okufanayo nenyaniso efunyenwe kumgca wangaphambili (into engachazwanga).
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.line.0: Ukwahlula macala omabini ngokwe-x kunika 2x + (y + x·y′) + 2y·y′ = 0.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.line.2: Ukufaka u-P(2, −1), inani elingaphantsi x+2y li-2+2·(−1)=0, ngoko ithambeka alichazwanga.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.line.3: Ngoko akukho mgca othinteleyo kwichaphaza P.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.explain: Umgca wesi-4 uphosakele. Ukubala kwemigca emi-1 ukuya kwemi-3 kuchanekile. Kodwa "igama lethambeka alichazwanga" lithetha "akukho nani elibizwa ngokuba lithambeka," hayi ukuba akukho mgca othinteleyo. Inani elingasentla 2x+y=3 alingu-0, ngoko ithambeka linokukhula ngaphandle komda, oko kukuthi umgca othinteleyo oyafana ne-eksisi ye-y unokwenzeka.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.prompt: Ukuba kukho umgca othinteleyo kujika C kwichaphaza P, bhala ulingano lwawo, ubhale nesizathu sokugweba kwakho.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.hint.0: Bala ukuba inani elingasentla lithatha lixabiso lini ngoxa inani elingaphantsi lingu-0, uze ucinge ukuba ithambeka liba likhulu kangakanani.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.hint.1: Zoba ukuba umgca onethambeka elikhula ngaphandle komda ubonakala njani kwiplani yeekhowudinethi, uze ubhale ulingano lomgca lowo odlula kwichaphaza P.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ukhangele ukuba inani elingaphantsi lingu-0 kodwa elingasentla alingu-0?
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ufake x=2 kulingano lwejika ujonge ukuba ijika nomgca badibana njani?
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ngaba unokuchaza umahluko phakathi kwe-"akukho thambeka" ne-"akukho mgca othinteleyo"?
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.model.0: Inani elingaphantsi lingu-0 kwaye elingasentla li-3, ngoko ithambeka likhula ngaphandle komda. Ngoko umgca othinteleyo ngumgca x=2, oyafana ne-eksisi ye-y. Ukufaka x=2 kujika kunika y²+2y+1=0, ngoko y=−1 sisisombululo esiyodwa, oko kuthetha ukuba umgca uthinta nje ijika kwichaphaza P, nako kuhambelana.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.model.1: Kukho umgca othinteleyo. Ithambeka alichazwanga kuba umgca othinteleyo uthe nkqo, kwaye ulingano lwawo lu-x=2. Ndikhangele nokuba inani elingasentla 2x+y li-3, hayi u-0, ngoko asiyiyo ifom ethi 0/0.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Kwanele ukukhangela inani elingasentla, nokuba awusebenzisi indlela yokufaka x=2 kujika.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.prompt: Yintoni ekufuneka uyikhangele ngaphambi kokugqiba ukuba "kukho umgca othinteleyo othe nkqo" kwichaphaza apho inani elingaphantsi legama lethambeka lingu-0?
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.hint.0: Kwifom y′ = (inani elingasentla)/(inani elingaphantsi), thelekisa ukuba iqhezu libonakala lahlukile njani xa inani elingaphantsi lingu-0 kwaye ixabiso lenani elingasentla lahlukile.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.hint.1: Ngaba iifom 0/0 no-3/0 yimeko enye? Cinga ukuba nganye ithini.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.o.a: Ukuba, xa inani elingaphantsi lingu-0, inani elingasentla nalo alingu-0 (oko kukuthi, ukuba asiyiyo ifom ethi 0/0)
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.o.b: Ukuba ixabiso lika-y alinegethivu xa ichaphaza likujika
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.r.b: Uphawu lwe-y alunanto yokwenza nokuba umgca othinteleyo ukho na. Usenokuba uxubile uphawu lwekhowudinethi necala lomgca othinteleyo.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.o.c: Ukuba ixabiso elihlahlwe kabini y″ alingu-0
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.r.c: Ukwahlula okwesibini kukuxelela kuphela icala apho ijika libhegayo; akumiseli ukuba umgca othinteleyo ukho na.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.o.d: Ukuba ijika linokubhalwa ngefom y = (igama le-x)
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.r.d: Umgca othinteleyo ukho nokuba umsebenzi ongathe ngqo awunakubhalwa ngefom y=f(x). Le meko ayifuneki.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.explain: Nokuba inani elingaphantsi lingu-0, ukuba elingasentla alingu-0, ithambeka likhula ngaphandle komda kwaye kuvela umgca othinteleyo othe nkqo. Ukuba nenani elingasentla lingu-0, yifom 0/0, ngoko eli gama lodwa alinakugqiba, kwaye kufuneka ujonge imilo yejika kuloo chaphaza ngenye indlela.

n-m-h3-diffc-02.title: Ngomzuzu apho isantya singu-0, ngaba ichaphaza liyajika?
n-m-h3-diffc-02.topic: Ukwahlula: isantya nokukhawuleza, iimeko zotshintsho lwecala
n-m-h3-diffc-02.goal: Qonda, ngotshintsho loluphawu lwesantya, umahluko phakathi komzuzu apho isantya singu-0 nomzuzu apho icala lentshukumo litshintsha khona, uze wakhe ukhangele ngokwakho amagama esantya anelisa iimeko.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.material: Isantya sechaphaza P elishukuma kumgca wamanani ngexesha t (t≥0) yi-v(t), kwaye v(1)=0. UMinsu wathi, "Ngomzuzu apho isantya singu-0, ichaphaza liyatshintsha icala ngokuqinisekileyo." (Ukutshintsha icala kuthetha ukusuka ekuhambeni ngasekunene uye ekuhambeni ngasekhohlo, okanye ukusuka ekuhambeni ngasekhohlo uye ekuhambeni ngasekunene. Ukuba isantya sipositivu, lishukuma ngasekunene; ukuba sinegethivu, ngasekhohlo.)
n-m-h3-diffc-02.thinking.1: Yakha uqinisekise amagama esantya anelisa iimeko
n-m-h3-diffc-02.thinking.2: Hlela oko kunokugwetywa ngamaxabiso esantya nokukhawuleza kuphela
n-m-h3-diffc-02.prereq.0: Ubudlelwane phakathi kwendawo, isantya, nokukhawuleza (isantya yi-derivative yendawo, ukukhawuleza yi-derivative yesantya)
n-m-h3-diffc-02.prereq.1: Ubudlelwane phakathi kophawu lwesantya necala lentshukumo
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.prompt: Khetha isivakalisi esithetha okufanayo ne-"ichaphaza P litshintsha icala ngexesha t₀."
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ubhale ukuba ichaphaza lishukuma ngaluphi uhlangothi xa isantya sipositivu nalapho sinegethivu.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga ukuba uphawu lwesantya kufuneka lwenze ntoni ukuze icala litshintshe, uze uthelekise nemeko apho siba ngu-0 emva koko sibuye kuphawu olufanayo.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.r.a: Nokuba ukukhawuleza akungu-0, ukuba isantya asingu-0 icala lihlala linjalo. Usenokuba uxubile isantya nokukhawuleza.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.o.b: Indawo kwi-t₀ inkulu kuneendawo zamaxesha onke ngaphambi nangasemva nje
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.r.b: Oku kucinga kuphela ngexesha apho indawo inkulu kakhulu (isiphelo sasekunene). Kushiya imeko yokujika kwisiphelo sasekhohlo.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.r.c: v(t₀)=0 yimpawu enye kuphela yomzuzu wotshintsho lwecala, asisivakalisi esifanayo. Cinga ngemeko apho v=0 kodwa uphawu lusala lunjalo.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.o.d: Iimpawu zesantya ngaphambi nangasemva nje kwe-t₀ ziyahluka
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.r.d: Ubone utshintsho lwecala ngotshintsho loluphawu lwesantya.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.explain: Icala litshintsha xa uphawu lwesantya luguquka lusuka kupositivu lusiya kunegethivu okanye lusuka kunegethivu lusiya kupositivu. Isantya ukuba singu-0 yimeko eyimfuneko eyenzeka ngomzuzu wotshintsho loluphawu, kodwa ayonelanga.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.prompt: Xa isantya sinikwa yi-v(t)=(t−1)^m (t−p)^n, faka iitripele ezimbini okanye ngaphezulu ezahlukeneyo (m, n, p) ezinelisa zonke ezi zilandelayo: ichaphaza P alitshintshi icala ku-t=1, kwaye litshintsha icala ku-t=p. (m no-n ngamanani endalo asuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-6, kwaye p linani lendalo elisuka kwi-2 ukuya kwi-9.)
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.hint.0: Zama amaxabiso amaninzi e-m ne-n wenze itheyibhile yeempawu ze-(t−1)^m kunye ne-(t−p)^n ngaphambi nangasemva nje kwe-t=1 ne-t=p.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.hint.1: Yahlula kwiimeko apho isikhuphi singamnye nesisipheyiri, uze uthelekise ukuba uphawu lufanayo okanye luyahluka ngaphambi nangasemva nje kwelo chaphaza.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.ok.c1: m, n, kunye no-p ngamanani endalo aphakathi koluhlu.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Uphawu lwesantya lufanayo ngaphambi nangasemva nje kwe-t=1.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Uphawu lwesantya luyatshintsha ngaphambi nangasemva nje kwe-t=1, ngoko ichaphaza litshintsha icala.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.ok.c3: Uphawu lwesantya luyahluka ngaphambi nangasemva nje kwe-t=p.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Uphawu lwesantya lufanayo ngaphambi nangasemva nje kwe-t=p, ngoko ichaphaza alitshintshi icala.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.explain: Ukuba isikhuphi se-(t−1) siyipheyiri, esi sibalayo sinophawu olufanayo ngaphambi nangasemva nje kwe-t=1, kwaye ukuba isikhuphi se-(t−p) singumangqabangqaba, uphawu luyahluka ngaphambi nangasemva nje kwe-t=p. Ezinye izinto ezibalayo azitshintshi uphawu ekufuphi nelo chaphaza (p≥2). Kwi-(1, 1, 3), uphawu lutshintsha nakwi-t=1, kwaye kwi-(2, 2, 3), alutshintshi kwi-t=3.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Khetha omnye wemizekelo oyifumeneyo ubhale ukuba kutheni ichaphaza lingatshintshi icala kwi-t=1 nangona v(1)=0.
