n-m-h3-diffc-03.title: Singayifumana ithambeka lomsebenzi oxubeneyo ngamaxabiso asetyeyibhileni?
n-m-h3-diffc-03.topic: Ukwahlula: i-derivative yomsebenzi oxubeneyo namatheyibhile amaxabiso omsebenzi namaxabiso e-derivative
n-m-h3-diffc-03.goal: Xa ufumana i-derivative yomsebenzi oxubeneyo, gqiba ukuba kufuneka ifundwe kweliphi ichaphaza i-derivative yomsebenzi wangaphandle, uze uhlele oko kunokufunyanwa ngamaxabiso asetyeyibhileni kuphela.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.material:
Amaxabiso emisebenzi emibini enokwahlulwa f no-g injengoko kusetyeyibhile engezantsi. Amaxabiso angekho kwitheyibhile awaziwa. (f∘g)(x) ithetha f(g(x)), kwaye (g∘f)(x) ithetha g(f(x)).
 x=1: f(1)=3, f′(1)=4, g(1)=2, g′(1)=−3
 x=2: f(2)=5, f′(2)=7, g(2)=1, g′(2)=6
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.prompt: Khetha onke amaxabiso asetyenziselwa ukufumana i-(f∘g)′(1).
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala i-derivative yomsebenzi oxubeneyo f(g(x)) njengemveliso yecandelo langaphandle nelangaphakathi, uze ujonge ukuba icandelo langaphandle lithatha lixabiso lini njengegalelo.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.hint.1: Sebenzisa inyani yokuba xa x=1, isiphumo sokufaka u-1 kwi-g sibe ligalelo le-f ukugqiba ukuba zeziphi izinto ekufuneka zifundwe kwitheyibhile.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.r.a: Ufunde ithambeka le-f kwi-x=1. Umsebenzi wangaphandle f kufuneka usebenzise ithambeka lawo kwixabiso lomsebenzi wangaphakathi, g(1).
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.r.b: Ufunde i-derivative yomsebenzi wangaphandle kwixabiso lomsebenzi wangaphakathi, g(1).
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.r.c: I-g(1) iyafuneka ukugqiba ukuba umsebenzi ongaphandle wenziwa i-derivative kweliphi ichaphaza.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.r.d: Ucinge ngenxalenye apho i-derivative yomsebenzi ongaphakathi iphindaphindwa.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.r.e: I-g′(2) lithambeka xa x=2, ngoko alisetyenziswa kwixabiso elifunwayo xa x=1.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.r.f: Ixabiso lomsebenzi f(2) bubude, ayilothambeka, ngoko alisetyenziswa ekubaleni i-derivative.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.explain: (f∘g)′(1)=f′(g(1))·g′(1). Ekubeni g(1)=2, funda f′(2)=7 uphindaphinde nge-g′(1)=−3 ukufumana −21. Inqaku eliphambili kukusebenzisa i-f′(g(1)), hayi i-f′(1).
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.acc.0: I-g(1)=2 lixabiso elisetyenziselwa ukugqiba ukuba i-f′ ifundwa kweliphi ichaphaza, ngoko alivelanga ngokuthe ngqo ekuphindaphindeni, kodwa ukuphindaphinda i-f′(2) kuphela ne-g′(1) kuyafana nokubala.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.prompt: Khetha onke amaxabiso amiselwa ngamaxabiso asetheyibhileni kuphela.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.hint.0: Kumsebenzi ngamnye odityanisiweyo, kuqala fumana ubhale ixabiso lomsebenzi ongaphakathi.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ukuba i-derivative yomsebenzi ongaphandle kuloo nto ifakwayo isetheyibhileni na.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.r.a: Siyayidinga ithambeka g′(3) kwi-g(f(1))=g(3), kodwa alikho setheyibhileni. Ukusebenzisa i-g′(1) esetheyibhileni kusebenzisa ichaphaza elahlukileyo lokufaka.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.r.b: Ithambeka f′(2) kwisithuba somsebenzi ongaphandle g(1)=2 lisetheyibhileni.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.r.c: Siyayidinga ithambeka g′(5) kwi-g(f(2))=g(5), kodwa alikho setheyibhileni.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.r.d: Ithambeka f′(1) kwisithuba somsebenzi ongaphandle g(2)=1 lisetheyibhileni.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.explain: I-derivative yomsebenzi odityanisiweyo ingafunyanwa kuphela ukuba itheyibhile inethambeka lomsebenzi ongaphandle elifundwe kwixabiso lomsebenzi ongaphakathi. Kwi-(f∘g)′, amaxabiso e-g, 2 no-1, omabini ngamaxabiso e-x asetheyibhileni, ngoko kuyenzeka, kwaye kwi-(g∘f)′, amaxabiso e-f, 3 no-5, ngamaxabiso e-x angekho setheyibhileni.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.prompt: Fumana ixabiso le-(f∘g)′(2). Bhala nesizathu sokuba kulihlazo ukubala f′(2)·g′(2)=42.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.hint.0: Kuqala funda ixabiso le-g(2) kwitheyibhile uze ugqibe ukuba umsebenzi ongaphandle wenziwa i-derivative kweliphi ichaphaza.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.hint.1: Kwindlela yokubala enike i-42, thelekisa ichaphaza apho ufunde khona i-derivative ye-f nexabiso elingena ngenene kwi-f.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ufumene g(2) kuqala wagqiba ukuba ufunde kweliphi ichaphaza lomsebenzi ongaphandle?
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba uthe ithambeka lalicephi ichaphaza elixubene kwixabiso le-42?
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.model.0: g(2)=1, ngoko i-f′ kufuneka ifundwe kwi-1, kunika (f∘g)′(2)=f′(1)·g′(2)=4×6=24. I-f′(2)·g′(2) ifunda ithambeka le-f xa x=2, kodwa ixabiso elingena kwi-f aliyi-2 kodwa yi-g(2)=1, ngoko kulihlazo.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.model.1: I-derivative yomsebenzi odityanisiweyo yi-f′(g(2))g′(2). Ekubeni g(2)=1, f′(1)=4 kwaye g′(2)=6, kwaye imveliso yi-24. I-42 ayichanekanga kuba isebenzise i-f′(2)=7.

n-m-h3-dist-02.title: Sinokuyibiza nini ukwabiwa kwebinomiyali ukuba sikhupha iibhola ezintathu?
n-m-h3-dist-02.topic: Ukwabiwa kwamathuba: iimeko zokuba ukwabiwa kwebinomiyali kusebenze
n-m-h3-dist-02.goal: Khetha ulwazi olufuneka ngokupheleleyo ukugweba ukuba linokuphathwa njengokwabiwa kwebinomiyali, uze ubonise ngamanani indlela ithuba elitshintsha ngayo xa olo lwazi lutshintsha.
n-m-h3-dist-02.material: Ibhokisi iqulethe iibhola ezi-3 ezimhlophe neebhola ezi-2 ezimnyama. U-Seoyun uthe, "Inani X leebhola ezimhlophe xa kukhutshwa iibhola ezi-3 lilandela ukwabiwa kwebinomiyali B(3, 3/5)." Ukuba u-Seoyun uchanekile na akunakwaziwa kwezi zibhaliweyo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku.
n-m-h3-dist-02.thinking.0: Wahlula ulwazi olubalulekileyo ekugwebeni kolo olungabalulekanga
n-m-h3-dist-02.thinking.1: Hlola ngokubala umahluko ovelayo xa imeko iphuka
n-m-h3-dist-02.prereq.0: Intsingiselo yokwabiwa kwebinomiyali B(n,p): yenza ukuvavanywa okuzimeleyo okungu-n, ngalinye linethuba elifanayo lempumelelo p
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.prompt: Kufuneka wazi ntoni ukugweba ukuba u-Seoyun uchanekile?
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kuqala khumbula ukuba ukuvavanywa kufuneka kube neepropati ezithini ukuze kusetyenziswe ukwabiwa kwebinomiyali.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.hint.1: Gqiba nganye nganye ukuba inketho nganye ihlola loo propati, okanye ibuza nje into esele yaziwa.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.o.a: Bala kwakhona ukuhlola ukuba ibhokisi inabo ngokwenene iibhola ezi-3 ezimhlophe neebhola ezi-2 ezimnyama
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.r.a: Inani leebhola sele linikiwe. Lisetyenziswa ukufumana ithuba 3/5, kodwa alikuxeleli ukuba ithuba elifanayo ligcinwa ixesha ngalinye.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.o.b: Hlola ukuba ukukhupha iibhola ezi-3 linani elikhulu ngokwaneleyo lokuvavanywa
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.r.b: Ukwabiwa kwebinomiyali akusebenzi kuba inani lokuvavanywa likhulu. Nokuba lincinci, njenge-n=3, kukwabiwa kwebinomiyali ukuba iimeko ziyafezekiswa.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.o.c: Hlola ukuba ibhola nganye ekhutshiweyo ibuyiselwa ebhokisini phambi kokuba kukhutshwe elandelayo
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.r.c: Ukhangela ukuba okuqulathwe yibhokisi kuhlala kunjalo na ngalo lonke ixesha. Le yimeko ephambili yokwahlulwa kwebinomiyali.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.o.d: Khangela ukuba ulandelelwano lokuphuma kwamabhola amhlophe lumiselwe kwangaphambili na
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.r.d: Ulandelelwano alubalulekanga kuhlulo lwenani X lamabhola amhlophe. Okumisela ukuba kukwahlulwa kwebinomiyali kukuba iimvavanyo ziyachaphazelana na.

Ukuba ibhola nganye etsaliweyo ibuyiselwa, oko kuyabamba, kodwa ukuba akubuyiselwa, iziphumo zangaphambili zitshintsha iithuba zamva. Inani lamabhola liyaziwa sele, kwaye inani leemvavanyo alifuni ukuba likhulu.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.prompt: Masithi kutsalwa amabhola ama-3 engabuyiselwa. Ukuba ibhola yokuqala ibimhlophe, fumana ithuba lokuba ibhola yesibini ibe mhlophe, uze usebenzise oku ukubhala ukuba kutheni u-X engenakuba yi-B(3, 3/5) kule meko.

n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ngaba unokuchaza into eyenzekayo xa amabhola ebuyiselwa?
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.model.0: Ukuba ibhola yokuqala imhlophe, amabhola aseleyo ama-2 amhlophe kwama-4, ngoko ithuba li-2/4=1/2. Lahlukile kwi-3/5 yokuqala, ngoko imeko yokuba ithuba lihlala lifana iyaphuka, kwaye asiyiyo i-B(3, 3/5).
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.model.1: Ukuba amabhola awabuyiselwa, isiphumo sokutsalwa kwangaphambili sitshintsha ithuba elilandelayo. Ukuba ibhola emhlophe itsalwa kuqala, ithuba lokuba elandelayo libe mhlophe li-2 kwama-4 (0.5), lahlukile kwi-3/5, ngoko iimvavanyo azizimelanga yaye ayinakuba kukwahlulwa kwebinomiyali.

n-m-h3-dist-03.title: Imidlalo emibini enomndilili ofanayo: ngaba ukusasazeka nako kuyafana?

n-m-h3-dist-03.goal: Gweba ngokuthelekisa ukwahlulwa ngqo ukuba umndilili ofanayo uthetha ukuba ukusasazeka nako kuyafana na, uze uchaze isizathu usebenzisa ukwahluka.
n-m-h3-dist-03.material: Masibe X linani elibonakalayo xa kuphoswa idayisi eqhelekileyo enamacala amathandathu. Kukho imidlalo emibini. Kumdlalo A, uphosa idayisi kanye kwaye amanqaku akho aphindwe kabini inani elibonakalayo (2X), kwaye kumdlalo B, uphosa idayisi kabini kwaye amanqaku akho sisixa samanani amabini (X₁+X₂). Kuyo yomibini imidlalo umndilili wamanqaku ngama-7. UYoungsu wathi, "Ekubeni imindilili ifanayo, ukusasazeka kwamanqaku kufuneka kufane nako."
n-m-h3-dist-03.thinking.1: Yakha ubungqina bomzekelo ochasayo usebenzisa iithuba ezithile
n-m-h3-dist-03.thinking.2: Yenza ngokubanzi usebenzisa imithetho yendlela ukwahluka okutshintsha ngayo
n-m-h3-dist-03.prereq.0: Ixabiso elilindelekileyo nokwahluka kwenguqu engahleliyo eyahlukeneyo
n-m-h3-dist-03.prereq.1: Ukwahluka kwesixa sezinto ezimbini eziguquguqukayo ezizimeleyo ezingahleliyo V(X+Y)=V(X)+V(Y)
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.prompt: Yeyiphi eyona ndlela ifanelekileyo yokuthelekisa ukuvavanya ibango likaYoungsu?
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.hint.0: Ibango likaYoungsu limalunga "nokusasazeka," hayi umndilili. Yeyiphi idatha ebinokukubonisa oko?
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.hint.1: Kukhetho ngalunye, cinga ukuba lunganokuveza umahluko phakathi kwemidlalo emibini na.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.o.a: Phinda ubale ukhangele ukuba imindilili yemidlalo emibini ilingana ngokwenene nama-7
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.r.a: Sele inikiwe ukuba imindilili ifanayo. Ukukhangela ixabiso elifanayo kwakhona akuyi kukuxelela ngokusasazeka.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.o.b: Sebenzisa inyani yokuba umndilili wokuphosa idayisi kanye yi-3.5 ukuthelekisa imidlalo emibini
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.r.b: Oku kukuxelela kuphela ukuba umndilili wama-7 kuyo yomibini imidlalo uvela koku xabiso. Akuveli ukusasazeka.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.o.c: Beka macala ngecala amanqaku anokwenzeka kwimidlalo emibini nethuba lenqaku ngalinye
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.r.c: Uthelekisa ukwahlulwa kwamanqaku lonke. Le yindlela yokubona ngqo ukuba imilo yokwahlulwa inokwahluka na nokuba imindilili ifanayo.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.o.d: Phosa idayisi amaxesha amaninzi ubone ukuba umndilili wamanqaku emidlalo emibini usondela kuma-7 na
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.r.d: Ibonisa ukuba umndilili uqokelelana kufuphi nama-7 na, kodwa ayikuxeleli nto ngokusasazeka.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.explain: Umndilili sisishwankathelo esinye kuphela sokwahlulwa. Ukuba ubeka amanqaku namathuba macala ngecala, unokubona ngoko nangoko ukuba imilo yokwahlulwa inokwahluka nokuba umndilili ufanayo. Ukubala kwakhona umndilili okanye ukukhangela kuphela ukuba uqokelelana kufuphi nomndilili akunakuvavanya ibango likaYoungsu.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.prompt: Fumana ithuba lokuba inqaku libe li-2 okanye li-12 kumdlalo ngamnye (ithuba elidibeneyo lemeko ezimbini), uze uchaze ukuba ibango likaYoungsu alichanekanga.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala ukuba ngawaphi amanani edayisi anika amanqaku ama-2 nama-12 kumdlalo A.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.hint.1: Kumdlalo B, bala zonke izibini ezilandelelanayo zamanani amabini anika amanqaku ama-2 nama-12, ufumane ukuba zingaphi kwiziphumo ezingama-36.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.placeholder: umz. Kumdlalo A, ukufumana amanqaku ama-2 ...
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ubale ngokwakho iindlela zokufumana amanqaku ama-2 nama-12 kumdlalo B njengezibini ezilandelelanayo?
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba unokuthi imilo yokwahlulwa inokwahluka nokuba imindilili ifanayo?
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ngaba unokuthi umahluko phakathi kwamathuba amabini ubonisa njani umahluko wokusasazeka?
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.model.0: Kumdlalo A, ukuphosa u-1 okanye u-6 kunika amanqaku ama-2 okanye ama-12, ngoko li-2/6=1/3. Kumdlalo B, kukho iziphumo ezimbini kuphela, (1,1) kunye no-(6,6), ngoko li-2/36=1/18. Ngomndilili ofanayo, amathuba amanqaku aphezulu ahluka kakhulu, ngoko ukusasazeka akunakubizwa ngokuba kufanayo.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.model.1: Ithuba lokufumana amanqaku ama-2 okanye ama-12 liyisithathu kuA nesishumi elinesibhozo kuB. Nangona umndilili ungama-7 kuzo zombini, u-A unika amanqaku aphezulu kakhulu rhoqo, ngoko ukwahluka kuyahluka.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.prompt: Masibe V ukwahluka kwenani X elibonakalayo ekuphoseni idayisi kanye. Ukwahluka kwamanqaku omdlalo A 2X nomdlalo B X₁+X₂ (ukuphosa okubini akuchaphazelani) kuyintoni?
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.hint.0: 2X sisiphumo esinye esiphindwe kabini, kwaye X₁+X₂ ziziphumo ezimbini ezahlukeneyo ezidibeneyo. Cinga ngezi zimbini ngokwahlukeneyo.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.hint.1: Faka inani elilula endaweni ye-V (umzekelo V=1), fumana ukwahluka okubini kukhetho ngalunye, uze uthelekise ukuba kuhambelana nokusasazeka kwemidlalo emibini oyibonileyo kwinyathelo elidlulileyo.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.o.a: Ukwahluka kwe-2X yi-2V, kwaye ukwahluka kwe-X₁+X₂ yi-2V
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.r.a: Uthathe i-2X njenge-"X yongezwe kabini." Ukongeza ixabiso elifanayo kabini kwahlukile ekongezeni iziphumo zokuphosa okubini okwahlukeneyo.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.o.b: Ukwahluka kwe-2X yi-4V, kwaye ukwahluka kwe-X₁+X₂ yi-2V
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.r.b: Kwi-2X, onke amaxabiso aphindwe kabini, ngoko ukwahluka kuba kukhulu ngamaxesha angama-2²; kwisixa seziphumo ezimbini ezizimeleyo, ukwahluka kuyadibana, ngoko kukhulu ngamaxesha ama-2.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.o.c: Ukwahluka kwe-2X yi-4V, kwaye ukwahluka kwe-X₁+X₂ yi-4V
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.r.c: Usebenzise umthetho wokuba ukuphindaphinda ngekhonstanti kwenza isikwere sesi sibalayo kukwahluka nakwisixa sokuphosa okubini. Kwisixa esizimeleyo, ukwahluka kudibana nje.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.o.d: Ukwahluka kwe-2X yi-2V, kwaye ukwahluka kwe-X₁+X₂ yi-4V
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.explain: V(2X)=2²V=4V, kwaye kwisixa sezinto ezimbini eziguquguqukayo ezizimeleyo, V(X₁+X₂)=V+V=2V. Imindilili zombini ziyi-7, kodwa ukwahluka kuyahluka: 4V kunye ne-2V. (Ukwahluka kokuphosa idayisi yi-V=35/12, ngoko ziyi-35/3 kunye ne-35/6.)

n-m-h3-dist-04.title: Ngaba ixabiso elilindelekileyo lelona xabiso livela rhoqo?
n-m-h3-dist-04.goal: Hlela inkcazo nentsingiselo yexabiso elilindelekileyo, uze wakhe ukhangele ukwahlulwa apho ixabiso elilindelekileyo lingelilo ixabiso elinokwenzeka okanye ixabiso elinethuba elikhulu.
n-m-h3-dist-04.material: Kukho inguqu engahleliyo X ethatha amaxabiso 0, 1, 2. Xa uphumeza amathuba amaxabiso amathathu kwitheyibhile yokwahlulwa kwamathuba, ixabiso elilindelekileyo E(X) liyamiselwa.
n-m-h3-dist-04.thinking.0: Hlela izivakalisi ngexabiso elilindelekileyo kwezinyanisekileyo nezingezizo
n-m-h3-dist-04.thinking.1: Yakha ukwahlulwa okunelisa iimeko ukusebenzise njengomzekelo ochasayo
n-m-h3-dist-04.prereq.0: Itheyibhile yokwahlulwa kwamathuba yenguqu engahleliyo eyahlukeneyo
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke izivakalisi ezichanekileyo ngexabiso elilindelekileyo E(X).
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.hint.0: Kwisivakalisi ngasinye, cinga ukuba ungasivavanya ngokwenza itheyibhile yokwahlulwa kwamathuba na.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.hint.1: Qala uvavanye ngokwahlulwa okulula apho amaxabiso angu-0 no-1 kuphela kwaye amathuba amabini alingana.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.r.a: Nokuba u-X unokuthatha amaxabiso apheleleyo kuphela, E(X) inokuba lidesimali. Umzekelo, umndilili wenani lemisila ekuphoseni imali unokuba lixabiso elinje ngo-0.5.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.o.b: E(X) sisixa sexabiso ngalinye eliphindwe lithuba lalo.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.r.c: Uthathe ixabiso elilindelekileyo ne-"ixabiso elinethuba elikhulu" njengento enye. Ixabiso elinokwenzeka kakhulu yingcamango eyahlukileyo, kwaye zombini zihlala zahluka.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.o.d: Ukuba umvavanyo uphindwaphindwa amaxesha amaninzi, umndilili wamaxabiso abonwayo uqokelelana kufuphi ne-E(X).
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.r.d: Uchaze ngokuchanekileyo apho umndilili uzinza khona njengoko umvavanyo uphindaphindwa.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.explain: E(X) sisixa sexabiso × ithuba, kwaye lixabiso apho umndilili uzinza khona xa umvavanyo uphindwaphindwa amaxesha amaninzi. Akukho siqinisekiso sokuba lixabiso elinokuthathwa ngu-X ngokwenene, nokuba lixabiso elinethuba elikhulu.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.prompt: Masithi u-X uthatha amaxabiso 0, 1, 2. Khetha amathuba abo njengeepesenti ezipheleleyo (p0, p1, p2). Iimeko: ① nganye kumathuba amathathu ubuncinane ngu-1% kwaye adibana abe ngu-100% ② ixabiso elinethuba elikhulu ngu-2 kuphela ③ E(X)≤1.2 (ixabiso elilindelekileyo ubuncinane ngu-0.8 ngaphantsi kuno-2, ixabiso elinokwenzeka kakhulu). Yenza imizekelo eyi-3 eyahlukileyo (enamaxabiso ahlukeneyo e-p2).
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ukhethe i-p0, p1, p2 ukuze zidibane zibe ngu-100, uze wenze i-p2 ibe yeyona inkulu.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.hint.1: Bala i-E(X)=(p1+2·p2)/100 ukhangele ukuba ingama-1.2 ubuninzi. Ukuba inkulu kakhulu, zama ukonyusa i-p0 okanye i-p1.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.hint.2: Tshintsha i-p2 ibe ngamaxabiso ahlukeneyo anje ngama-45 nama-39, uze ukhethe i-p0 ne-p1 kwakhona ngalo lonke ixesha.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.ok.c1: Amathuba ngamanani aphelele ubuncinane angama-1% kwaye adibana abe ngama-100%.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Amathuba amathathu kufuneka abe ngamanani aphelele ubuncinane angama-1% yaye adibane abe ngu-100.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.fail.c2: P(X=2) kufuneka ibe nkulu kunamanye amathuba amabini ngamnye (akufuneki ilingane nalo naliphi).
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.explain: E(X)=(p1+2·p2)/100. Umzekelo, kwi-(40, 15, 45), E(X)=1.05, kwaye ixabiso elinethuba elikhulu li-2. E(X)=1.05 alilo ixabiso elinokuthathwa ngu-X, kwaye lahlukile nakwi-2, ixabiso elinethuba elikhulu. Imizekelo ehlela kwakhona (p0, p1, p2) kuphela ayifuni ukubalwa njengomzekelo ofanayo.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.prompt: Khetha omnye wemizekelo yakho kwaye, usebenzisa amanani awo, chaza ukuba kutheni kuphosakele ukufunda i-E(X) njenge-"ixabiso elivela rhoqo" okanye "ixabiso elivela ngokwenene."
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.hint.0: Fumana i-E(X) yomzekelo wakho okhethiweyo uze uyithelekise namaxabiso anokuthathwa ngu-X: 0, 1, 2.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala ukuba ixabiso elinethuba elikhulu linxulumana njani nexabiso le-E(X).
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ubale i-E(X) ngokwakho kumzekelo owukhethileyo?
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uchaze ukuba kutheni i-E(X) lixabiso elingenakwenzeka ngokwenene?
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ngaba uchaze ukuba ixabiso elinethuba elikhulu lahluka njani kwi-E(X)?
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.model.0: Umzekelo, kwi-(40, 15, 45), E(X)=0.15 + 0.9 = 1.05. Alilo ixabiso elinokuthathwa ngu-X, kwaye ixabiso elinethuba elikhulu li-2. Ngoko E(X) asilolo ixabiso elivela rhoqo okanye ixabiso elinokuvela.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.model.1: Kwi-(37, 24, 39), E(X)=1.02, kodwa u-X unokuba ngu-0, 1, okanye 2 kuphela, ngoko 1.02 ayinakuvela. Ixabiso elinethuba elikhulu li-2, kuma-39%, ngoko lahlukile kwixabiso elilindelekileyo.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.model.2: Kwi-(25, 36, 39), E(X)=1.14 alilo ixabiso elinokuthathwa ngu-X, kwaye lahlukile nakwi-2, ixabiso elinokwenzeka kakhulu.

n-m-h3-dist-05.title: Ukuba Ithuba Ngu-0, Ngaba Ngokwenene Ayinakwenzeka?
n-m-h3-dist-05.topic: Ukwahlulwa kwamathuba: ithuba lechaphaza elinye lenguqu engahleliyo eqhubekayo
n-m-h3-dist-05.goal: Gqiba ukuba ixabiso linokuvela na xa ithuba laso kwichaphaza elinye lenguqu engahleliyo eqhubekayo lingu-0, uze uchaze oko kugweba, kunye nempembelelo yokubandakanya okanye ukungabandakanyi iziphelo, ngamazwi anokuqondwa ngumhlobo.
n-m-h3-dist-05.material: Ibhasi ifika ngokulinganayo nangawuphi na umzuzu ophakathi kwemizuzu engu-0 nengu-10 ukusuka ngoku. Ixesha lokulinda X (imizuzu) linokuba lilo naliphi na ixabiso ukusuka ku-0 ukuya ku-10 ngokubandakanya. Ithuba lesithuba lilingana nobude baso: P(a≤X≤b)=(b−a)/10. UJia wabhala oku kulandelayo.
n-m-h3-dist-05.thinking.1: Chaza ingcamango enzima usebenzisa amagama alula nemizekelo
n-m-h3-dist-05.thinking.2: Gqiba ukuba ukubandakanya okanye ukungabandakanyi isiphelo kutshintsha ithuba na
n-m-h3-dist-05.prereq.0: Intsingiselo yenguqu engahleliyo eqhubekayo nomsebenzi wobuninzi bethuba (ithuba yindawo ngaphezu kwesithuba)
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.hint.0: Khangela ngokulandelelana ukuba umgca ngamnye ulandela ngokufanelekileyo kumgca ongaphambi kwawo.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.hint.1: Fumana imigca ethi "ithuba li-0" ne-"ayinakwenzeka," uvavanye ukuba ingqiqo ebadibanisayo isebenza na ngokucinga ngebhasi efika ngokwenene.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.line.0: X inokuthatha onke amaxabiso ukusuka ku-0 ukuya ku-10, kwaye P(a≤X≤b)=(b−a)/10.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.line.1: P(X=4) lithuba lesithuba esinobude obungu-0, ngoko li-(4−4)/10=0.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.line.2: Kuba ithuba li-0, ibhasi ukufika kwimizuzu emi-4 kanye yinto engenakwenzeka.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.explain: Umgca wesi-3 uphosakele. Kwinguqu engahleliyo eqhubekayo, nokuba ithuba kwichaphaza elinye li-0, eli xabiso alinakwenzeka ngokuyimfuneko. Kukho amaxabiso angenasiphelo phakathi kwe-0 ne-10, ngoko elinye ngalinye lineethuba elingu-0, kodwa elinye ixabiso liyenzeka. Imigca yesi-4 neyesi-5 ilandela ngokuchanekileyo.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.prompt: Bhala umyalezo wokubhaliweyo ochaza kuJia. Chaza ukuba yeyiphi inxalenye yengqiqo yakhe efuna ukulungiswa, nokuba P(X≤4) ne-P(X<4) zithelekiswa njani ngobukhulu, usebenzisa amagama alula nomzekelo.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.hint.0: Cinga ukuba incinane kangakanani ithuba lokukhetha ixabiso elinye kanye phakathi kwe-0 ne-10.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.hint.1: Phinda uthi ingcamango efanayo ngokwendawo: yeyiphi indawo yomgca omnye ongenabubanzi?
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.placeholder: umz. Ithuba lemizuzu emi-4 kanye li ...
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba usebenzise amagama nomzekelo ongaqondwa ngumhlobo wesekondari?
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ngaba uchaze ukuba kutheni ithuba lifana nokuba isiphelo sibandakanyiwe okanye hayi?
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.model.0: Kukho amaxabiso angenasiphelo phakathi kwemizuzu engu-0 nengu-10, ngoko ithuba lokufikelela imizuzu emi-4 kanye lincinane kangangokuba lisondele ku-0 liba ngu-0. Kodwa oko akuthethi ukuba ibhasi ayifiki kwimizuzu emi-4, kuba ifika kumzuzu othile. Nokuba imizuzu emi-4 ibandakanyiwe okanye hayi, ithuba elilongeza ngu-0, ngoko P(X≤4) ne-P(X<4) ziyalingana.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.model.1: Kuba iqhubeka, nokuba ichaphaza elinye linethuba elingu-0, ibhasi isenokufika ngalo mzuzu. Injengokuba ichaphaza elinye komgca linendawo engu-0 ngoxa umgca usenamachaphaza. Ukongeza okanye ukususa ichaphaza elinye akutshintshi ithuba, ngoko P(X≤4)=P(X<4)=0.4.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.model.2: P(X=4)=0, kodwa ixesha lokufika lixabiso elinye elimiselweyo, ngoko akunakwenzeka ukuba elo xabiso livele. Ichaphaza elinye alinabubanzi, ngoko ukulongeza okanye ukulisusa akutshintshi ithuba, kwaye amathuba amabini ayalingana.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.hint.0: Cinga ukuba isivakalisi ngasinye sixhomekeke njani kwixabiso le-P(X=a).
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.hint.1: Kwidayisi X (eyahlukeneyo), fumana i-P(X≤3) ne-P(X<3) uzithelekise.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.o.a: Nakwinguqu engahleliyo eqhubekayo, P(X≤a) ihlala inkulu kuno-P(X<a).
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.r.a: Ucinge ukuba "≤" ibandakanya iimeko ezininzi, ngoko ithuba layo kufuneka libe likhulu. Kwinguqu engahleliyo eqhubekayo, ithuba kwichaphaza elinye li-0, ngoko zombini ziyalingana.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.o.b: Kwinguqu engahleliyo eqhubekayo, ukuba P(X=a)=0, ngoko u-X akanakulingana no-a.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.r.b: Uthathe ithuba elingu-0 njengokungenakwenzeka. Kwinguqu engahleliyo eqhubekayo, ixabiso elinethuba elingu-0 linokuvela ngokwenene.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.o.c: Kwinguqu engahleliyo eqhubekayo, ithuba lifana nokuba iziphelo zesithuba zibandakanyiwe okanye hayi.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.r.c: Ithuba kwichaphaza elinye li-0, ngoko ukubandakanya okanye ukungabandakanyi isiphelo akutshintshi ithuba.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.o.d: Nakwinguqu engahleliyo eyahlukeneyo, P(X≤a)=P(X<a) ihlala ibamba.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.r.d: Kwinguqu engahleliyo eyahlukeneyo, P(X=a) inokungabi ngu-0, ngoko zombini zisenokungalingani.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.explain: Kwinguqu engahleliyo eqhubekayo, P(X=a)=0, ngoko P(a≤X≤b)=P(a<X<b)=P(a≤X<b)=P(a<X≤b). Kwinguqu engahleliyo eyahlukeneyo, P(X=a)>0 iyenzeka, ngoko ukubandakanya okanye ukungabandakanyi isiphelo kunokutshintsha ithuba.

n-m-h3-dist-07.title: Ukwakha Ukwabiwa Kwebinomiyali Ukusuka Kumndilili Nokwahluka
n-m-h3-dist-07.topic: Ukwabiwa kwamathuba: umndilili nokwahluka kokwabiwa kwebinomiyali
n-m-h3-dist-07.goal: Sebenzisa ubudlelwane phakathi komndilili nokwahluka kokwabiwa kwebinomiyali ukukhupha indibaniselwano ezingenakwenzeka, wakhe ukwabiwa kwebinomiyali okuhlangabezana nemiqathango enikiweyo ukufumana umthetho.
n-m-h3-dist-07.material: Ufuna ukuchaza idatha ethile ngokwabiwa kwebinomiyali B(n,p). Apha n linani lendalo kwaye p linani eliphakathi kwe-0 ne-1. Umndilili wokwabiwa kwebinomiyali yi-np kwaye ukwahluka yi-np(1−p).
n-m-h3-dist-07.thinking.1: Yakha imizekelo yakho ehlangabezana nemiqathango uze ufumane umthetho
n-m-h3-dist-07.prereq.0: Umndilili np nokwahluka np(1−p) kokwabiwa kwebinomiyali B(n, p)
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.prompt: Yeyiphi kwezi jozi zomndilili nokwahluka enokwenzeka ngenene kukwabiwa kwebinomiyali B(n, p)?
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.hint.0: Misela umndilili ulingane ne-np nokwahluka kulingane ne-np(1−p), ubone ukuba kuseleni xa wahlula ukwahluka ngomndilili.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.hint.1: Kukhetho ngalunye, hlola ukuba i-p oyifumanayo iphakathi kwe-0 ne-1 kwaye n linani lendalo na.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.r.a: Apha ukwahluka kukhulu kunomndilili. Ekubeni ukwahluka yi-np(1−p), akunakuba kukhulu kunomndilili np.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.r.b: Ukuba ufumana i-p emva koko n=np÷p, n alilo inani lendalo. Ulibale umqathango wokuba n linani lendalo.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.r.c: Ukuba ukwahluka kulingana nomndilili, ngoko 1−p=1, ngoko p=0. Emva koko umndilili wawuya kuba yi-0, ongahambelaniyo.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.r.d: Ukwahluka ÷ umndilili = 1−p kumisela i-p, kwaye n ikwaphuma ilinani lendalo, ngoko oku kunokwenzeka.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.explain: Ukwahluka ÷ umndilili = 1−p. Kwi-(8, 6), 1−p=3/4, p=1/4, kwaye n=8÷(1/4)=32, ngoko kunokwenzeka. Kwi-(10, 12), 1−p>1 ngoko p<0; kwi-(8, 5), p=3/8 kwaye n=64/3, elingelo inani lendalo; kwaye kwi-(6, 6), p=0.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.prompt: Yakha ukwabiwa kwebinomiyali okuhlukeneyo okuyi-3 B(n, p) onomndilili we-12 nokwahluka okungadluli kwi-8. Bhala n njengenani lendalo kwaye p njengepesenti yenani eliphelele (p%). (umzekelo xa p=25%, bhala 25)
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngokubhala ii-jozi zika-n no-p ezanelisa umndilili np=12 (p njengepesenti yenani eliphelele).
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.hint.1: Kwijozi nganye, bala ukwahluka 12(1−p) uhlole ukuba akudluli kwi-8 na.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.ok.c1: n linani lendalo kwaye p iphakathi kwe-1% ne-99%.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.fail.c1: n kufuneka libe linani lendalo kwaye p kufuneka libe yipesenti yenani eliphelele ukusuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-99.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.explain: Ukusuka kwi-np=12, p=q/100. Ukuze ukwahluka np(1−p)=12(1−p) kungadluli kwi-8, p kufuneka ibe ubuncinane yi-1/3. Imizekelo apho zombini n no-p zihambelana nemiqathango yi-(30, 40%), (25, 48%), (24, 50%), (20, 60%), (16, 75%), kunye ne-(15, 80%).
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.prompt: Ujonge ukwabiwa kwakho okuthathu, bhala ukuba bukhona buphi ubudlelwane phakathi kwe-p nokwahluka xa imindilili ilingana.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala ecaleni ngecala i-p nokwahluka kokwabiwa okuthathu, njengetheyibhile.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.hint.1: Jonga ukuba ukwahluka kuba kukhulu okanye kuncinci njengoko p ikhula.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.placeholder: umzekelo: Xa umndilili ufana, i-12, njengoko p ikhula ukwahluka ...
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ubale ngenene ukwahluka kokwabiwa okuthathu?
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba uthe ubudlelwane phakathi kwe-p nokwahluka kunye nomqathango wokuba imindilili iyalingana?
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingaba usebenzise into yokuba ukwahluka kunokubhalwa njenge-12(1−p)?
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.model.0: Xa umndilili np ufana, i-12, ukwahluka yi-12(1−p), ngoko okukhona p inkulu, kokukhona ukwahluka kuncinci. Umzekelo, p=40% inika i-7.2 kwaye p=75% inika i-3.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.model.1: Konke ukwabiwa okuthathu kunomndilili we-12, kodwa ukwahluka kwancipha njengoko p yakhula. Umzekelo, 6 xa p=50% kwaye 2.4 xa p=80%: okukhona ithuba lempumelelo liphezulu, kokukhona kusasazeka kancinci.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.model.2: Xa imindilili ilingana, okukhona p inkulu, kokukhona ukwahluka 12(1-p) kuba kuncinci.

n-m-h3-dist-08.title: Isisombululo Esinike Ithuba Elingu-2: Ngumgca Muni Owonakeleyo?
n-m-h3-dist-08.topic: Ukwabiwa kwamathuba: indawo yomsebenzi wokuxinana kwethuba
n-m-h3-dist-08.goal: Qaphela ukuba awunakwenza i-integral ngaphandle kwesithuba apho umsebenzi wokuxinana kwethuba ungeyonto engekho nto, fumana umgca owonakeleyo, uze ufumane ithuba elichanekileyo.
n-m-h3-dist-08.material: Ivaribhile engahleliweyo eqhubekayo X inomsebenzi wokuxinana kwethuba f(x)=kx (0≤x≤2), kwaye f(x)=0 kuwo onke ama-x angaphandle. Nesisombululo sikaMinjun sokufumana ikhonstanti k ne-P(1≤X≤3).
n-m-h3-dist-08.thinking.1: Hlola ukuba isiphumo siphakathi koluhlu olunokwenzeka kwithuba na
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca wokuqala ongachanekanga kwisisombululo sikaMinjun.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola ukusuka phezulu ukuba umgca ngamnye ulandela ngokusemthethweni kumgca wangaphambili.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s1.hint.1: Kumgca ngamnye, thelekisa igrafu esetyenzisiweyo kweso sithuba se-x ne-f(x) enikiweyo ekuxoxweni.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s1.line.0: f(x)=kx (0≤x≤2) kwaye f(x)=0 kwenye indawo, kwaye indawo iphela yi-1.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s1.line.2: I-P(1≤X≤3) yindawo phakathi kwegrafu ye-y=x/2 kunye ne-eksisi ye-x ukusuka kwi-x=1 ukuya kwi-x=3.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s1.explain: Umgca wesi-3 awulunganga. Kumsebenzi wokuxinana kwethuba, f(x)=0 xa x ikhulu kune-2, ngoko igrafu ye-y=x/2 isetyenziswa kuphela ukuya kwi-x=2. Ngoko indawo ukusuka kwi-x=2 ukuya kwi-3 akufunekanga yongezwe. Imigca yesi-4 nesi-5 ithwala ngokulula isithuba esingalunganga esivela kumgca wesi-3.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.prompt: Lungisa umgca ongalunganga ufumane ixabiso le-P(1≤X≤3). Bhala nesizathu sokuba impendulo kaMinjun ye-2 ayinakuba lithuba.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.hint.0: Kuqala dweba apho igrafu ingeyonto engekho nto khona.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.placeholder: umzekelo: f(x) ayiyonto engekho nto kuphela xa x ...; ngoko ...
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingaba uhlolile isithuba apho f(x) ingeyonto engekho nto phambi kokusombulula?
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ubale ngokwakho i-3/4 (nge-integral okanye njengetrapezoyidi)?
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingaba uhlolile impendulo yakho usebenzisa into yokuba ithuba alinakudlula kwi-1?
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.model.0: Xa x ikhulu kune-2, f(x)=0, ngoko kufuneka ubale kuphela ukusuka kwi-x=1 ukuya kwi-2, kwaye indawo yi-(1/2)×(1/2+1)×1=3/4. Impendulo kaMinjun ye-2 ayinakwenzeka kuba ithuba alinakuba likhulu kune-1, kodwa idlula kwi-1.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.model.1: P(1≤X≤3)=P(1≤X≤2)=∫₁² x/2 dx=3/4. Ekubeni indawo iphela yi-1, indawo yesithuba ayinakuba yi-2.

n-m-h3-prob-01.title: Ubuncinane Omnye Yintombi: Lithini Ithuba Lokuba Zombini Ziyintombi?
n-m-h3-prob-01.topic: Ithuba: ithuba elinemeko, ukuzimela nokuxhomekeka, ukuqiqa kwindlela kaBayes, ukumisela isithuba semizekelo
n-m-h3-prob-01.goal: Kwisisombululo sethuba elinemeko, fumana kwaye ulungise indawo apho amatyala angalinganiyo ngokunokwenzeka abalwe njengalinganayo, uze uqinisekise ukuba amatyala asalayo atshintsha ngokuxhomekeke kwindlela imeko ebhalwe ngayo.
n-m-h3-prob-01.material: Konke esikwaziyo kukuba usapho lunabantwana ababini. Umntwana ngamnye uyintombi ngethuba le-1/2, kwaye siqinisekisa ukuba isini sabantwana aba babini asichaphazeli omnye komnye. USeungwoo wasombulula "ithuba lokuba bobabini abantwana bayintombi, kuthiwe ubuncinane omnye uyintombi" ngendlela ekuboniswe ngezantsi.
n-m-h3-prob-01.thinking.1: Akha kwakhona isithuba semizekelo usebenzisa amatyala anokwahlulwa
n-m-h3-prob-01.prereq.0: Intsingiselo yethuba elinemeko (umlinganiselo wamatyala athile phakathi kwamatyala ahlangabezana nemeko)
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca wokuqala ongachanekanga kwisisombululo sikaSeungwoo.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.hint.0: Jonga ukusuka phezulu, umgca ngomgca, ukuba umgca ngamnye ulandela ngokuchanekileyo kumgca ongaphambili.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala wena amatyala athiwa "alinganayo ngokunokwenzeka," uhlule umntwana wokuqala kowesibini, uze uthelekise ukuba ngenene alingana ngobukhulu.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.line.0: Phantsi kwemeko yokuba ubuncinane omnye wabantwana aba babini uyintombi, fumana ithuba lokuba bobabini abantwana bayintombi.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.line.1: Ukwakhiwa kwabantwana aba babini kuhlobo olunye kwezi zintathu, "iintombi ezi-2," "intombi e-1 nonyana o-1," kunye "noonyana aba-2," kwaye iintlobo ezintathu zilinganayo ngokunokwenzeka.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.line.2: Ukususa "oonyana aba-2," ongahambelani nemeko yokuba ubuncinane omnye uyintombi, kushiya iintlobo ezimbini.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.line.3: Kwiintlobo ezi-2 ezisalayo, kukho e-1 apho bobabini abantwana bayintombi.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.explain: Umgca 2 yindawo yokuqala eyahamba kakubi. "Intombi e-1 nonyana o-1" ibandakanya zombini imeko apho umntwana wokuqala eyintombi kunye nemeko apho umntwana wesibini eyintombi, ngoko xa owokuqala nowesibini behlulwa, ayilingani ngokunokwenzeka "neentombi ezi-2" okanye "noonyana aba-2." Imigca 3 ukuya ku-5 ilandela iintlobo ezintathu ukusuka kumgca 2 ngokuthembana, ngoko ukubala ngaphakathi kwazo kuchanekile kodwa umphumo awuchanekanga.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.prompt: Usebenzisa isisombululo esilungisiweyo, fumana ithuba lokuba bobabini abantwana bayintombi, uze ubhale isizathu sokuba ixabiso lahluke kweloo likaSeungwoo. (Umntwana ngamnye uyintombi ngethuba le-1/2, kwaye aba babini baqinisekiswa ukuba abachaphazeli omnye komnye.)
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.hint.0: Hlula abantwana njengowokuqala nowesibini, uze ubhale onke amadibaniso eesini. Zingaphi, kwaye zilingana ngokunokwenzeka?
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.hint.1: Bala kuphela amatyala ahlangabezana nemeko, uze uthelekise ukuba ngaphi kuwo kukho zombini iintombi.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.placeholder: umz. Ukuba sihlula umntwana wokuqala nowesibini, ...
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ubhale onke amatyala anokwenzeka, uhlula umntwana wokuqala nowesibini?
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ugcine kuphela amatyala ahlangabezana nemeko uze ufumane umlinganiselo wamatyala ezintombi zombini phakathi kwawo?
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingaba uthe "intombi e-1 nonyana o-1" asiyonto imbi enye?
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.model.0: Ukuba sihlula umntwana wokuqala nowesibini, (intombi, intombi), (intombi, unyana), (unyana, intombi), kunye (unyana, unyana) zonke zilingana ngokunokwenzeka. Kumatyala ama-3 apho ubuncinane omnye eyintombi, e-1 inezintombi zombini, ngoko ithuba li-1/3.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.model.1: Intombi enye nonyana omnye bahlulwa babe ngamatyala amabini, (owokuqala eyintombi, owesibini unyana) kunye (owokuqala unyana, owesibini eyintombi), ngoko akufuneki kubalwe njengetyala elinye. Ngoko kukho amatyala ama-3 ahlangabezana nemeko, kwaye elinye kuphela linezintombi zombini, ngoko ithuba lingaba yinxalenye yesithathu.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Ukudwelisa usebenzisa iimpawu ezifana ne-G kunye ne-B kulungile.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.prompt: Ukuba imeko ibingengathi "ubuncinane omnye uyintombi" kodwa "umntwana wokuqala uyintombi," ithuba lokuba bobabini abantwana bayintombi lingaba yintoni?
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala amatyala asalayo phantsi kwale meko, uhlula umntwana wokuqala nowesibini.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.hint.1: Beka uluhlu lwamatyala asalayo ovela kwingxaki edlulileyo ecaleni koluhlu, uze ufumane oko kutshintshileyo.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.r.a: Ubale ngokungachanekanga amatyala ahlangabezana nemeko, okanye uxubile "ubuncinane intombi enye" kunye "neentombi zombini."
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.r.b: Unike ithuba phezu konke okwakuqala ungasebenzisanga imeko. Xa kukho imeko, amatyala asalayo ayatshintsha.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.r.c: Uthathe imeko yengxaki edlulileyo kunye nale njengento enye. Ngeli xesha kushiyeke kuphela isini somntwana wesibini sivuliwe.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.explain: Ukuba umntwana wokuqala uyintombi, amatyala asalayo yi-(intombi, intombi) kunye ne-(intombi, unyana), alinganayo ngokunokwenzeka. Kwawo, elinye linezintombi zombini, ngoko ithuba li-1/2. "Ubuncinane omnye uyintombi" ikwavumela i-(unyana, intombi), ngoko kukho amatyala asalayo ama-3 kwaye ithuba li-1/3. Isithuba semizekelo esisalayo sixhomekeke kwindlela imeko ebhalwe ngayo.

n-m-h3-est-01.title: Ukuhlola Isisombululo Sethuba Lokuba Iibhotile Ezi-9 Zibe Nomndilili Wobuncinane be-503 mL

UHaeun, osebenza kulawulo lomgangatho, ukhethe ngokungenamkhethe iibhotile ezi-9 wafumana ithuba lokuba umndilili wevolumu X̄ ube ubuncinane yi-503 mL. Inxalenye yetheyibhile yokwabiwa okuqhelekileyo okuqhelekileyo: P(0≤Z≤0.5)=0.1915, P(0≤Z≤1.5)=0.4332, P(0≤Z≤3)=0.4987. n-m-h3-integc-04.title: Ii-Integral Ezichanekileyo Ngaphandle Kwe-Antiderivative
n-m-h3-integc-04.topic: Ukudityaniswa: ii-integral ezichanekileyo zisebenzisa ukutshintshwa nokulingana kwexesha (ukufumana ixabiso ngaphandle kwe-antiderivative)
n-m-h3-integc-04.goal: Ukuhlaziya isigwebo sakho njengoko ulwazi lukhula, qinisekisa ukuba ubudlelwane bokulingana obufunyenwe ngokutshintshwa bumisela ixabiso le-integral echanekileyo ngaphandle kokufumana i-antiderivative.
n-m-h3-integc-04.material: Landela, inyathelo ngenyathelo, inkqubo yokufumana ixabiso le-integral echanekileyo I=∫_0^{π/2} sin x/(sin x+cos x) dx. (I-∫_0^{π/2} yi-integral echanekileyo ukusuka kwi-0 ukuya kwi-π/2.)
n-m-h3-integc-04.thinking.1: Bala inani lemibhalo yokulingana nenani lezinto ezingaziwayo
n-m-h3-integc-04.thinking.3: Gweba iimeko apho indlela efanayo isebenza khona
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.hint.0: Xa ngexesha lonke kuvela ulwazi olutsha, bala "zingaphi izinto ezingaziwayo nokuba zingaphi iimbalo zokulingana."
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuba ingaba uqikelelo lwakho lokuqala nexabiso elifunyenwe kamva aluhluki kakhulu.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Ufuna ukufumana i-I=∫_0^{π/2} sin x/(sin x+cos x) dx. Kunzima ukufumana i-antiderivative yeli binzana ngqo. Amaxabiso entlawulo ebalwayo h(x)=sin x/(sin x+cos x) yi-h(0)=0, h(π/4)=1/2, h(π/2)=1, kwaye ubude bexesha yi-π/2 (malunga ne-1.57).
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Luphi uqikelelo olufaneleke kakhulu lobungakanani be-I?
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Ukuphakama kunyuka ukusuka kwi-0 ukuya kwi-1 kunexabiso eliphakathi le-1/2, ngoko indawo ingaba malunga ne-(1/2)×1.57≈0.8. Olu qikelelo lunokusetyenziswa kamva ukujonga ukuba ixabiso olifumeneyo lichanekile na.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: I-I ingaba malunga ne-1.57: kuba uphatha ukuphakama njenge-1 uphindaphinde ngobude be-1.57
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ukuphakama kuyi-1 kuphela esiphelweni sexesha. Olu qikelelo luphatha ukuphakama njenge-1 kuyo yonke inxalenye yexesha.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: I-I ingaba malunga ne-0.8: kuba ukuphakama kuyahluka ukusuka kwi-0 ukuya kwi-1, umndilili ungaba malunga ne-1/2
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uqikelele utshintsho lokuphakama ngomndilili. Asilo ixabiso elichanekileyo, kodwa lunokusetyenziswa ukulinganisa ubungakanani.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: I-I yi-0: kuba i-h(0)=0 kwindawo yokuqala
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ixabiso lokuba yi-0 kwichaphaza elinye alenzi i-integral echanekileyo ibe yi-0. Jonga amaxabiso kuyo yonke inxalenye yexesha.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Jonga nale J=∫_0^{π/2} cos x/(sin x+cos x) dx. Ukongeza amaqhezu omabini kwenza inani elingasentla lilingane nelingaphantsi, ngoko i-I+J=∫_0^{π/2} 1 dx=π/2.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ngaba i-I inokumiselwa ngolu lwazi lodwa?
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Kukho umbhalo omnye wokulingana kuphela, i-I+J=π/2, ngoko i-I ne-J azinakumiselwa ngokwahlukeneyo. Kufuneka ufumane ubudlelwane obunye phakathi kwe-I ne-J.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Uyihlule yaba ngamaqhekeza amabini alinganayo ungajongi ukuba i-I=J na. I-I+J=π/2 bubudlelwane obunye kuphela phakathi kwe-I ne-J.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Ayinakumiselwa: i-I+J=π/2 ayinceda konke ekufumaneni i-I.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ixabiso le-I+J lulwazi oluluncedo. Linike ubudlelwane obunye phakathi kwe-I ne-J.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Aluneli okwangoku: kufuneka wazi ubudlelwane obunye phakathi kwe-I ne-J.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Uqaphele ukuba kukho izinto ezimbini ezingaziwayo, i-I ne-J, kodwa umbhalo omnye wokulingana kuphela.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Kwi-J, vumela i-x=π/2−t. Ngoko i-dx=−dt, kwaye njengoko i-x ihamba ukusuka kwi-0 ukuya kwi-π/2, i-t ihamba ukusuka kwi-π/2 ukuya kwi-0. Ekubeni i-sin(π/2−t)=cos t kwaye i-cos(π/2−t)=sin t, i-J=∫_{π/2}^{0} sin t/(sin t+cos t)·(−dt)=∫_0^{π/2} sin t/(sin t+cos t) dt, elingana ne-I.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.2.after: I=J kwaye I+J=π/2, ngoko I=π/4 (malunga ne-0.785). Oku kuvumelana kakuhle noqikelelo lokuqala lwe-0.8.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: I=π/4: ngenxa yokuba J=I kwaye I+J=π/2
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Usebenzise ukulingana kubini I=J kunye ne-I+J=π/2 kunye. Kuvumelana kwakhona noqikelelo lokuqala lwe-0.8.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Uthabathe ixabiso le-I+J njengexabiso le-I. J iqulathe isixa esifanayo nayo.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Uthabathe ukuphakama kwichaphaza elinye eliphakathi njengexabiso le-integral echanekileyo. Kufuneka uphindaphinde ukuphakama ngobude besithuba.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni kwakunokwenzeka kuphela uqikelelo, kwaye nasemva kokufumana ukulingana kwe-I+J, kwakubalulekile ukuba "ukwahlula phakathi" kwakusekusenjalo kusemtsha. Emva kokuba ukutshintshela kunike ubudlelwane J=I kuphela, i-I yabekwa. Ngokusebenzisa ulungelelwano lwesithuba kwi-integral echanekileyo, ungafumana ixabiso ngaphandle kokufumana i-antiderivative.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.prompt: Xa utshintshela x=π/2−t kwi-J, dx=−dt, kodwa J ibe +I endaweni ye-−I. Cacisa isizathu, ugxile kwimida yokudibanisa (ongaphezulu nongaphantsi).
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.hint.0: Fumana ixabiso le-t elihambelana ne-x=0 nele-x=π/2, uze ubhale imida engaphezulu nengaphantsi ye-integral entsha.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala okwenzekayo kuphawu xa ubuyisela i-integral echanekileyo enomda ongaphezulu ongaphantsi komda ongaphantsi kwindlela eqhelekileyo.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ubhale wena ukuba emva kokutshintshela umda ongaphantsi ngu-π/2 kwaye ongaphezulu ngu-0?
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.model.0: Njengoko x ihamba ukusuka kwi-0 ukuya kwi-π/2, t ihamba ukusuka kwi-π/2 ukuya kwi-0, ngoko imida engaphezulu nengaphantsi ye-integral iyatshintshana. Ukujika isithuba kutshintsha uphawu, kwaye kunye nokuthabatha okuvela ku-dx=−dt, uphawu luyaphelisana, ngoko J=+I.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.model.1: Emva kokutshintshela, isithuba siyajikwa, sisuka kwi-π/2 sisiya kwi-0. Ukubeka isithuba esijikiweyo ngokufanelekileyo kudala uphawu olunye lokuthabatha, kwaye eso nokuthabatha okuvela ku-dx=−dt kuyaphelisana, ngoko uphawu luphela lulungile.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.prompt: Khetha i-integral echanekileyo enokufunyanwa ixabiso layo ngendlela efanayo esetyenziselwa ukufumana i-I (tshintsha x ngo-π/2−x uze udibanise intetho ehambelanayo).
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.hint.0: Kuyo nayiphi na inketho, bhala okwenzekayo kwisithuba nakwinani elingaphantsi xa x itshintshwa ngo-π/2−x.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.hint.1: Khangela ukuba inani elingasentla nelingaphantsi liyalingana na xa udibanisa intetho yantlandlolo neyatshintshiweyo.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.r.a: Ukuba isithuba [0,π/3], ngoko x no-π/2−x abenzi pairi ngaphakathi kwesithuba esifanayo, ngoko indlela engasentla ayisebenzi njengoko injalo.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.r.b: Inani elingaphantsi alilungelelanisiwe, ngoko nokuba udibanisa intetho ehambelanayo iqhezu aliba lula libe linani elinye.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.r.c: Ubone ukuba ukutshintshela x ngo-π/2−x kutshintshanisa i-sin³ ne-cos³, nokuba isixa sezintetho ezimbini sisi-1.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.r.d: Inani elingaphantsi liba li-0 ngaphakathi kwesithuba (kwi-x=3π/4), ngoko i-integral echanekileyo ayichazwanga nokuchazwa.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.explain: Kwi-c, isithuba [0,π/2] sizimapha ngaphakathi kwaso phantsi kwe-x→π/2−x, kwaye inani elingaphantsi sin³x+cos³x lilungelelanisiwe, ngoko ukudibanisa intetho ehambelanayo kunika i-1. Ngoko ixabiso li-π/4. Ingxaki kwi-a sisithuba, kwi-b ulungelelwano lwenani elingaphantsi, kwaye kwi-d lichaphaza apho inani elingaphantsi li-0 (3π/4).

n-m-h3-est-05.title: Ukuchaza Ngokuchanekileyo Umahluko Phakathi Kwemindilili Yesampulu Yeedolophu Ezimbini Kumhlobo
n-m-h3-est-05.goal: Xa imindilili yesampulu emibini ihluka kancinci kuphela, bala amaxesha okuthembana ukujonga ukuhlangana, uze uphinde ubhale isibakala ngamagama angabhengezi ophumeleleyo, uze usichaze kumhlobo.
n-m-h3-est-05.material: Inqaku lephephandaba lasekuhlaleni: "Abafundi basesekondari baseDolophini A basebenzisa iifowuni zabo ezihlakaniphile ngomndilili weeyure ezi-3.4 ngosuku, ixesha elide kuneDolophu B (iiyure ezi-3.1). Abafundi baseDolophini A bazisebenzisa ixesha elide." Kwiidolophu zombini, abafundi abayi-100 bakhethwa ngokungenamkhethe, ixesha lokusetyenziswa lilandela ukwabiwa okuqhelekileyo, kwaye ukuphambuka okuqhelekileyo kwenani labemi kwaziwa ukuba yiiyure ezi-1.5 kwiidolophu zombini.
n-m-h3-est-05.thinking.0: Bala amaxesha okuthembana ngokwakho uze uwathelekise
n-m-h3-est-05.thinking.1: Hlula umahluko woqikelelo lwamanani odwa kuhlangano lwamaxesha
n-m-h3-est-05.thinking.2: Phinda ubhale ulungiso ukuze lufanelane nomntu olufumana
n-m-h3-est-05.prereq.0: Ixesha lokuthembana lomndilili wenani labemi elisuka ekwabiweni okuqhelekileyo kunye nokuphambuka okuqhelekileyo kwenani labemi okwaziwayo
n-m-h3-est-05.prereq.1: Ixabiso le-z lokuthembana kwe-95%, malunga ne-1.96
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s1.prompt: Fumana ixesha lokuthembana le-95% lomndilili wenani labemi ledolophu nganye uze ufake amaxabiso ajikelezwe kwindawo yesithathu yedesimali (ngoko, kwiindawo ezimbini zedesimali). (Idolophu A: imida ephantsi nephezulu; Idolophu B: imida ephantsi nephezulu)
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ufumane ukuphambuka okuqhelekileyo komndilili wesampulu wedolophu enye, 1.5/√100.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s1.hint.1: Phindaphinda eli xabiso ngo-1.96 ukufumana umda wempazamo, uze uyongeze uze uyisuse kumndilili wesampulu wedolophu nganye.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s1.explain: Umndilili wesampulu ± 1.96×1.5/√100 = ± 0.294, ngoko iDolophu A ukusuka ku-3.106 ukuya ku-3.694 kwaye iDolophu B ukusuka ku-2.806 ukuya ku-3.394. Ukuba awahlulanga nge-√n, njenge-3.4±1.96×1.5, ixesha banzi kakhulu, kwaye ukuba usebenzisa z=1.645, ufumana ixesha le-90%.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.prompt: Ukujonga amaxesha amabini okuthembana, khetha isigqibo esifanelekileyo kakhulu ngokuphathelele inqaku.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.hint.0: Zoba amaxesha amabini kumgca wamanani uze ujonge ukuba ayahlangana na.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.hint.1: Cinga ukuba ixabiso kwinxalenye ehlangeneyo lingaba ngumndilili wenani labemi ledolophu zombini.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.o.a: IDolophu A ixesha elide, kuba umndilili wayo wesampulu mkhulu nge-0.3 yeeyure.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.r.a: Uthelekise kuphela ubungakanani beemndilili zesampuli. Umndilili wesampuli utshintsha ukusuka kwisampuli ukuya kwesinye, ngoko xa uvumela impazamo, ulandelelwano lunokujika.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.o.b: Kunzima ukuthi ngokuqinisekileyo isixeko A side ngakumbi; izithuba ziyagqubana, ngoko zisenokulingana.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.o.c: Izixeko zombini ziyafana, kuba izithuba ezimbini ziyagqubana, ngoko iimndilili zabantu bonke zinokuthathwa njengezilinganayo.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.r.c: Ufunde ukugqubana njengobungqina bokuba "ziyafana." Ukugqubana kuthetha ukuba ukulingana kusenokwenzeka; akuqinisekisi ukuba ziyalingana.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.o.d: Akunakugwetywa; ngabafundi abali-100 kuphela kwisixeko ngasinye, akukho kuthelekisa okunentsingiselo.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.r.d: Isampuli encinci ayenzi sithuba sibe nzima ukusebenzisa. Sisakuxelela ukuba iimndilili zikuluhlu luni.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.explain: Izithuba ezimbini, 2.806 ukuya kwi-3.394 kunye ne-3.106 ukuya kwi-3.694, ziyagqubana ukusuka kwi-3.106 ukuya kwi-3.394. Ukugqubana kukuhlolwa kokukhawuleza kuphela; ngokuchanekileyo ngakumbi, kufuneka ujonge ukuba isithuba se-95% somahluko weemndilili ezimbini siquka u-0 na. Apha isithuba somahluko simalunga ne-−0.12 ukuya kwi-0.72, esiquka u-0, ngoko kunzima ukuqukumbela ukuba isixeko A side ngakumbi. Kodwa akukangqinwa ukuba iimndilili ezimbini ziyalingana nazo.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.prompt: Umhlobo ufunde eli nqaku wapapasha kwishetyi yeqela, "Abantwana besixeko A ngokuqinisekileyo basebenzisa iifowuni zabo ixesha elide kunabantwana besixeko B." Ngokwesibalo sezithuba ngentla, bhala umyalezo olungisayo kwizivakalisi ezimbini okanye ezintathu, ngamagama anokuqondwa ngumhlobo wesikolo samabanga aphezulu.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.hint.0: Qala isivakalisi sokuqala ngokuvuma amanani enqaku (3.4 no-3.1).
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.hint.1: Emva koko, ngamagama alula, qhubeka ngokuba ukugqubana kwezithuba kushiya ithuba elithini.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.placeholder: umz. Inqaku lithi iiyure ezi-3.4 neeyure ezi-3.1, kodwa ...
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ubhale ngamagama alula umhlobo wakho anokuwaqonda?
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ukhankanye ukugqubana kwezithuba njengobungqina bakho ubuncinane kanye?
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ngaba uhlale ulungelelene, uthi "kunzima ukuqiniseka" kunokuba "kuphosisile"?

Ngokwenyani, izixeko ezimbini zinokuba phantse zifana.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.model.1: Umahluko wama-0.3 eeyure kwiimndilili zesampuli ungaphakathi komda wempazamo. Kuba izithuba ezimbini zokuthemba ziyagqubana, kunzima ukuthi u-A usebenzisa ixesha elide, kwaye banokulingana.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.model.2: Umahluko ngama-0.3 eeyure kuphela, ngoko banokufana, kwaye andikwazi ukuthi ngokuqinisekileyo. Izithuba ezimbini ziyagqubana.

n-m-h3-integc-02.title: Ukwenza Imisebenzi eyahlukeneyo yeCubic ngeDefinite Integral 4
n-m-h3-integc-02.topic: Ukudityaniswa: iipropathi ze-integral echanekileyo — ukuphelisana kwamalungu esiqingatha esingaqhelekanga kwixesha elilinganayo
n-m-h3-integc-02.goal: Sebenzisa inyaniso yokuba ii-integral ezichanekileyo zamalungu esidigri esingaqhelekanga phezu kwexesha elilinganayo ziyi-0 ukwakha imisebenzi eyahlukeneyo enee-integral ezichanekileyo ezifanayo, uze uchaze ulwakhiwo.
n-m-h3-integc-02.material: Cinga nge-integral echanekileyo yomsebenzi we-cubic f(x)=ax³+bx²+cx+d phezu kwe-[−1,1]. (I-x³ ithetha i-x ekhyubhu, kwaye i-∫_{-1}^{1} yi-integral echanekileyo ukusuka kwi-−1 ukuya kwi-1.)
n-m-h3-integc-02.thinking.0: Jonga ukuba ngaba amalungu ebinzana ayaphelisana na kwixesha elilinganayo
n-m-h3-integc-02.thinking.1: Yakha imisebenzi eyahlukeneyo enika i-integral echanekileyo efanayo
n-m-h3-integc-02.thinking.2: Jonga iimeko ezisetyenziswa ngazo le ndlela (ixesha elilinganayo, isidigri esingaqhelekanga)
n-m-h3-integc-02.prereq.1: Indlela uphawu lwexabiso lomsebenzi olwahluke ngayo kwi-x nakwi-−x
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.prompt: Khetha yonke imisebenzi apho i-integral echanekileyo phezu kwe-[−1,1] iyi-0.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.hint.0: Wahlula ibinzana ngalinye libe ngamalungu, uphawe ukuba ngawaphi amalungu ashintsha njani xa useka i-−x endaweni ye-x.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.hint.1: Khetha ibinzana elinye elinge-integral echanekileyo engeyi-0, ubale i-integral yelungu ngalinye phezu kwe-[−1,1] ukuze ukhangele.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.r.a: Amalungu esidigri esiyipheyiri anexabiso elifanayo kwi-x nakwi-−x, ngoko awaphelisani. Bala i-integral echanekileyo yawo omabini la malungu.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.r.b: Uqaphele ukuba kukho amalungu esidigri esingaqhelekanga kuphela, ngoko amaxabiso kwi-x nakwi-−x aphikisene.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.r.e: Uqaphele ukuba kukho amalungu esidigri esingaqhelekanga kuphela, ngoko amaxabiso kwi-x nakwi-−x aphikisene.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.r.c: Ilungu eliqhelekileyo 1 linexabiso elifanayo kwi-x nakwi-−x, ngoko aliphelisani. Jonga i-integral yelungu eliqhelekileyo.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.r.d: Ilungu le-x liyaphelisana kodwa ilungu le-x² aliphelisani. Wagweba ibinzana lonke ujonge ilungu elinye kuphela.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.explain: Kumalungu apho amaxabiso kwi-x nakwi-−x aphikisene (x, x³, x⁵, …), indawo ekhohlo neyasekunene phezu kwe-[−1,1] zahluke ngophawu kuphela, ngoko i-integral echanekileyo iyi-0. Kwi-x⁴−x² yi-2/5−2/3, kwi-x³+1 yi-2, kwaye kwi-x²+x yi-2/3, kungekho namnye kuzo oyi-0.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.prompt: Yiba yi-f(x)=ax³+bx²+cx+d (a, b, c, d ziinani eziphelele ukusuka kwi-−20 ukuya kwi-20 kubandakanywa) kunye ne-∫_{-1}^{1} f(x)dx = 4, wenze ii-f ezintathu ezahlukeneyo ezinelungu le-x³ nelungu le-x ngokwenene (a≠0, c≠0). Faka i-a, b, c, d nganye.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.hint.0: Okokuqala bala into oyifumanayo xa udibanisa i-ax³ ne-cx ngokwahlukeneyo phezu kwe-[−1,1].
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.hint.1: Okokuqala khetha i-(b, d) ukuze ibinzana eliseleyo 2b/3+2d lilingane ne-4, uze ufake i-a ne-c ngamanani angengawo zero.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Zonke iikoyifishenti ezine ziinani eziphelele ngaphakathi kuluhlu.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Iikoyifishenti ezine kufuneka zibe ziinani eziphelele ukusuka kwi-−20 ukuya kwi-20 kubandakanywa.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Ukuba i-a iyi-0, akukho lungu le-x³.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Ukuba i-c iyi-0, akukho lungu le-x.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.explain: Phezu kwe-[−1,1], i-∫ax³dx=0 kunye ne-∫cx dx=0, ngoko i-∫f(x)dx = 2b/3 + 2d. Ukuba le yi-4, ngoko i-b+3d=6. Imizekelo yi-(1,0,2,2), (3,3,−1,1), kunye ne-(−2,6,5,0). I-(1,3,2,2) inika i-2+4=6, hayi i-4, kwaye imizekelo ene-a=0 okanye c=0 ayifaneleki ngenxa yeemeko.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Emva kokufumana ii-f ezintathu okanye ezingaphezulu ezahlukeneyo, ubona ukuba i-integral echanekileyo ihlala ifana nakuba i-a ne-c zishintsha ngokukhululekileyo. Chaza ukuba kutheni.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Bala i-integral ye-ax³ ne-cx nganye phezu kwe-[−1,1].
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Bhala njengebinzana ukuba ingaba i-integral yamalungu aseleyo isebenzisa i-b ne-d kuphela na.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ngaba udibanise isizathu sokuba kutheni i-x³ ne-x zine-integral echanekileyo eyi-0 phezu kwe-[−1,1] nokulingana kwexesha?
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uqinisekise ngebinzana ukuba i-integral imiselwa yi-b ne-d eseleyo kuphela?
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.because.model.0: I-ax³ ne-cx zinophawu oluphikisanayo kwi-x nakwi-−x, ngoko phezu kwe-[−1,1] ii-integral zazo ezichanekileyo ziyaphelisana zibe yi-0. Ngoko ixabiso limiselwa kuphela zii-integral ze-bx² ne-d, 2b/3+2d.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Ii-integral ezichanekileyo zamalungu esidigri esingaqhelekanga i-ax³ ne-cx ziyi-0, ngoko i-a ne-c azinakuchaphazela ixabiso. Yi-b yesidigri esiyipheyiri kuphela kunye nelungu eliqhelekileyo d eliphembelelayo.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s3.prompt: Le propathi inokusetyenziswa xa ixesha lilinganayo malunga ne-0, njenge-[−1,1]. Khetha i-integral echanekileyo apho le ndlela ifanelekileyo khona.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s3.hint.0: Okokuqala jonga ukuba ingaba ixesha liphakathi kwe-0 na, linobude obulinganayo ngasekhohlo nangasekunene.

n-m-h3-integc-03.title: Umthamo Owenziwa Ngokujikeleza Ummandla Phakathi Kwemigca Emibini: Kwahamba Kwasiphi?
n-m-h3-integc-03.topic: Ukudityaniswa: umthamo wesolidi esenziwe ngokujikeleza ummandla phakathi kwemigca emibini (ubume bokusikwa)
n-m-h3-integc-03.goal: Kwisisombululo somthamo wesolidi sokujikeleza kummandla phakathi kwemigca emibini, fumana ulungise umgca ophosise ubume bokusikwa, uze ukhombe ukuba ibinzana elingachanekanga linika umthamo wawuphi ummandla.
n-m-h3-integc-03.material: USoyoung ufumene umthamo wesolidi esenziwe ngokujikeleza ummandla ovalwe yimigca emibini y=x kunye ne-y=x² kanye ejikeleze i-eksisi ye-x. (I-x² ithetha i-x isikwere.)
n-m-h3-integc-03.thinking.1: Sebenza ubuyela umva ukufumana ummandla omelwe yibinzana elingachanekanga
n-m-h3-integc-03.thinking.2: Qinisekisa impazamo ngokuqhathanisa ngqo iindawo zokusikwa
n-m-h3-integc-03.prereq.0: Umthamo wesolidi sokujikeleza malunga ne-eksisi ye-x
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca wokuqala ongachanekanga kwisisombululo sikaSoyoung.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s1.hint.0: Khetha ichaphaza elinye njenge-x=1/2 uzobe ukuba ummandla uhambela kude kangakanani ukusuka kwi-eksisi ye-x apho nokuba ukwenda phi.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s1.hint.1: Nquma ukuba ingaba ukusikwa okujikelezileyo yidiski eqinileyo okanye yidiski enomngxuma.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s1.line.0: Imigca y=x kunye ne-y=x² idibana kwi-x=0 nakwi-x=1, kwaye kwi-0≤x≤1, i-x≥x².
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s1.line.1: Xa lo mmandla ujikelezwa malunga ne-eksisi ye-x, ukusikwa kwi-x sisangqa esinerediyasi ye-x−x².
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s1.explain: Umgca wesi-2 yeyokuqala ukuphosisa. Xa ummandla phakathi kwemigca emibini ujikelezwa malunga ne-eksisi ye-x, ukusikwa yiwasha, idiski enomngxuma (irediyasi yangaphandle i-x, yangaphakathi i-x²). Asisosangqa esinerediyasi eyimpawu phakathi kwerediyasi ezimbini. Ukususela kumgca wesi-3, ukubala kulandela ukusikwa okungachanekanga komgca wesi-2, ngoko iimathematika zichanekile kodwa umphumo awuchanekanga.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.prompt: Lungisa umgca ongachanekanga ufumane umthamo. Emva koko, usebenzisa ukusikwa kwi-x=1/2, chaza ngezivakalisi ezinye okanye ezibini ukuba kutheni ibinzana likaSoyoung lingachanekanga.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.hint.0: Zoba ukusikwa kwi-x ukujonga ukuba ingaba sisangqa esikhulu serediyasi ye-x esisuswe kuso isangqa esincinci serediyasi ye-x².
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.hint.1: Kwi-x=1/2, bhala uqhathanise iindawo zesangqa esikhulu, esincinci, nesikaSoyoung.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ubhale irediyasi yangaphandle neyangaphakathi yokusikwa kwi-x wafumana indawo yako?
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uqhathanise indawo yokusikwa kukaSoyoung neyachanekileyo kwi-x=1/2?
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ngaba uqaphele ukuba i-(x−x²)² ne-x²−x⁴ ziyahlukana?
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.model.0: Ukusikwa kwi-x yiwasha enerediyasi yangaphandle i-x neyangaphakathi i-x², ngoko indawo yayo yi-π(x²−x⁴). I-V=π∫_0^1 (x²−x⁴)dx=π(1/3−1/5)=2π/15. Kwi-x=1/2 ukusikwa okuchanekileyo yi-π(1/4−1/16)=3π/16, kodwa ibinzana likaSoyoung sisangqa serediyasi ye-1/4, esiyi-π/16 kuphela.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.model.1: Ukusikwa okwenziwa kukujikeleza ummandla phakathi kwemigca emibini yidiski enkulu ngaphandle kwedisiki encinci, ngoko yi-π(x²)−π(x²)², kwaye umthamo yi-2π/15. Ukwenza isikwere somahluko werediyasi akufani nomahluko weendawo zezangqa ezikhulu nezincinci.

n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.hint.0: I-π∫_0^1 (nasiphi na isebenzi)² dx ibeka kunye iidiski eziqinileyo ezinerediyasi "yixabiso lalo msebenzi." Fumana ukuba loo msebenzi bubude bomgca ofuthi.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.hint.1: Kwisigqibo ngasinye, bhala ubume bokusikwa kwi-x xa kujikelezwa malunga ne-eksisi ye-x.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.r.a: Lo mmandla uvelisa ukusikwa okunomngxuma, ngoko kuya kufuneka udibanise i-π(x²−x⁴). Jonga ukusikwa kwi-x=1/2.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.o.b: Ummandla ovalwe yi-y=x, i-eksisi ye-x, kunye ne-x=1
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.r.b: Ukusikwa kwalo mmandla sisangqa esiqinileyo serediyasi ye-x, ngoko siba yi-π∫x²dx.

n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.r.c: Ukusikwa kwalo mmandla sisangqa esiqinileyo serediyasi ye-x², ngoko siba yi-π∫x⁴dx.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.o.d: Ummandla ovalwe yi-y=x−x² kunye ne-eksisi ye-x
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.r.d: Uqaphele ukuba lo ngummandla ovelisa izangqa eziqinileyo ezinerediyasi ebubude bomgca ofuthi x−x².
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.explain: I-y=x−x² iyi-0 okanye ingaphezulu kwi-0≤x≤1, kwaye xa ummandla phakathi kwalo mgca ofuthi ne-eksisi ye-x ujikelezwa malunga ne-eksisi ye-x, ukusikwa sisangqa esiqinileyo serediyasi ye-x−x². n-m-h3-integc-05.topic: I-integration: iimpawu ze-integral echanekileyo — ii-integral ezichanekileyo zemisebenzi ephindaphindayo nokukhetha ulwazi olufunekayo

n-m-h3-integc-07.title: Ukuba I-Integral Echanekileyo Incinci, Ingaba Umsebenzi Mncinci Kuyo Yonke Indawo?
n-m-h3-integc-07.topic: I-integration: iimpawu ze-integral echanekileyo — ingaba isiphakamiso esijikisiweyo sempawu yokuthelekisa siyasebenza na?
n-m-h3-integc-07.goal: Qinisekisa ngokwakha umzekelo ochasayo wakho ukuba impawu yokuthelekisa ye-integral echanekileyo ihamba kwicala elinye kuphela, uze uhlele into enokuthiwa kwelinye icala (ubukho).
n-m-h3-integc-07.material: Esi sisizathu sikaMinsu malunga nemisebenzi emibini f no-g echazwe kwisithuba 0≤x≤2. (∫_0^2 yi-integral echanekileyo isuka kwi-0 ukuya kwi-2.)
n-m-h3-integc-07.thinking.2: Sebenzisa i-contrapositive ukumisela into enokuthiwa ngokuqinisekileyo
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca wokuqala apho ingqiqo iphosakala khona kwisizathu sikaMinsu.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s1.hint.0: Kwimigca 1 no-2, fumana "ingqikelelo" kunye "nesiphelo" kwenye nenye uthelekise ukuba ziye zatshintshaniswa na.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga ukuba umgca 3 ubonisa ubungqina bokuba umgca 2 ulungile rhoqo, okanye nje umzekelo omnye.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s1.line.0: Ukuba f(x)≤g(x) kwi-0≤x≤2, ngoko ∫_0^2 f(x)dx ≤ ∫_0^2 g(x)dx.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s1.line.1: Ngokuchaseneyo, ukuba ∫_0^2 f(x)dx < ∫_0^2 g(x)dx, ngoko f(x)<g(x) kuyo yonke i-x kwi-0≤x≤2.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s1.line.2: Umzekelo, ukuba f(x)=x kunye no-g(x)=3, ngoko ∫_0^2 f(x)dx=2 < 6=∫_0^2 g(x)dx, kwaye f(x)<g(x) kwi-0≤x≤2.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s1.explain: Umgca 2 uphosakele. Impawu yokuthelekisa ye-integral echanekileyo ihamba kwelinye icala: "ukuba f≤g kuyo yonke i-x, ngoko i-integral ye-f incinci okanye iyalingana ne-integral ye-g." Isiphakamiso sayo esijikisiweyo (ukuba i-integral incinci, umsebenzi mncinci kuyo yonke i-x) asisebenzi ngokubanzi. Umgca 3 ubonise kuphela umzekelo omnye apho kwenzeka ukuba ibe lunjalo; akubungqina bokuba umgca 2 ulungile.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.prompt: Bonisa ngeemizekelo isizathu sokuba umgca 2 kaMinsu uphosakele. Kwi-f(x)=px kunye ne-g(x)=q (p no-q ziinani ezipheleleyo ezisuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-30 kuquka zombini), fumana amatyeli amabini-bini ezintathu (p, q) ezinje nge-∫_0^2 f(x)dx < ∫_0^2 g(x)dx kodwa kukho x kwi-0≤x≤2 enge-f(x)>g(x), uze uzifake.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala i-∫_0^2 px dx kunye ne-∫_0^2 q dx ngokwe-p no-q, uze uguqule uthelekiso lwazo lube yimeko.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.hint.1: f(x)=px iba nkulu njengoko x iba nkulu. Bhala imeko ethelekisa i-f(2) kunye ne-g(2) esiphelweni sesithuba, x=2.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.fail.c1: p no-q kufuneka ibe ngamanani aphelele asuka ku-1 ukuya ku-30 ngokubandakanya.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.explain: ∫_0^2 px dx = 2p kunye ne-∫_0^2 q dx = 2q. 2p<2q kuthetha p<q, kwaye ukuze f(2)=2p ibe likhulu kune-g(2)=q ku-x=2 kufuneka q<2p. Ngoko imizekelo ene-p<q<2p, efana ne-(3,4), (5,7), kunye ne-(10,11), yimizekelo echasayo. I-(3,6) ine-q=2p, ngoko f(2)=g(2) kwaye f(x)≤g(x) iyasebenza kuwo wonke u-x, ngoko ayiyomzekelo ochasayo.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.because.prompt: Khetha enye kwi-(p, q) oyifakileyo, uze, unika ixabiso elinye lika-x apho f(x)>g(x) namaxabiso e-integral ezimbini ezichanekileyo, uchaze isizathu sokuba ngumzekelo ochasayo kumgca 2 kaMinsu.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.because.hint.0: Khetha u-x omnye apho f(x)>g(x) uze ubhale amaxabiso e-f kunye ne-g apho.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.because.hint.1: Bala amaxabiso e-integral ezimbini ezichanekileyo uze uthelekise ukuba yeyiphi enkulu.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.because.placeholder: umz. Xa (p, q)=(...), ku-x=... f(x)=... kwaye g(x)=..., ngoko ...
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingaba uqinisekise, ngamanani athe ngqo, u-x apho f(x)>g(x)?
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ubale amaxabiso e-integral ezimbini ezichanekileyo uze ujonge ukungalingani?
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.because.model.0: Ukuba (p, q)=(3,4), ngoko ∫_0^2 3x dx=6 kunye ne-∫_0^2 4 dx=8, ngoko ∫f<∫g. Kodwa ku-x=2, f(2)=6 kwaye g(2)=4, ngoko f(2)>g(2). I-integral ye-f incinci, kodwa kwenye x i-f inkulu, ngoko ngumzekelo ochasayo kumgca 2.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.because.model.1: Kwi-(5,7), ii-integral ezichanekileyo zi-10 kunye ne-14, ngoko eye-f incinci. Kodwa ku-x=2, f(2)=10 likhulu kune-g(2)=7. Ngoko nokuba i-integral incinci, umsebenzi awuncinci kuwo wonke u-x.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.prompt: Cinga ukuba ∫_0^2 f(x)dx < ∫_0^2 g(x)dx iyasebenza. Yintoni onokuyithi ngokuqinisekileyo phantsi kwale meko?
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala ukuba uthelekiso lwee-integral ezichanekileyo lwaluya kuba yintoni ukuba ucinge "f≥g kuwo wonke u-x."
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.hint.1: Cinga ukuba yeyiphi isigqibo esisalayo ukuba ke loo mpumo iyaphikisana nemeko enikiweyo.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.o.a: Ubuncinane u-x omnye kwixesha apho f(x)<g(x).
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.r.a: Usebenzise i-contrapositive yepropati ethi ukuba f≥g kuwo wonke u-x, ngoko i-integral ye-f kufuneka ibe ubuncinane yi-integral ye-g.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.r.b: Awukwazi ukumisela ixabiso kwichaphaza elinye u-x=1 ngokuthelekisa ii-integral ezichanekileyo. Ungakha nomzekelo apho i-f inkulu ku-x=1.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.r.c: Umzekelo ochasayo owakhiweyo ngaphambili uyaliphula eli bango. Nokuba i-integral incinci, i-f inokuba nkulu kwenye x.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.r.d: Kumzekelo ochasayo, f(2)>g(2) ku-x=2. Kunokubakho amachaphaza apho i-f inkulu.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.explain: Ukuba f(x)≥g(x) kuwo wonke u-x, ngoko ∫f ≥ ∫g kufuneka kube yinyani. Imeko enikiweyo ∫f<∫g iyaphikisana noku, ngoko ubuncinane u-x omnye ukhona onge-f(x)<g(x). Kodwa awukwazi ukuxela ukuba loo x ikuphi, zingaphi, okanye ukuba ikhona x ene-f>g.

n-m-h3-integc-06.title: I-Integration Ngeenxalenye: Ungayikhetha U Nangayiphi Na Indlela?
n-m-h3-integc-06.topic: I-integration: imilinganiselo yokukhetha u kunye ne-v' kwi-integration ngeenxalenye
n-m-h3-integc-06.goal: Qinisekisa ukuba ubunzima be-integral eseleyo buxhomekeke kwindlela okhetha ngayo u kunye ne-v' kwi-integration ngeenxalenye, uze ucacise umlinganiselo wokukhetha ngamagama anokuqondwa ngumhlobo.
n-m-h3-integc-06.material: UHajun wenze i-integration ngeenxalenye kwi-∫ x eˣ dx kunye no-u=eˣ kunye ne-v'=x, kwaye intetho yaba nzima ngakumbi. UHajun uthi, "Ngaba awunakukhetha u kunye ne-v' nangayiphi na indlela kwi-integration ngeenxalenye?" (eˣ ngu-e ophakanyiswe kwi-x, kwaye ln x yi-logarithm yemvelo ye-x.)
n-m-h3-integc-06.thinking.0: Thelekisa indlela i-integral eseleyo etshintsha ngayo ngokuxhomekeke ekukhetheni
n-m-h3-integc-06.thinking.1: Misela umlinganiselo wokukhetha (iba lula xa yenziwa i-derivative / lula ukudibanisa)
n-m-h3-integc-06.prereq.1: Ii-derivative kunye ne-integral zemisebenzi ye-logarithmic neye-exponential
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.prompt: UHajun wenze i-integration ngeenxalenye kwi-∫ x eˣ dx kunye no-u=eˣ kunye ne-v'=x. Leliphi kwezi zilandelayo ichaza okwenzekayo ngolu khetho?
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.hint.0: Kunye no-u=eˣ kunye ne-v'=x, zifumane wena u' no-v uze ubhale i-integral ekwicala lasekunene lefomula uv − ∫u'v dx.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.hint.1: Thelekisa i-integral yantlandlolo kunye ne-integral eseleyo uze ubone ukuba amandla e-x atshintshe njani.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.o.a: I-integral eseleyo iqulathe i-x², ngoko amandla e-x enyuka ngokwenyani.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.r.a: Ubone ukuba ukuba u kunye ne-v' ziyatshintshwa, ukudibanisa i-v' kunyusa amandla, kwaye ngenxa yoko i-integral eseleyo inokuba nzima ngakumbi kune-integral yantlandlolo.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.o.b: I-integral eseleyo iba yi-0, ngoko impendulo iphuma ngoko nangoko.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.r.b: Ukuze i-integral eseleyo ibe yi-0, u'v kuya kufuneka ibe yi-0. Zifumane wena u' no-v uze ukhangele.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.o.c: Ifomula ye-integration ngeenxalenye ayiyi kuphela, ngoko ayinakusonjululwa.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.r.c: Ifomula iyasebenza nokuba uthatha yiphi into njengo-u. Okutshintshayo kubunzima be-integral eseleyo.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.o.d: I-integral eseleyo yi-eˣ kuphela, ngoko iba lula kakhulu.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.r.d: Okuseleyo kukuphindaphinda kwe-u'=eˣ kunye no-v=x²/2. Zifumane wena u' no-v.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.explain: Kunye no-u=eˣ kunye ne-v'=x, u'=eˣ kunye no-v=x²/2, ngoko ∫ x eˣ dx = (x²/2)eˣ − ∫ (x²/2)eˣ dx. I-integral eseleyo ine-x ephakanyiswe amandla amnye ngaphezu kweyantlandlolo, ngoko yaba nzima ngakumbi. Ifomula iyasebenza, kodwa ukhetho alubanga lulungileyo. Ukuba uthatha u=x kunye ne-v'=eˣ, i-integral eseleyo yi-∫ eˣ dx kuphela.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.prompt: Ufuna ukufumana i-∫ x ln x dx usebenzisa i-integration ngeenxalenye. Khetha icebiso elifanelekileyo lokunika uHajun.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.hint.0: Kuyo nayiphi na inketho, qala ukhangele ukuba ungayifumana ngoko nangoko v.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.hint.1: Thelekisa ukuba imveliso ye-u' kunye no-v ilula kune-integral yantlandlolo na.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.o.a: Elona lilula kukuthatha u=x kunye ne-v'=ln x.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.r.a: Ukufumana v kwi-v'=ln x akukho ngoko nangoko (v=x ln x−x). I-integral eseleyo ikwaqulathe ln x kwaye ayiba lula.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.o.b: Elona lilula kukuthatha u=1 kunye ne-v'=x ln x.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.r.b: Ukufumana i-antiderivative ye-v'=x ln x kuyafana nengxaki yantlandlolo, ngoko akukho nkqubela.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.o.c: Elona lilula kukuthatha u=ln x kunye ne-v'=x.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.r.c: Uthathe into eba lula xa yenziwa i-derivative (ln x) njengo-u kwaye into elula ukudibanisa (x) njenge-v'.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.o.d: Akukho mahluko ekukhetheni, kuba i-integral eseleyo inzima ngokulinganayo, ngoko khetha nantoni na.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.r.d: Ngokuxhomekeke ekukhetheni, i-integral eseleyo inokuba lula okanye nzima ngakumbi. Khumbula amava kaHajun kwinyathelo elidlulileyo.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.explain: Kunye no-u=ln x kunye ne-v'=x, u'=1/x kunye no-v=x²/2, kwaye ∫ x ln x dx = (x²/2)ln x − ∫ (x/2) dx = (x²/2)ln x − x²/4 + C. I-integral eseleyo yintetho yomgca kwi-x, ngoko ilula. Umlinganiselo wokukhetha okulungileyo kukuthatha into eba lula xa yenziwa i-derivative (ln x → 1/x) njengo-u, kwaye into elula ukudibanisa (x) njenge-v'.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.prompt: Bhala impendulo kuHajun. UHajun wathi, "Ngaba awunakukhetha u kunye ne-v' nangayiphi na indlela kwi-integration ngeenxalenye?" Usebenzisa i-∫ x ln x dx njengomzekelo, cacisa ngamagama alula indlela yokukhetha kakuhle nesizathu.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.hint.0: Kwi-∫ x ln x dx, fumana ukuba kweyiphi i-ln x ne-x eba lula xa yenziwa i-derivative neyiphi ilula ukudibanisa.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala ukuba yintoni i-integral eseleyo ngolo khetho, uze uyisebenzise njengobungqina ukubonisa uHajun.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ubhale umlinganiselo wokukhetha, ngesivakalisi esinye, endaweni "yendlela yonke"?
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba usebenzise ngokwenene umlinganiselo kwi-∫ x ln x dx?
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ngaba ubhale ngamagama anokuqondwa nguHajun (hayi nje uluhlu lweempawu)?
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.model.0: Hajun, ifomula iyasebenza nokuba ukhetha njani, kodwa ukuba i-integral eseleyo iba lula okanye hayi kuyahluka. Kwi-∫ x ln x dx, kufuneka uthathe u=ln x kunye ne-v'=x. ln x iba lula, 1/x, xa yenziwa i-derivative, kwaye x lula ukudibanisa. Ke i-integral eseleyo iba yi-∫ x/2 dx elula.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.model.1: Zama u=ln x kunye ne-v'=x. Umlinganiselo kukuthatha into eba lula xa yenziwa i-derivative njengo-u kwaye into elula ukudibanisa njenge-v'. Ke i-integral eseleyo yi-x/2 kuphela, esonjululwa ngokukhawuleza. Ukuba uthatha u=x endaweni yoko, kufuneka uqale ngokudibanisa ln x, okunzima ngakumbi.

n-m-h3-prob-03.title: Yeyiphi Iapp Yokufunda Esebenza Ngcono?
n-m-h3-prob-03.topic: Ithuba: ithuba elinemeko, ukuzimela nokuxhomekeka, ukuqiqa kwindlela kaBayes, ukumisela isithuba semizekelo
n-m-h3-prob-03.goal: Jonga ukuba imilinganiselo epheleleyo nemilinganiselo ngaphakathi kweqela ngalinye inokukhomba kwiindlela ezichasayo, uhlaziya isigqibo sakho kwinqanaba ngalinye njengoko idatha eninzi iveziwe.
n-m-h3-prob-03.material: Ufuna ukuthelekisa "ipesenti yabafundi abaphucule amanqaku abo" phakathi kwabafundi besikolo abasebenzise i-app yokufunda A okanye i-app B. Amanani aveziwe inqanaba ngenqanaba.
n-m-h3-prob-03.thinking.0: Ukwenza isigqibo sokuqala ngokusekelwe kwimilinganiselo epheleleyo
n-m-h3-prob-03.thinking.1: Ukuhlaziya isigqibo usebenzisa imilinganiselo enemeko ngaphakathi kwamaqela
n-m-h3-prob-03.thinking.2: Ukutolika umphumo ngokusebenzisa ukwahluka kokwakheka kwamaqela
n-m-h3-prob-03.prereq.0: Ithuba elinemeko ngumlinganiselo ngaphakathi kwamatyala ahlangabezana nemeko
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.prompt: Idatha ivezwa inqanaba ngenqanaba. Kwinqanaba ngalinye, khetha isigwebo usebenzisa kuphela oko uyaziyo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.hint.0: Ixesha ngalinye xa kuvela ulwazi olutsha, hlola ukuba uthelekisa izinga leliphi iqela.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.hint.1: Bala izinga lilonke nezinga leklasi nganye, uze ucinge ukuba leliphi lithelekisa abafundi abakwimeko efanayo.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Kwisikolo esinye, abafundi bakhethe i-app yokufunda A okanye B ngokwabo bayisebenzisa isemestare enye. Kubafundi abangama-200 abasebenzise u-A, abangama-132 baphucule amabakala abo, kwaye kubafundi abangama-200 abasebenzise u-B, abangama-152 baphucule.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Yeyiphi i-app ebonakala ineempumelelo ngakumbi ekuphuculeni amabakala?
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Izinga lilonke libonakala liphezulu ku-B. Kodwa ukuba asazi ukuba amaqela abafundi ayafana ngohlobo na, kusekude ukuqukumbela nantoni na ngempumelelo ye-app kula manani odwa.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: B: kuba ipesenti yabafundi abaphucule amabakala iphezulu
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Uthelekise amazinga lilonke (66% no-76%) njengoko enjalo. Esi sisigwebo sokuqala esiza engqondweni.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: A: nokuba kuphucule abafundi abambalwa abasebenzise u-A, kungenxa yokuba mhlawumbi bayisebenzisa abafundi abazabalazayo
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uthathe ngaphandle kobungqina ukuba abasebenzisi be-A bafundi abazabalazayo. Asikwazi ukwazi ulwakhiwo lwabafundi okwangoku.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Kusekude ukuxela: kuba asazi ukuba abafundi abanjani basebenzise i-app nganye
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Uqonde ukuba kufuneka ulwazi olungakumbi ngaphandle kwamazinga.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Abafundi bahlulwe baba yiklasi ephambili neklasi esisiseko, bafakwa kwakhona. I-app A: 36 kwabangama-40 kwiklasi ephambili kunye ne-96 kwabali-160 kwiklasi esisiseko baphucule. I-app B: 136 kwabali-160 kwiklasi ephambili kunye ne-16 kwabangama-40 kwiklasi esisiseko baphucule.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ngoku, yeyiphi i-app ebonakala ineempumelelo ngakumbi?
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Kwiklasi ephambili yi-36/40=90% ngokuchasene ne-136/160=85%, kwaye kwiklasi esisiseko yi-96/160=60% ngokuchasene ne-16/40=40%. Izinga lika-A liphezulu kuzo zozibini iiklasi, kodwa B yabonakala iphezulu lilonke. Izinga lilonke namazinga ngeklasi ngeklasi anokukhomba kwiindlela eziphikisanayo.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: B: izinga layo lilonke liphezulu, ngoko amanani ahlulwe ngeklasi akabalulekanga
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Nangona idatha ehlulwe ngeklasi inikiwe, ujonge kuphela izinga lilonke. Awusebenzisanga ukuthelekisa phakathi kwabafundi bakwiklasi enye.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: A: izinga lika-A liphezulu kwiklasi ephambili (90% kunye ne-85%) nakwiklasi esisiseko (60% kunye ne-40%)
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Uthelekise abafundi bakwiklasi enye ukujonga impumelelo ye-app ngokwahlukeneyo.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ziyafana: A ukhokela kwiklasi enye kwaye B ukhokela kwenye, ngoko ziyacinywana
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: A ukhokela kuzo zozibini iiklasi, kodwa ufunde ngokuthi B ukhokela kwiklasi enye. Thelekisa amanani kwakhona.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Abafundi bakhethe ii-app ngokwabo. Kubafundi abangama-200 abasebenzise u-A, abali-160 babekwiklasi esisiseko, ngelixa kubafundi abangama-200 abasebenzise u-B, abangama-40 kuphela babekwiklasi esisiseko.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ekugqibeleni, sesiphi isigqibo esifanelekileyo kakhulu ukusenza ngale datha?
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Iklasi esisiseko liqela elinezinga eliphantsi lokuphucula amabakala nokuba yeyiphi i-app esetyenzisiweyo, kwaye aba bafundi baqokelelene ku-A, nto leyo etsale phantsi izinga lika-A lilonke. Ngaphakathi kwiklasi enye A ukhokela, kodwa kuba abafundi bakhethe ii-app ngokwabo, kukho umda ekuqukumbeleni ukuba oku yimpumelelo ye-app.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: A ubonakala eneempumelelo ngakumbi. Izinga lakhe lilonke liphantsi kuphela kuba abafundi abaninzi beklasi esisiseko bayisebenzisa; ngaphakathi kwiklasi enye A ukhokela, kodwa kusekude ukuqiniseka
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Uthelekise ngaphakathi kwiklasi enye, kwaye ukhankanye nomda wokuba idatha ivela ekukhetheni kwabafundi bobabini.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: B ubonakala eneempumelelo ngakumbi. Izinga lakhe lilonke lokuphucula amabakala liphezulu, kodwa kusekude ukuqiniseka
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ulandele izinga lilonke kuphela. Awusebenzisanga ulwazi lokuba abafundi beklasi esisiseko baqokelelene ku-A, nto leyo ehlise izinga lakhe lilonke.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Asikwazi ukuthi nayiphi na indlela. Ukwahlula ngeklasi kujike isiphumo, ngoko idatha iyonke ayinakuthenjwa, kwaye kusekude ukuqiniseka
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ulahle yonke into kuba idatha yajika. Ukuthelekisa ngaphakathi kwiklasi enye kusanika ulwazi.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni ugwebe ngamazinga lilonke ukuba B ungcono, kodwa nje ukuba abafundi bahlulwe baba ngamaqela, isigqibo sajika. n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.2.info: Ngolunye usuku, uyenza kwakhona ngengxowa efanayo. Ngeli xesha, ibhola yokuqala isafihliwe, uvule ibhola yesibini ekhutshwe emva koko, kwaye yayiyibhola ebomvu. Ibhola yokuqala ayikhange ikhangelwe okwangoku.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.2.ask: Lingakanani ithuba lokuba ibhola yokuqala, leyo yafihlwa kwangaphambili, yayibomvu?
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.2.after: P(yokuqala ibomvu | yesibini ibomvu) = P(zombini zibomvu)÷P(yesibini ibomvu) = (3/8×2/7)÷(3/8) = 2/7. Ukwazi ukuba ibhola yesibini ibomvu kubalwa ngokungathi ibhola enye ebomvu isusiwe, ngoko ithuba lokuba ibhola yokuqala ibomvu nalo lehla ukusuka kwi-3/8 liye kwi-2/7.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.2.o.a: 2/7: ukuba siyazi ukuba ibhola yesibini ibomvu, ithuba lokuba ibhola yokuqala ibomvu liyehla
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.2.o.b: 3/8: ibhola yokuqala sele ikhutshiwe, ngoko ukwazi ibhola yesibini akutshintshi nto
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Uphosise uhlelo lwexesha ngesalathiso senkcazelo. Inkcazelo efundwe kamva inokutshintsha nethuba lesiphumo sangaphambili.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.2.o.c: 5/7: ibhola yesibini ibomvu, ngoko ibhola yokuqala kusenokwenzeka yayiluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Umbuzo ubuza ithuba lokuba ibhola yokuqala ibomvu, kodwa unike ithuba lokuba iluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka. Khangela ukuba la maxabiso mabini adibana abe ngu-1.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.reflect: Xa singazange sibone nayiphi na ibhola, ithuba lebhola yesibini lalingu-3/8, njengasekuqaleni, kodwa kwakuba sisazi ibhola yokuqala latshintsha laba ngu-2/7. Kwaye, ukufunda ngebhola ekhutshwe kamva kutshintshe ithuba lebhola ekhutshwe kwangaphambili. Ithuba elixhomekeke kwimeko limiselwa hayi ngohlelo lwexesha kodwa ngoko "esikwaziyo."
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s2.prompt: Cacisela umhlobo ukuba kutheni ithuba lokuba ibhola yesibini, ekhutshwe ungawazi umbala webhola yokuqala, ibomvu lingu-3/8. (Lo ngumhlobo owathi ayinakubalwa ukuba awuwazi umbala webhola yokuqala.)
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala imeko apho ibhola efihliweyo ibomvu nemeko apho iluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ngokwahlukeneyo, uze ufumane ithuba lokuba ibhola yesibini ibomvu kwenye nenye.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s2.hint.1: Phindaphinda ngethuba lemeko nganye, udibanise iimeko ezimbini, uze ubale ukuba liliphi ixabiso eliphumayo.
