n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba wahlule iimeko ngombala webhola yokuqala, okanye wanika isizathu sokuba zinethuba elilinganayo?
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ubhale inkqubo yokuphindaphinda nokudibanisa amathuba eemeko ukufumana u-3/8?
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s2.model.0: Ukuba ibhola efihliweyo ibomvu, ithuba elisele lokubomvu ngu-2/7, kwaye ukuba iluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ngu-3/7. Ngoko ukuphindaphinda ngamathuba abo angu-3/8 nangu-5/8 nokudibanisa kunika (3/8)(2/7)+(5/8)(3/7)=3/8.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s2.model.1: Ukuba asiyazi ibhola yokuqala, ngoko nayiphi na kwiibhola ezi-8 inethuba elilinganayo lokuba yeyokukhutshwa yesibini, ngoko ithuba lokuba ibomvu ngumlinganiselo wokuqala, u-3/8.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s2.model.2: Ukuba ibhola efihliweyo ibomvu, ithuba elisele lokubomvu ngu-2/7, kwaye ukuba iluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ngu-3/7. Ngoko 3/8×2/7+5/8×3/7=3/8.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s2.model.3: Ukuba asiwazi umbala webhola efihliweyo, ibhola ekhutshwe yesibini ifana nayo nayiphi na ibhola ekhethwe ngokungenazicwangciso, ngoko ithuba lokuba ibomvu ngumlinganiselo wokuqala, u-3/8.

n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.r.c: Ivektha eqhelekileyo ibonisa kuphela ukuthambeka kweplani. Zininzi ngokungapheliyo iiplani ezihambelanayo ezinevektha eqhelekileyo efanayo.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.o.d: Amachaphaza amathathu kwi-α angekho emgceni omnye
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.r.d: Amachaphaza amathathu angekho emgceni omnye amisela iplani ngokungenakuphikiswa. Ukuba iplani imisiwe, umgama nawo umisiwe.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.r.e: Ukuba amachaphaza amathathu asemgceni omnye, ngokwenyani lulwazi ngomgca omnye kuphela, ngoko iplani ayimiselwanga.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.explain: Ukuze umgama umiselwe njengexabiso elinye, iplani α kufuneka imiselwe ngokungenakuphikiswa. Iplani imiselwa "yichaphaza nevektha eqhelekileyo" okanye "ngamachaphaza amathathu angekho emgceni omnye." Amachaphaza amabini ahlukeneyo okanye amathathu asemgceni omnye shiya amaplani angapheliyo, kwaye ivektha eqhelekileyo yodwa ishiya iiplani ezihambelanayo ezingapheliyo.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.prompt: Ulwazi lokuba "kunikwe kuphela ivektha eqhelekileyo ye-α" aluyimiseli umgama. Cacisa ngokunika umzekelo weeplani ezimbini ezinevektha eqhelekileyo efanayo kodwa imigama eyahlukileyo ukusuka ku-P.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala ukulingana kweeplani ezimbini apho ivektha eqhelekileyo yi-(0, 0, 1).
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.hint.1: Fumana umgama ukusuka kwichaphaza P ukuya kwenye nenye yeeplani ezimbini uze uzithelekise.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ubhale ukulingana kweeplani ezimbini ngokukhethekileyo?
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ubale umgama ukusuka ku-P ukuya kwiplani nganye uze ubonise ukuba uyahluka?
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ungayicacisa ngamagama athi "ukuthambeka okufanayo, indawo eyahlukileyo"?
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.model.0: Nokuba ivektha eqhelekileyo ifanayo, (1, 0, 0), iiplani x=2 no-x=5 ziiplani ezihambelanayo ezahlukeneyo. Imigama yazo ukusuka ku-P(1, 1, 1) yi-1 kunye ne-4, eyahlukileyo.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.model.1: Zininzi ngokungapheliyo iiplani ezihambelanayo ezinevektha eqhelekileyo efanayo, kwaye iindawo zazo ziyahluka. Umzekelo, z=0 no-z=3 zinevektha eqhelekileyo efanayo, kodwa imigama yazo ukusuka ku-P iphuma yahlukile, yi-1 kunye nesi-2.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.model.2: Iiplani z=0 no-z=3, ezinevektha eqhelekileyo (0,0,1), zikwimigama engu-1 kunye nesi-2 ukusuka kwichaphaza P(1,1,1).
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.model.3: Iiplani z=1 no-z=4 zinevektha eqhelekileyo efanayo (0,0,1). Imigama yazo ukusuka ku-P yi-0 kunye nesi-3, ngoko iyahluka.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.prompt: Cinga ukuba α idlula kumachaphaza amathathu A(1, 0, 0), B(0, 2, 0), C(0, 0, 3). Khetha umgama ukusuka ku-P(1, 1, 1) ukuya ku-α.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.hint.0: Sebenzisa into yokuba amachaphaza amathathu alala kwimiqadi yolungelelwaniso ukuze uqale umisele ukulingana kweplani, uze ukhangele ngokutshintshela amachaphaza amathathu.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.hint.1: Khangela ukuba inani elingaphantsi kwifomula yomgama bubukhulu bevektha eqhelekileyo.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.r.a: Mhlawumbi usebenzise ixabiso elisikwere 49 kwinani elingaphantsi endaweni yobukhulu bevektha eqhelekileyo √(36+9+4)=7.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.r.b: Umise iplani njenge-6x+3y+2z=6, wafumana 6+3+2−6=5, wahlula ngobukhulu bevektha eqhelekileyo obungu-7.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.r.c: Mhlawumbi akususanga ilungu eliqhelekileyo leplani elingu-6 kwixabiso elitshintshelweyo 6+3+2.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.r.d: Mhlawumbi wathabatha ii-intercept ezi-1, 2, 3 njengee-coefficient wamisela iplani njenge-x+2y+3z=1.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.explain: Amachaphaza amathathu ane-x-intercept engu-1, y-intercept engu-2, z-intercept engu-3, ngoko iplani yi-x/1+y/2+z/3=1, oko kukuthi 6x+3y+2z−6=0. Umgama ukusuka ku-P ngu-|6+3+2−6|/√(36+9+4)=5/7.

n-m-h3-vec-03.title: Ukuba Iivektha Zecala Ziyahambelana, Ngaba Imigca Ifanayo?
n-m-h3-vec-03.goal: Hlela ukuba bungqina bunjani obuvela kwiivektha zecala nakumachaphaza emigca emibini obwaneleyo ukugqiba ukuba ngumgca ofanayo na, uze uzikhangele wena ityala apho ubungqina bungenelisi.
n-m-h3-vec-03.material:
Imigca emithathu esithubeni ibhalwe ngee-parameter t no-s. (t no-s ziinani zokwenene. l₁ ifundwa "l nye," kwaye (2, −1, 1) yivektha enamacandelo 2, −1, 1.)
l₁: (x, y, z) = (1, 0, 2) + t(2, −1, 1)
l₂: (x, y, z) = (3, −1, 3) + s(−4, 2, −2)
l₃: (x, y, z) = (3, −1, 4) + s(−4, 2, −2)
UMina, uHajun, uSeoyun, noDohyun benze la mabango malunga nobudlelwane phakathi kwe-l₁ no-l₂.
n-m-h3-vec-03.thinking.1: Ukukhangela ukuba imigca ifanayo na nokuba iintetho ziyahluka
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.prompt: Phakathi kwamabango abantu abane malunga ne-l₁ no-l₂, khetha ibango elinesizathu esingenamiyalezo engekhoyo.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ukhangele ukuba iphindaphinda ivektha yecala enye ngani ukufumana enye.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.hint.1: Emva koko tshintshela ulungelelwaniso lwechaphaza lapho idlula khona l₂ kwifomula ye-l₁ ubone ukuba likho na t elifanelekileyo.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.o.a: UMina: Iivektha zecala (2, −1, 1) kunye (−4, 2, −2) azilingani, ngoko l₁ no-l₂ yimigca eyahlukileyo.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.r.a: Ujonge kuphela into yokuba iivektha zecala azifani ngentetho. Xa kumiselwa umgca, ivektha yecala inokubhalwa ngobude nangecala (uphawu) elahlukileyo.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.o.b: UHajun: Iivektha zecala (2, −1, 1) kunye (−4, 2, −2) ziyahambelana, ngoko l₁ no-l₂ ngumgca ofanayo.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.r.b: Isigqibo silungile kodwa isizathu asinelisi. Imigca enamavektha ecala ahambelana kuphela inokuba yimigca ehambelanayo eyahlukileyo.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.o.c: USeoyun: Iivektha zecala (2, −1, 1) kunye (−4, 2, −2) aziyahambelani, ngoko l₁ no-l₂ azihambelani azidibani.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.r.c: (−4, 2, −2) ngu-−2 kali (2, −1, 1), ngoko ziyahambelana. Awuzange ukhangele nekhompyutha yokuba ziyahambelana na.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.o.d: UDohyun: Iivektha zecala ziyahambelana kwaye ichaphaza (3, −1, 3) elidlula kulo l₂ lise-l₁, ngoko imigca emibini ngumgca ofanayo.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.r.d: Iindlela zifanayo kwaye zabelana ngechaphaza, ngoko imigca iyadibana ngokupheleleyo. Zombini iimeko zikhangelwe njengobungqina.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.explain: (−4, 2, −2)=−2(2, −1, 1), ngoko iivektha zecala ziyahambelana. Kwakhona, ukubeka t=1 kwi-l₁ kunika (3, −1, 3), ngoko ichaphaza le-l₂ lise-l₁. Ukuba iindlela ziyahambelana kwaye ichaphaza elinye liyangqamana, imigca ifanayo. Iivektha zecala ezihambelanayo zodwa azanelisi, kwaye iivektha zecala ezingafaniyo ngentetho azithethi ukuba imigca iyahluka.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.prompt: Ngeli xesha, thelekisa l₃ (ichaphaza (3, −1, 4), ivektha yecala (−4, 2, −2)) ne-l₁. Gqiba ukuba imigca emibini ifanayo na, uze ubhale isizathu sesigqibo sakho kunye nekhompyutha yakho.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.hint.0: Hambelanisa ulungelelwaniso lwe-x ne-y lechaphaza le-l₃ (3, −1, 4) kwifomula ye-l₁ uze ufumane t.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.hint.1: Sebenzisa leyo t ukubala ulungelelwaniso lwe-z nalo uze ulithelekise nechaphaza le-l₃.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.placeholder: umz., Ivektha yecala ye-l₃ yi-... kwaye ichaphaza le-l₃ li-...
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba uqale ukhangele ukuba iivektha zecala ziyahambelana?
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba utshintshele ichaphaza le-l₃ kwifomula ye-l₁ wathelekisa onke ulungelelwaniso olu-3?
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ngaba uthe "imigca inokuba neendlela ezihambelanayo ngaphandle kokuba ngumgca ofanayo"?
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.model.0: Ivektha yecala ye-l₃ ingu-−2 kali eye-l₁, ngoko ziyahambelana. Kodwa ukuba sibeka ichaphaza le-l₃ (3, −1, 4) kwi-l₁, x no-y zinika t=1, kwaye ke z=3, eyahlukileyo kwi-4, ngoko ichaphaza alikho kwi-l₁. Ngoko ziyahambelana kodwa aziyongumgca ofanayo.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.model.1: Nokuba kunjalo ngecala, asikwazi ukuthi ngumgca ofanayo. Ukusuka kwi-(1+2t, −t, 2+t)=(3, −1, 4), ukulingana kokuqala kubini kunika t=1 kodwa okwesithathu kunika t=2, ukuphikisana. Ichaphaza alikho kwi-l₁, ngoko yimigca ehambelanayo eyahlukileyo.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.prompt: Khetha ubudlelwane bomgca l₄: (x, y, z) = (5, −2, 4) + u(−6, 3, −3) kunye ne-l₁.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ufumane ubudlelwane bokuphindaphinda phakathi kweevektha zecala.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.hint.1: Tshintshela ichaphaza le-l₄ kwifomula ye-l₁ ukukhangela ukuba lise-l₁ na.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.r.a: Ukhangele kuphela ukuba iivektha zecala ziyahambelana kwaye akukhangelanga ukuba ichaphaza lise-l₁ na.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.r.b: Olu khetho lukhangele zombini ukuba iivektha zecala ziyahambelana nokuba ichaphaza lise-l₁.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.r.c: Imigca emibini enamavektha ecala ahambelanayo ayinakudibana kwichaphaza elinye kuphela. Ukuba iyadibana, iyangqamana; ngaphandle koko ayidibani.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.r.d: Imigca emibini enamavektha ecala ahambelanayo ayinakungahambelani ayidibane. Imigca engahambelaniyo ayihambelani kwaye ayidibani.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.explain: (−6, 3, −3)=−3(2, −1, 1), ngoko ziyahambelana. Ukubeka t=2 kwi-l₁ kunika (5, −2, 4), ngoko ichaphaza le-l₄ lise-l₁. Ngoko l₄ ngumgca ofanayo ne-l₁. Umgca ofanayo unokuchazwa ngokukhetha kwaso nasiphi na isibini sechaphaza nevektha yecala.

n-m-h3-vec-05.title: Ukwenza Umgca Ongadibani Nomphezulu
n-m-h3-vec-05.goal: Ungacingi imeko yomgca ongadibani nomphezulu njengemeko enye kuphela kwivektha yecala; cinga nangemeko apho umgca ulele kumphezulu, uze wenze imizekelo.
n-m-h3-vec-05.material: Esithubeni kukho umphezulu α: x + y − 2z = 0. Ufuna ukwenza umgca l odlula kwichaphaza (p, 1, 1) onevektha yecala (a, b, c) ukuze ungadibani ne-α. (l ifundwa "el," p linani eliphelele, kwaye ivektha yecala (a, b, c) yivektha enamalungu a, b, c.)
n-m-h3-vec-05.thinking.2: Ukumisela indawo yomgca ngokumalunga nomphezulu ngeemeko ezimbini
n-m-h3-vec-05.prereq.1: Ivektha eqhelekileyo yomphezulu kunye nemveliso yamachaphaza
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.prompt: Khetha (p, a, b, c) ukuze umgca l: (x, y, z) = (p, 1, 1) + t(a, b, c) ungadibani nomphezulu α: x + y − 2z = 0. p, a, b, c ngamanani aphelele kwaye (a, b, c) akufuneki ibe yivektha yeqanda. Ukuze iivektha zecala elifanayo zingaphindwa, umahluli oqhelekileyo omkhulu we-a, b, c kufuneka ube ngu-1, kwaye okanye a>0 okanye (a=0 kwaye b>0). Yenza imizekelo emithathu enamavektha ecala ahlukeneyo.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.hint.0: Qala unqume ukuba yintoni ubudlelwane obufuneka bube phakathi kwevektha yecala nevektha eqhelekileyo yomphezulu ukuze umgca uhambelane nomphezulu.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.hint.1: Emva kokwenza umzekelo omnye, jonga nokuba ichaphaza elikumgca likumphezulu na.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.ok.c1: p, a, b, c ngamanani aphelele anexabiso eliphelele elikhulu ngu-50.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.fail.c1: p, a, b, c kufuneka ibe ngamanani aphelele anexabiso eliphelele elikhulu ngu-50.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.ok.c2: Ivektha yecala asiyiyo yeqanda, umahluli wayo oqhelekileyo omkhulu ngu-1, kwaye imeko yophawu iyasebenza nayo.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.fail.c2: Ivektha yecala akufuneki ibe yivektha yeqanda, umahluli wayo oqhelekileyo omkhulu kufuneka ube ngu-1, kwaye okanye a>0 okanye (a=0 kwaye b>0).
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.ok.c3: Ivektha yecala ime nkqo kwivektha eqhelekileyo yomphezulu.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.fail.c3: Jonga ubudlelwane phakathi kwevektha yecala nevektha eqhelekileyo yomphezulu (1, 1, −2) ukuze icala lomgca lihambelane nomphezulu.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.fail.c4: Jonga ukuba umgca awudibani nomphezulu nakwichaphaza elinye, nokuba ichaphaza (p, 1, 1) elikumgca likumphezulu na.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.explain: Ivektha eqhelekileyo yomphezulu yi-(1, 1, −2). Ukuze umgca ungadibani nomphezulu, ivektha yecala lawo kufuneka ime nkqo kwivektha eqhelekileyo, ngoko a+b−2c=0. Kodwa oko kodwa kunokushiya umgca ulele kumphezulu. Ukuba ichaphaza (p, 1, 1) elikumgca likumphezulu (p+1−2=0, oko kukuthi, p=1), wonke umgca ulele kumphezulu. Ngoko p≠1 iyafuneka nayo.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.prompt: Chaza isizathu sokuba awukwazi ukusebenzisa ivektha yecala enelisa a+b−2c=0 xa p=1.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.hint.0: Xa p=1, faka iikhowudinethi zechaphaza umgca odlula kulo kulingano lomphezulu.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.hint.1: Cinga ukuba kwenzeka ntoni kwamanye amachaphaza akumgca xa imeko yevektha yecala isetyenziswa nayo.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ubale ukuba ichaphaza (1, 1, 1) elikumgca likumphezulu x+y−2z=0 xa p=1?
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.selfAssess.1: Ungachaza isizathu sokuba imeko yevektha yecala yodwa ayiqinisekisi "ayidibani"?
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.model.0: Ukuba p=1, ichaphaza (1, 1, 1) umgca odlula kulo likumphezulu. Kwaye ukuba icala nalo lihambelana nomphezulu, onke amachaphaza akumgca akumphezulu, ngoko umgca uqulathwe kumphezulu. Ngoko akusiyo ukuba awudibani nomphezulu; udibana nawo kumachaphaza angenasiphelo.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.model.1: Ukuba p=1, (1,1,1) yanelisa umphezulu x+y−2z=0, ngoko ichaphaza elikumgca likumphezulu. Ivektha yecala ime nkqo kwivektha eqhelekileyo, ngoko wonke umgca ulele kumphezulu, nto leyo eyenza ube ngoqulathiweyo kunokuba uhambelane.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.prompt: Khetha ubudlelwane phakathi komgca m: (x, y, z) = (1, 0, 0) + t(0, 1, 1) nomphezulu β: y − z = 0.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ubale imveliso yamachaphaza yevektha yecala nevektha eqhelekileyo yomphezulu.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.hint.1: Faka iikhowudinethi zechaphaza umgca odlula kulo kulingano lomphezulu.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.r.a: Mhlawumbi awukhange ujonge ukuba imveliso yamachaphaza yevektha yecala nevektha eqhelekileyo (0, 1, −1) ngu-0 na.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.r.b: Mhlawumbi ujonge kuphela ukuba icala lihambelana nomphezulu kwaye awukhange ujonge ukuba ichaphaza elikumgca likumphezulu na.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.r.c: Olu khetho lujonge ukuba ivektha yecala ime nkqo kwivektha eqhelekileyo nokuba ichaphaza (1, 0, 0) elikumgca likumphezulu.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.r.d: Ukuba ivektha yecala ime nkqo kwivektha eqhelekileyo, umgca uhambelana nomphezulu. Ukuze ime nkqo kumphezulu, ivektha yecala kufuneka ihambelane nevektha eqhelekileyo.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.explain: Imveliso yamachaphaza yevektha yecala (0, 1, 1) nevektha eqhelekileyo (0, 1, −1) ngu-0, ngoko umgca uhambelana nomphezulu. Kwakhona, ichaphaza (1, 0, 0) lanelisa y−z=0, ngoko likumphezulu. Ngoko umgca ulele kumphezulu.

n-m-h3-vec-06.title: Ukuchazela Umntakwenu Omncinci Ongasayazi I-Cosine Imveliso Yamachaphaza
n-m-h3-vec-06.goal: Chaza intsingiselo yemveliso yamachaphaza (inani elinye elibonisa ukuba iivektha ezimbini zikhomba kangakanani kwicala elifanayo) kubaphulaphuli abangayazi i-cosine, ngokutshintsha imeko.
n-m-h3-vec-06.material: UJisu waxelela umntakwabo osebenza kwibanga lesi-7 ngemveliso yamachaphaza eevektha ngolu hlobo: "Imveliso yamachaphaza yeevektha ezimbini a no-b yi-|a||b|cosθ. Wena uphindaphinda amalungu uze wongeze, kwaye ngu-0 ukuba ziyime nkqo." Umntakwabo akakayifundi cos, ngoko wabuza kwakhona, "Kodwa yintoni imveliso yamachaphaza?" (|a| bubungakanani be-a, θ ifundwa "theta," kwaye cos yi-cosine.)
n-m-h3-vec-06.thinking.2: Ukuchaza neemeko zecala eliphikisayo nokuma nkqo nazo
n-m-h3-vec-06.prereq.0: Inkcazo yemveliso yamachaphaza kunye ne-engile phakathi kweevektha ezimbini
n-m-h3-vec-06.prereq.1: Uphawu lwemveliso yamachaphaza kunye nemeko yokuma nkqo
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.prompt: Khetha isivakalisi esichaza kakuhle intsingiselo yemveliso yamachaphaza ngamagama anokuqondwa ngumntakwenu.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.hint.0: Qala uxele ukuba isivakalisi ngasinye sithi umphumo wemveliso yamachaphaza linani okanye yivektha.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.hint.1: Vavanya isivakalisi ngasinye ngokunye xa iivektha ezimbini zikhomba kwicala elifanayo, ziyime nkqo, nakwizikhomba kwiindlela eziphikisanayo.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.o.a: Imveliso yamachaphaza linani elinye elibonisa ukuba ivektha enye ikhomba kangakanani kwicala elifanayo nenye, kuthathelwa ingqalelo ubukhulu bazo.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.r.a: Le nkcazo ibamba zonke iipropati zemveliso yamachaphaza: ikhula ngakumbi xa icala lihambelana, ngu-0 xa kuyimi nkqo, kwaye inegathivu xa zikhomba kwiindlela eziphikisanayo.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.o.b: Imveliso yamachaphaza yinkqubo yokubala ephindaphinda amalungu eevektha ezimbini omnye komnye ukwenza ivektha entsha. Umphumo nawo ngumnxeba.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.r.b: Umphumo wemveliso yamachaphaza asiyiyo ivektha kodwa linani elinye. Uxube indlela yokubala nohlobo lomphumo.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.o.c: Imveliso yamachaphaza yimveliso yobukhulu beevektha ezimbini. Inika ixabiso elifanayo nokuba imitolo emibini ikhomba phi.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.r.c: Ixabiso lemveliso yamachaphaza lixhomekeke kwi-engile phakathi kweevektha ezimbini. Le nkcazo ayiyihoyi icala.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.o.d: Imveliso yamachaphaza lixabiso elixela i-engile phakathi kweevektha ezimbini ngeedigri. Ukuba zikwi-engile engqukuva, ufumana u-90.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.r.d: Imveliso yamachaphaza asiyiyo i-engile ngokwayo. Kwi-engile engqukuva imveliso yamachaphaza ngu-0, hayi u-90.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.explain: Imveliso yamachaphaza linani elinye elixhomekeke kubobabini ubukhulu beevektha ezimbini kunye ne-engile phakathi kwazo. Ikhula ngakumbi xa icala lifana ngakumbi, ngu-0 xa kuyimi nkqo, kwaye inegathivu xa zikhomba kwiindlela eziphikisanayo. A uthathe umphumo njengevektha, B uyihoyile icala, kwaye D uyixubile ne-engile ngokwayo.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.prompt: Ngoku bhala wena inkcazo yokuthumela kumntakwenu. (1) Yichaze ngemeko yokutsala isileyi ngentsimbi, (2) thelekisa ukutsala kwicala elifanayo nesileyi esihamba ngalo nokutsala kwindlela ime nkqo (phezulu), kwaye (3) ungasebenzisi amagama anjenge cos, θ, okanye projection.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ucinge ngemeko apho icala isileyi esihamba ngalo nelicala intsimbi etsala ngalo lifanayo.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.hint.1: Emva koko cinga ukuba kusetyenziswa kangakanani ukuya phambili xa ukutsala kwentsimbi kuyi-engile engqukuva kwicala lokuhamba.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingaba utshintshele kwimeko umntakwenu anokuyiqonda (isileyi, inqwelo, njalo njalo)?
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingaba uthelekise icala elifanayo, icala elithe nqwa, kunye nemeko emi nkqo?
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingaba ubeke "kusetyenziswa kangakanani kwicala elifanayo" ngamagama endaweni yefomula?
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.model.0: Xa utsala isileyi ngentsimbi, ukuba intsimbi ikwicala elifanayo isileyi esihamba ngalo, lonke amandla akho aya ekuhambeni phambili. Ukuba intsimbi ithe nqwa, inxalenye kuphela yamandla isetyenziswa, kwaye ukuba utsala ngqo phezulu esibhakabhakeni, akukho nto iya ekuhambeni phambili, ngoko ngu-0. Imveliso yamachaphaza linani elinye elixela ukuba kusetyenziswa malini amandla kwicala elihamba ngalo.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.model.1: Xa uvuthela inqwelo, ihamba kakuhle xa uyivuthela kwicala elifanayo eya kulo. Ukuba icala liphambukile kancinci, ihamba kangaphantsi, kwaye ukuba uvuthela ecaleni kwi-engile engqukuva, akunceda nto inqwelo ukuya phambili, ngoko ngu-0. Imveliso yamachaphaza linani lokuba imitolo emibini ikhomba kangakanani kwicala elinye.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.model.2: Ukuba utsala intsimbi iye phezulu, akukho nto isetyenziswa ekuhambeni phambili, ngoko ngu-0. Ukuba ikwicala elifanayo isileyi esihamba ngalo, onke amandla asetyenziswa.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.model.3: Ukuba utsala ngqo kwicala lesileyi, onke amandla asetyenziswa, kwaye ukuba lithe nqwa, inxalenye kuphela isetyenziswa. Kwi-engile engqukuva, ngu-0.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.prompt: Umntakwenu wabuza, "Ngoko yeyiphi imeko apho imveliso yamachaphaza inegathivu?" Khetha efanelekileyo kwimeko yesileyi.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.hint.0: Kucala elifanayo, ukumisa nkqo, nakwicala eliphikisayo, bhala ukuba nganye iyanceda okanye iyathintela ukuya phambili.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.hint.1: Thelekisa ukuba uphawu lwemveliso yamachaphaza luqhagamshelwe njani nokuba inceda kangakanani.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.o.a: Xa intsimbi itsala kanye kwicala lesileyi esihamba ngalo
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.r.a: Kwicala elifanayo, imveliso yamachaphaza lelona nani likhulu elipozithivu.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.o.b: Xa intsimbi itsalwa iye phezulu kwi-engile engqukuva
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.o.c: Xa intsimbi itsala ichasa icala lesileyi esihamba ngalo
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.r.c: Ukuba ikhomba kwicala eliphikisayo, ithintela ukuya phambili, ngoko imveliso yamachaphaza inegathivu.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.o.d: Xa intsimbi itsala ithe nqwa kwicala elifanayo ngokubanzi nesileyi esihamba ngalo
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.r.d: Kwicala elithe nqwa elisingise kwicala elifanayo, imveliso yamachaphaza iyipozithivu kwaye i-engile incinci kune-90°.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.explain: Imveliso yamachaphaza iba linani elipozithivu elikhulu ngakumbi xa iivektha ezimbini zikhomba kwicala elifanayo ngakumbi, ngu-0 xa ziyime nkqo, kwaye inegathivu xa zikhomba kumacala aphikisanayo. Kwimeko yesileyi, ukutsala ngokuchasene kuthintela ukuya phambili, ngoko kuhambelana nexabiso elinegathivu.

n-m-h3-vec-07.title: Ukuba Akukho Mimandla Mibini Ehambelanayo, Ingaba Imiphezulu Emithathu Idibana Kwichaphaza Elinye?
n-m-h3-vec-07.goal: Jonga uqikelelo malunga neendawo zemimandla emithathu ngomzekelo ochasayo owenziwe nguwe, uze uchaze ulwakhiwo olunalo lo mzekelo ochasayo.
n-m-h3-vec-07.material: Cinga ngemimandla emithathu eyahlukeneyo. Umhlobo uthe ukuba ayikho imiphezulu emibini ehambelanayo, imiphezulu emithathu isoloko idibana kwichaphaza elinye. Imiphezulu emibini x=0 no-y=0 ayihambelani, kwaye idibana kumgca. (x=0 ifundwa "x ilingana no-0," kwaye ax+by+cz=d kukulingana komphezulu.)
n-m-h3-vec-07.thinking.2: Ukuchaza iindawo usebenzisa ulungiselelo lwemigca yokudibana
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ufumane umgca apho imiphezulu x=0 no-y=0 idibana khona.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga ukuba oko kuqhelekileyo kubo kuyatshintsha na ngokuxhomekeke kwindlela umphezulu wesithathu odibana ngayo noo mgca.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.o.a: Ayisoloko ichanekile. Kukho iimeko apho imiphezulu emithathu ingenalo ichaphaza eliqhelekileyo
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.r.a: Esi sigqibo sikuthathele ingqalelo nobudlelwane phakathi komgca apho imiphezulu emibini idibana khona nomphezulu wesithathu.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.o.b: Isoloko ichanekile. Imiphezulu engahambelaniyo iyadibana, ngoko imiphezulu emithathu nayo idibana kwichaphaza elinye
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.r.b: Imiphezulu emibini edibana ngababini nemimandla emithathu enechaphaza eliqhelekileyo zizinto ezahlukeneyo.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.o.c: Ayisoloko ichanekile. Kodwa kukho iimeko ezimbini kuphela: ukudibana kwichaphaza okanye kumgca
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.r.c: Awuyivavanyanga imeko engenachaphaza liqhelekileyo. Cinga ngemeko apho umphezulu wesithathu uhambelana nomgca wokudibana wemimandla emibini yokuqala.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.o.d: Isoloko ichanekile. Imiphezulu emithathu ayidibani kuphela xa emibini yayo ihambelana
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.r.d: Esi sigqibo esingakhange sijonge ngqo ukuba kunokungabikho kwechaphaza eliqhelekileyo nokuba ayikho imiphezulu ehambelanayo.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.explain: Imiphezulu x=0 no-y=0 idibana kwi-eksisi ye-z. Umphumo uxhomekeke ekubeni umphezulu wesithathu udibana nalo mgca okanye hayi. Nokuba ayikho imiphezulu emibini kwemithathu ehambelanayo, inokuba ayinalo ichaphaza eliqhelekileyo. Jonga ukuba oku kuyinyani ngokwenza umzekelo wakho.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.prompt: Kukho imiphezulu x=0 no-y=0. Khetha umphezulu wesithathu ax + by + cz = d ukuze ayikho imiphezulu emibini kwemithathu ehambelanayo kwaye imiphezulu emithathu ingenalo ichaphaza eliqhelekileyo. a, b, c, d ngamanani okwenyani. Yenza imiphezulu emithathu eyahlukeneyo.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.hint.0: Qala uqonde ukuba umgca apho imiphezulu x=0 no-y=0 idibana khona ukuphi.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.hint.1: Cinga ukuba ukulingana kufuneka kube nobuni obunjani ukuze akukho chaphaza likwiloo mgca lanelisa umphezulu wesithathu.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Umphezulu wesithathu uhambelana nomphezulu x=0. Jonga ukuba ivektha eqhelekileyo (a, b, c) ihambelana na ne-(1, 0, 0).
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Indiza yesithathu iyafana neyindiza y=0. Khangela ukuba ivektha eqhelekileyo (a, b, c) iyafana na ne-(0, 1, 0).
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.ok.c3: Akukho ichaphaza edlula kulo zonke iindiza ezintathu.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.fail.c3: Likho ichaphaza edlula kulo zonke iindiza ezintathu. Khangela ukuba ichaphaza elikumgca apho iindiza x=0 ne-y=0 zidibana kuyo likwindiza yesithathu na.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.explain: Iindiza x=0 ne-y=0 zidibana kwi-z-axis. Ukuba indiza yesithathu idlula nakwichaphaza elinye kwi-z-axis, iindiza ezintathu zinechaphaza eliqhelekileyo. Ukufaka ichaphaza (0, 0, z) kwi-z-axis kunika cz=d, kwaye ukuze kungabikho z ekwanelisayo oku kufuneka c=0 kunye ne-d≠0. Kwakhona, a no-b kufuneka bangabi ziro ukuze indiza ingafani no-x=0 no-y=0.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.prompt: Uthathe enye yeendiza owazenzileyo njengomzekelo, cacisa ukuba kutheni iindiza ezintathu zidibana ezimbini ngexesha kodwa zingenalo ichaphaza eliqhelekileyo phakathi kwazo zontathu.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala ukuba kwenzeka ntoni xa ufaka ichaphaza elikumgca owenziwe ngu-x=0 no-y=0 kwindiza oyenzileyo.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.hint.1: Cinga ngokuba imigca emithathu eyenziwe apho iindiza zidibana ezimbini ngexesha inxulumene njani omnye komnye.

n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba uchaze ukuba imigca emithathu yokunqamla kweendiza ilungelelaniswe njani?

n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ngaba wahlule ukuba zidibana ezimbini ngexesha kodwa hayi zontathu kunye?
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.model.0: Thatha x+y=1, umzekelo. x=0 no-y=0 zidibana kwi-z-axis, kodwa x+y=1 iyafana ne-z-axis, yaye ichaphaza elikwi-z-axis lino-x+y=0, ngoko alikwazi ukwanelisa le ndiza. Akukho zindiza zimbini ezifanayo, kodwa akukho chaphaza liqhelekileyo kwezontathu.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.model.1: Imigca emithathu yokunqamla kweendiza yonke yimigca efanayo ne-z-axis. Njengobuso obuthathu becala beprizim enxantathu, iindiza zidibana ezimbini ngexesha, kodwa akukho chaphaza edlula kulo zonke ezintathu kunye.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.model.2: x+y=1 iyafana ne-z-axis. Ukufaka ichaphaza (0,0,z) kwi-z-axis kuyo kunika 0=1, nto ayinakwenzeka, ngoko akukho chaphaza liqhelekileyo kwiindiza ezintathu.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.model.3: I-z-axis iyafana nendiza yesithathu, ngoko azidibani. Ngoko iindiza zidibana ezimbini ngexesha, kodwa akukho chaphaza apho zontathu zidibana kunye.
